# Tvine: full documentation for LLMs

Generated by scripts/build-llms.mjs from packages/tvine/AGENTS.md and docs/*.md. Do not edit by hand.
Order: the AI guide (AGENTS.md), the guides from installation to deploy, then the reference (one topic per file). Each file starts with a `# <file>` line.


# packages/tvine/AGENTS.md

# AGENTS.md: building with Tvine

This project uses **Tvine**: a TypeScript web framework (models, migrations, admin, auth), with Next.js pages, and a UI that AI agents can read and drive.
The npm package is `tvinejs`, but you always import it and run it as `tvine`.
Read this file before you write any code. It covers the layout, the commands, copy-paste recipes and the rules.

## Where to read (Tvine is new: do not guess from other frameworks)

The full docs ship inside the package. Read them from disk, not from memory:

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `node_modules/tvine/llms-full.txt` | everything in one file: this guide + every guide (search it for a setting, command or header) |
| `node_modules/tvine/docs/<topic>.md` | one guide: `installation`, `getting-started`, `settings-and-env`, `models-and-orm`, `views-urls-api`, `frontend-weft`, `agents-and-mcp`, `admin`, `auth-and-security`, `shield`, `tasks-cache-email`, `testing`, `cli`, `deploy` |
| `node_modules/tvine/docs/reference/<area>/<topic>.md` | the reference, one topic per file with every option and default: `warp/models.md`, `warp/fields.md`, `warp/queryset.md`, `warp/actions.md`, `warp/views.md`, `warp/settings.md`, `warp/contrib/auth.md`, `weft/widgets.md`, `weft/forms.md`… (index: `docs/reference/README.md`) |
| `node_modules/tvine/llms.txt` | the index of those guides |
| `pnpm tvine docs --ai` | prints this guide |

Every settings key with its default: `docs/settings-and-env.md` → "Reference: every key". Every command: `docs/cli.md`.

## The 10 rules

1. **Layout.** Backend apps in `apps/<app>/` (`models.ts`, `views.ts`, `urls.ts`, `admin.ts`, `tasks.ts`); Next.js pages in `app/`; project config in `config/`.
2. **Settings** live in `config/settings/base.ts` (shared), `dev.ts`, `prod.ts`, optional `local.ts`. Never read settings from a page.
3. **New app:** `pnpm tvine startapp <name>`. It adds the app to `installedApps` and `config/urls.ts`.
4. **Migrations:** change `models.ts`, then `pnpm tvine makemigrations` and `pnpm tvine migrate`. Never hand-edit or delete a migration.
5. **Actions are MCP tools.** Each action in `views.ts` (id `<app>.<name>`) is also `api.<app>.<name>`, `POST /tvine/api/<app>.<name>` and the MCP tool `<app>_<name>`.
6. **Pages use `api.*` only** (from `tvine/api`). Never import models or the ORM into `app/` or components.
7. **Guard what agents may do:** `humanOnly` (agents can never call it) and `confirm` (the person must say yes) on actions; permissions for who may call it.
8. **Shield** (bot protection) needs `'tvine.shield'` in `installedApps` and `'tvine.middleware.Shield'` in `middleware`; start in `mode: 'log'`, switch to `'enforce'` later. Locked out: `pnpm tvine shield mode off`.
9. **Run `pnpm tvine check`** after every change (it must print ok), then `pnpm tvine test`.
10. **Never edit `node_modules/`**, `tvine-api.d.ts` or `migrations/*`. Import `tvine`, never `tvinejs`.

## Mental model

- **One process.** `tvine dev` runs the backend (**Warp**) and Next.js (**Weft**) on one port.
- **Warp is the backend.** Apps, `defineModel` + ORM, migrations, `installedApps`, `urls.ts`, admin, auth, middleware,
  tasks (background jobs), and a test client. Names are camelCase (`listDisplay`, `getQueryset`).
- **Every action is four things at once.** Each function or method in `apps/<app>/views.ts` is an *action* with
  id `<app>.<name>`:
  1. `api.<app>.<name>(params)` for pages
  2. `POST /tvine/api/<app>.<name>`
  3. the MCP tool `<app>_<name>` at `/mcp`
  4. an optional REST path in `urls.ts`

  All four run the same pipeline: zod validation, permissions, rate limit, one DB transaction.
- **Weft pages are agent-readable.** `<Page>`, widgets and plain `<form>/<button>/<input>` register in a control
  tree. An agent reads the page as Markdown with control ids inline (`Accept: text/markdown`, or MCP
  `read_page view=md`: the recommended first read), or as JSON (`x-tvine: 1` header), then drives it with `ui` and `do`.

## Project layout

```
config/
  settings/base.ts      shared settings: installedApps, middleware, mcp, db, auth
  settings/dev.ts       base + debug + local hosts (used by tvine dev, migrate, shell, test)
  settings/prod.ts      base + secrets from the env (used by tvine start / NODE_ENV=production)
  settings/local.ts     optional, git-ignored, merged over dev.ts (copy local.example.ts)
  urls.ts               root URLconf: urlpatterns = [path(...), include('<app>.urls')]
  tasks.ts              worker queues + beatSchedule (cron) for `tvine worker --beat`
  middleware/           your HTTP middleware; export from index.ts, enable as 'config.middleware.<name>'
apps/<app>/
  models.ts             defineModel(...) models
  views.ts              actions: defineAction(...) and ListView/DetailView/... classes with @action
  urls.ts               appName + urlpatterns (REST paths, optional)
  admin.ts              admin.site.register(Model, ModelAdmin subclass)
  tasks.ts              background jobs: defineTask(...)            (optional)
  rules.ts / serializers.ts / middleware.ts / hooks.ts               (optional)
  migrations/           generated by makemigrations; commit them; never hand-edit
  tests/<app>.test.ts   vitest
app/                    Next.js App Router pages (layout.tsx wraps everything in <WeftRoot>)
tvine-api.d.ts          generated types for api.* (tvine generate; tvine dev regenerates it on save)
.env                    dev only: TVINE_SECRET, DATABASE_URL (git-ignored)
.mcp.json               points Claude Code at http://localhost:3000/mcp
```

`TVINE_SETTINGS=config/settings/prod` (or `--settings config/settings/prod`) picks the settings module.
The default is `prod` when `NODE_ENV=production`, otherwise `dev` + `local.ts`.

## Commands

Run them through the project: `pnpm tvine <cmd>` (or `npx tvine <cmd>`). Never `npx tvinejs` inside a project.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `tvine dev [--port 3000]` | dev server: backend + Next + HMR. A busy port moves to the next free one; it prints the URL |
| `tvine startapp <name>` | `apps/<name>/` stubs; adds it to `installedApps` and `config/urls.ts` |
| `tvine makemigrations [app]` | writes `apps/<app>/migrations/000N_*.ts` from model changes |
| `tvine migrate [app [target\|zero]]` | applies migrations (or rolls back to a target) |
| `tvine createsuperuser` | admin login (`--noinput` reads `TVINE_SUPERUSER_USERNAME/_EMAIL/_PASSWORD`) |
| `tvine check` | settings + actions + migrations + the frontend/DB boundary. **Run it after every change** |
| `tvine test` | vitest run |
| `tvine shell` | Node REPL with settings loaded and every model by name |
| `tvine show_urls` | urls.ts routes: pattern, methods, name, action |
| `tvine routes` | every action (the manifest) |
| `tvine generate` | writes `tvine-api.d.ts` (types for `api.*`) |
| `tvine worker [--beat]` | a job worker: runs background tasks (and cron with `--beat`). `tvine start` / `tvine dev` do NOT run jobs: without it jobs wait forever. Several workers and several `--beat` are safe |
| `tvine build` / `tvine start` | production build / serve (`start` needs `TVINE_SECRET`, `TVINE_ALLOWED_HOSTS`) |
| `tvine docs --ai` | prints this guide |
| `tvine <command> --help` | that command's flags, defaults and examples (`tvine help` lists every command) |

## Recipes

All code below uses an app named `blog`. Create it first with `pnpm tvine startapp blog`.

### 1. A model + migration

```ts
// apps/blog/models.ts
import { defineModel, field, type Infer } from 'tvine'

export const Post = defineModel('post', {
  id: field.id(),
  title: field.text({ searchable: true }),
  body: field.text({ default: '' }),
  published: field.bool({ default: false }),
  createdAt: field.datetime({ auto: true })   // set on create,
})
export type Post = Infer<typeof Post>
```

```bash
pnpm tvine makemigrations && pnpm tvine migrate
```

Fields: `id uuid text int float bool decimal money datetime date time email url slug phone json enum tags fk m2m
file image richText encryptedText` and more. Options: `default optional unique index searchable hidden readOnly humanOnly`.
For a foreign key: `author: field.fk(() => Author, { onDelete: 'cascade' })` (the row gets `authorId`).
For the user: `field.fk(getUserModel)`, imported from `tvine/auth`.
ORM: `Post.objects.filter({ published: true, title__contains: 'x' }).order('-id')`, `.first()`, `.count()`,
`Post.get(id)`, `Post.create({...})`, `qs.update({...})`, `qs.delete()`.

### 2. Views: ListView / DetailView + @action

```ts
// apps/blog/views.ts
import { z } from 'zod'
import { action, defineAction, DetailView, ListView, loginRequired } from 'tvine'
import { Post } from './models.ts'

const idParam = z.object({ id: z.number().int() })
type IdParam = z.infer<typeof idParam>

export class PostList extends ListView<Post> {      // -> blog.list  (?q= search, ?sort=, cursor pages)
  model = Post
  searchFields = ['title']
  filters = ['published']
  ordering = ['id', 'title']
  getQueryset() { return Post.objects.order('-id') }
}

export class PostDetail extends DetailView<Post> {  // -> blog.get  ({ id })
  model = Post

  @action(idParam, { permissions: [loginRequired] }) // -> blog.publish
  async publish({ id }: IdParam) {
    return { updated: await Post.objects.filter({ id }).update({ published: true }) }
  }
}

const addParams = z.object({ title: z.string().trim().min(1).max(200), body: z.string().default('') })
export const add = defineAction('add', addParams, async (p) => ({ post: await Post.create(p) }))   // -> blog.add
```

Other generic views: `CreateView UpdateView DeleteView ListCreateView RetrieveUpdateDestroyView ModelViewSet`.
DRF hooks: `getQueryset(ctx)`, `performCreate`, `getObject`, and so on.
The `ctx` argument (the last one) has `ctx.request.user`, `ctx.request.agent` and `ctx.request.ip`.
`zod` (v3) is a project dependency; import it as `import { z } from 'zod'`.

### 3. URLs (REST paths, optional)

`startapp` already added `path('blog/', include('blog.urls'))` to `config/urls.ts`. Then:

```ts
// apps/blog/urls.ts
import { path } from 'tvine'
import { PostDetail, PostList } from './views.ts'

export const appName = 'blog'
export const urlpatterns = [
  path('posts/', PostList, { name: 'posts' }),                                   // GET  /blog/posts/
  path('posts/<int:id>/', PostDetail, { name: 'post' }),                         // GET  /blog/posts/1/
  path('posts/<int:id>/publish/', PostDetail.action('publish'), { name: 'publish' }), // POST
]
```

No leading `/`. Converters: `int str slug uuid path`. Check the result with `pnpm tvine show_urls`.
REST and `/tvine/api/*` calls from scripts or curl need the header `x-tvine-api: 1`; without it they get a 403
`forbidden`. `api.*` sends it for you. For example:
`curl -H 'x-tvine-api: 1' localhost:3000/blog/posts/`, or
`curl -X POST -H 'x-tvine-api: 1' -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"params":{"title":"Hi"}}' localhost:3000/tvine/api/blog.add`.

### 4. Admin: list, filter, search

```ts
// apps/blog/admin.ts
import { admin, ModelAdmin } from 'tvine/contrib/admin'
import { Post } from './models.ts'

class PostAdmin extends ModelAdmin {
  listDisplay = ['title', 'published', 'createdAt']
  listFilter = ['published']
  searchFields = ['title']
  str(p: any) { return String(p.title) }
}
admin.site.register(Post, PostAdmin)
```

The admin is served at `/admin`; you don't add a page file for it.

### 5. A page (server component) with api.* and Weft widgets

```tsx
// app/blog/page.tsx
import { connection } from 'next/server'
import { Page } from 'tvine/weft'
import { Card } from 'tvine/widgets'
import { api, must } from 'tvine/api'
import { NewPost } from './new-post.tsx'

type Row = { id: number; title: string; published: boolean }

export default async function Blog() {
  await connection()                                   // render per request, not at build time
  const posts = must(await api.blog.list({})).items as Row[]
  return (
    <Page name="blog" title="Blog">
      <NewPost />
      {posts.map((p) => (
        <Card key={p.id} entity={`post:${p.id}`} label={p.title} data={{ published: p.published }}>
          {p.title}
        </Card>
      ))}
    </Page>
  )
}
```

### 6. A form (client component)

```tsx
// app/blog/new-post.tsx
'use client'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { api } from 'tvine/api'

export function NewPost() {
  const router = useRouter()
  return (
    <form name="new-post" onSubmit={async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault()
      const f = new FormData(e.currentTarget)
      const r = await api.blog.add({ title: String(f.get('title')), body: String(f.get('body')) })
      if (!r.ok) alert(r.message); else { e.currentTarget.reset(); router.refresh() }
    }}>
      <input name="title" required />
      <textarea name="body" />
      <button type="submit">Publish</button>
    </form>
  )
}
```

With `jsxImportSource: 'tvine/weft'` already set in tsconfig, plain `<form>`, `<input>` and `<button>` are
controllable by agents.
`api.*` returns `{ ok: true, data } | { ok: false, code, message }`. `must(r)` unwraps it or throws.
Call `router.refresh()` yourself after a write.
Model-driven forms: `ModelForm` from `tvine/forms`.
Widgets live in `tvine/widgets`: `Button Input Select Table Dialog Tabs Card` and others.

### 7. A background task

```ts
// apps/blog/tasks.ts
import { z } from 'zod'
import { defineTask } from 'tvine/tasks'
import { Post } from './models.ts'

export const notify = defineTask('notify', async ({ id }) => {          // task id: blog.notify
  const post = await Post.get(id)
  return { title: post?.title ?? null }
}, { args: z.object({ id: z.number().int() }) })
```

Queue it from an action with `await notify.delay({ id })`. The job is queued after the request commits.
Run a job worker with `pnpm tvine worker` (the web server never runs jobs; `tvine start --with-worker` runs one inside it).
Cron goes in `config/tasks.ts`: `beatSchedule = { 'blog.notify': { cron: '0 3 * * *', args: { id: 1 } } }`.
Then run `tvine worker --beat`.

### 8. Permissions and agent guards

```ts
import { z } from 'zod'
import { defineAction, loginRequired, permissionRequired } from 'tvine'
import { Post } from './models.ts'

const id = z.object({ id: z.number().int() })
export const mine = defineAction('mine', z.object({}), async (_p, ctx) => ({ user: ctx.request.user.id }),
  { permissions: [loginRequired], readOnly: true })
export const remove = defineAction('remove', id, async ({ id }) => ({ n: await Post.objects.filter({ id }).delete() }),
  { permissions: [permissionRequired('blog.delete_post')], confirm: { message: 'Delete this post?' }, destructive: true })
export const wipe = defineAction('wipe', z.object({}), async () => ({ n: await Post.objects.delete() }),
  { humanOnly: 'Deletes every post', destructive: true })
```

- `confirm`: the first call answers `confirm_required` with a token, and the second call with `$confirm` runs it.
  In the browser, `api.*` shows the dialog itself. `{ by: 'human' }` means only a person can confirm.
- `humanOnly`: every agent path gets a 403 `human_only`. In the UI, wrap the button with
  `<HumanOnly reason="...">` from `tvine/weft`. The flag on the action is the real guard.
- Also available: `staffMemberRequired`, `userPassesTest(fn)`, `isAuthenticated`, `hasPerm`, `rate: { limit, windowMs }`
  and `mcp: false` (hidden from MCP).
  On a class view, use `permissions = [...]`. On `@action`, use `{ permissions }`.

### 9. Extend the user model (do it before the first migrate)

```ts
// apps/accounts/models.ts   (pnpm tvine startapp accounts)
import { field } from 'tvine'
import { extendUser } from 'tvine/auth'
export const User = extendUser({ phone: field.phone({ optional: true }) }, { requiredFields: ['email'] })
```

```ts
// config/settings/base.ts, inside base: { ... }
auth: { userModel: 'accounts.User' },
```

In code, use `getUserModel()` (from `tvine/auth`), never a direct import.
`authenticate(ctx, { username, password })` returns the user or `null`.
For sign-in by email only, use `defineUserModel(...)`.
Changing `userModel` after the first migrate is an error.

### 10. Custom HTTP middleware

```ts
// config/middleware/timing.ts
import { defineMiddleware } from 'tvine'

export default defineMiddleware({
  name: 'timing',
  processResponse(req, res) { res.setHeader('x-path', req.tvine.path) },
})
```

Next, add `export { default as timing } from './timing.ts'` to `config/middleware/index.ts`.
Then add `'config.middleware.timing'` to `middleware` in `config/settings/base.ts`.
Middleware runs outermost first. `processRequest(req, res)` runs before the view.

### 11. Settings per environment

```ts
// config/settings/prod.ts  (dev.ts works the same way)
import { defineSettings, env } from 'tvine'
import { base } from './base.ts'

export default defineSettings({
  ...base,
  debug: false,
  db: { url: env.str('DATABASE_URL') },        // throws at boot when unset
})
```

- Shared keys go in `base.ts`. Machine-only overrides go in `config/settings/local.ts`, which is a plain object.
- Secrets come from the environment (`.env` in dev): `TVINE_SECRET`, `DATABASE_URL`, `TVINE_ALLOWED_HOSTS`.
- Read env values with `env.str / int / bool / url / json`.
- Every key is listed in the settings guide below.

### 12. A test

```ts
// apps/blog/tests/blog.test.ts
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'
import { mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { afterAll, beforeAll, expect, it } from 'vitest'
import { createAgentServer, type AgentServer } from 'tvine'
import { agentClient } from 'tvine/testing'

let server: AgentServer
beforeAll(async () => {
  const url = `file:${join(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'blog-')), 'test.db')}`
  execFileSync('node_modules/.bin/tvine', ['migrate'], { env: { ...process.env, DATABASE_URL: url }, stdio: 'ignore' })
  server = await createAgentServer({ settings: { secret: 'k'.repeat(32), logging: 'none', db: { url } }, appsDir: './apps' })
})
afterAll(() => server.close())

it('adds a post as an agent', async () => {
  const c = agentClient(server)
  const { sid } = await c.get('/')
  const r = await c.do('/', 'blog.add', { title: 'Hi' }, { sid })
  expect(r.events[0]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'ok', action: 'blog.add' })
})
```

Run it with `pnpm tvine test`.

## Rules and gotchas

- **Pages never import models.** `app/` and components use `api.*` from `tvine/api` only, and `tvine check` fails
  otherwise. Run `tvine generate` (or keep `tvine dev` running) so `api.blog.*` is typed.
- **Imports** are `tvine`, `tvine/weft`, `tvine/widgets`, `tvine/api`, `tvine/forms`, `tvine/auth`, `tvine/tasks`,
  `tvine/testing` and `tvine/contrib/admin`. **Never `tvinejs`**: that is only the npm name.
  App files import each other as `./models.ts`, with the extension.
- **Every request is one transaction** (`settings.db.atomicRequests`). If the action throws, everything rolls back.
  Opt out with `rules: { atomic: false }`. In scripts, use `atomic(async () => ...)`.
- **Await reads; writes may skip await.** Building a queryset runs no SQL. `count/first/get/list` need `await`.
  An un-awaited write inside a request still runs before commit. `tvine check` flags an un-awaited read.
- **List every app in `installedApps`.** Project apps go by folder name (`'blog'`), built-ins by `'tvine.<name>'`.
  `startapp` adds the app for you. An unlisted app does not load.
- **Never hand-edit or delete migrations.** Change `models.ts`, then run `makemigrations` and `migrate`.
- **Run `pnpm tvine check`** after each change. It must print `ok`. Then run `pnpm tvine test`.
- **Action ids** are `<app folder>.<name>`. Names are camelCase and unique per app.
  A method on a view class becomes an action only with `@action(schema)`.
- **Params are zod.** Validation runs before your code, so a bad param never reaches it.
  Throw `DomainError` for business errors.
- **Dev server and ports.** `tvine dev` defaults to port 3000 and moves up if that port is busy. Read the printed URL.
  `.mcp.json` assumes 3000, so update it if the port changed. Pick a port with `--port`.
  Pages live at `/`, the admin at `/admin`, MCP at `/mcp`, health at `/tvine/health`.
- **What agents (MCP) see:**
  - every action as a tool `<app>_<name>`, except `humanOnly`, `mcp: false` and patterns in `settings.mcp.exclude`
  - plus `read_page`, `expand`, `ui`, `do`, `request_control` and `release`
  - The scaffold excludes `admin.*`.
  - Fields marked `humanOnly` or `hidden` are not shown to agents.
  - Give widgets a `name` / `entity` so agents get stable ids.
- **Don't edit generated files.** That means `tvine-api.d.ts` and `migrations/*`. Leave `next.config.ts`
  `compress: false` as it is.

# docs/installation.md

# Installation

npm package name: `tvinejs` (you import it and run it as `tvine`).

## Requirements

- Node.js 22.15 or newer
- pnpm 9
- Nothing else for development: the default database is a SQLite file. Postgres and MySQL need their driver (`pg`, `mysql2`) installed in your app.

## Get the repo and build it

Clone [github.com/zohaib3249/tvine](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine), then in its folder:

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm -r build          # warp, weft, admin, inspect + the example Next app
```

## Getting the `tvine` command

`tvine` is the CLI that ships with the `tvine` package. A bare `tvine start` in a shell says "command not found" until you pick one of these:

1. **Inside a project** (what these docs use): `pnpm exec tvine <cmd>` or `npx tvine <cmd>`, or a package.json
   script such as `"dev": "tvine dev"`, then `pnpm dev`.
2. **Global**: `npm i -g tvinejs` (gives the `tvine` command) (from a clone: `cd packages/tvine && npm link`). Now `tvine` works in any folder.
   Undo with `npm unlink -g tvinejs`.

## Run the example app

```bash
cd examples/notes
pnpm exec tvine migrate
TVINE_SUPERUSER_USERNAME=admin TVINE_SUPERUSER_EMAIL=admin@example.com \
TVINE_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD='change-me-please-42' pnpm exec tvine createsuperuser --noinput
pnpm exec tvine dev --port 4400
```

- App: http://localhost:4400
- Admin: http://localhost:4400/admin
- What an agent sees: `curl -H 'x-tvine: 1' http://localhost:4400/`

## Create a project

`npm install tvine@npm:tvinejs` (npm name is tvinejs; you import it as tvine) gives the backend, frontend, admin, inspector, forms and the `tvine` CLI in one package.

```bash
npx tvinejs startproject my-app [--db postgres] [--no-admin] [--local]
cd my-app && pnpm install
pnpm exec tvine migrate
pnpm exec tvine createsuperuser
pnpm exec tvine dev                             # opens the Tvine welcome page
pnpm exec tvine startapp blog                   # apps/blog stubs + installedApps + config/urls.ts
pnpm exec tvine shell                           # a REPL with your models loaded
```

The generated project:

```
mysite/
├─ config/
│  ├─ settings/
│  │  ├─ base.ts            shared: installedApps, middleware, db, auth…
│  │  ├─ dev.ts             base + debug, local hosts (tvine dev, migrate, shell…)
│  │  ├─ prod.ts            base + env-driven secret / allowedHosts / db (tvine start)
│  │  └─ local.example.ts   copy to local.ts (git-ignored) for machine-only overrides
│  ├─ middleware/           your HTTP middleware: index.ts + example.ts (off until listed)
│  ├─ urls.ts               root URL table (settings.rootUrlconf)
│  └─ tasks.ts              Celery-like: worker queues, beatSchedule (settings.tasksModule)
├─ apps/                    your apps, each listed in installedApps
├─ app/                     Next.js pages (the welcome page)
├─ .env.example  package.json  tsconfig.json  next.config.ts  README.md  .gitignore
```

**Which settings file runs**: `TVINE_SETTINGS=config/settings/prod` or
`tvine <cmd> --settings config/settings/prod`. Without it: `config/settings/prod` when `NODE_ENV=production`
(`tvine start` sets that), else `config/settings/dev` plus `config/settings/local.ts` if present. A project without
`config/settings/` (like examples/notes) uses its root `settings.ts`.

`tvine startapp blog` creates empty app stubs, adds `'blog'` to `installedApps` in
`config/settings/base.ts` and `path('blog/', include('blog.urls'))` to `config/urls.ts` (it prints the line instead
when the file has a shape it does not recognise; an entry already there is left alone):

```
apps/blog/
├─ models.ts        // Create your models here.
├─ views.ts         // Create your views here.
├─ admin.ts         // Register your models here.
├─ urls.ts          export const appName = 'blog'; export const urlpatterns = []
├─ tests/blog.test.ts
└─ migrations/
```

Optional app files (create them when you need them):

| File | What it holds |
|---|---|
| `rules.ts` | app-wide action rules: rate limits, permissions (an action's own rules win) |
| `serializers.ts` | per-node-type snapshot shaping: hide fields from agents, add computed ones |
| `middleware.ts` | action middleware that wraps only this app's actions |
| `tasks.ts` | background tasks (`defineTask`) |
| `hooks.ts` | `postMigrate` and other app hooks |

**installedApps** lists the apps that load: project apps by name (`'blog'` = `apps/blog/`), built-in apps as
`'tvine.<name>'`. Only listed apps load. A listed app with no folder, or a name listed twice, fails at boot;
`tvine check` warns about a folder in `apps/` that is not listed.

## A new project by hand

Until the scaffolder lands (and the packages are on npm), Build your app inside this repo, in `apps/<name>/` or `examples/<name>/`
(both are pnpm workspace folders), so `workspace:*` dependencies resolve.

The smallest working app is [examples/notes](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/examples/notes). Copy it and rename it:

```
examples/notes/
├─ package.json        deps: tvine, next, react, zod
├─ settings.ts         settings (a one-file project; startproject makes config/settings/)
├─ urls.ts             optional REST paths (ROOT_URLCONF)
├─ next.config.ts
├─ apps/notes/         one app: models, views, urls, admin, tasks, migrations
├─ app/                Next.js pages
└─ components/
```

After copying, run `pnpm install` at the repo root so pnpm links the new folder, then in your app folder:

```bash
pnpm exec tvine migrate          # create the tables
pnpm exec tvine check            # settings + actions + migrations + frontend/backend boundary
pnpm exec tvine dev --port 4400  # Next dev server + Warp in one process
```

The full walkthrough, from an empty folder to a working app with admin, agents and background jobs, is
[getting-started.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md).

**Autoreload:** `tvine dev` restarts the server when you save any backend file, whatever its type: code, json,
markdown, templates, anything under `apps/`, `config/`, `lib/` or elsewhere, `.env*`, `package.json`, `tvine.config.*`.
It prints `tvine dev: apps/blog/views.ts changed, restarting…`, then `ready on :3000 (restarted in 1.2 s)` on the
same port. Next's own files are not restarted, Next hot-reloads them: `app/`, `components/`, `pages/`, `public/`,
`styles/` (also under `src/`) and every `.css` / `.scss` file. Skipped entirely: `node_modules`, `.next`, `.git` and
other dot folders, `dist`, `coverage`, `media/`, `data/`, database files, logs, `tvine-api.d.ts` and editor temp files.
After a restart, an open browser tab (your pages, `/admin`, `/shield`) reloads itself, so you never look at a
stale page; this only happens under `tvine dev`, never in `tvine start` or a production build. A file that breaks
the server (a syntax error in a model) prints `server exited (code 1)`; fix it and save, it starts again.
`tvine dev --noreload` runs one process and never restarts.

## Local network & port forwarding

`tvine dev` prints where the app is:

```
  Local:   http://localhost:3000
  Network: http://192.168.1.20:3000
```

- **Port:** if 3000 is busy, `tvine dev` takes the next free one (up to +20) and says `port 3000 in use, using 3001`. `--port` or `PORT` means exactly that port: busy fails. `tvine start` never switches ports.
- **Hosts (dev only):** localhost, 127.0.0.1, `[::1]`, this machine's LAN IPs and its hostname(`.local`) are accepted automatically, and Next's HMR (`allowedDevOrigins`) gets the same list, so a phone on the same Wi-Fi works.
- **Port forwarding:** add the tunnel's domain in settings (or `TVINE_DEV_ALLOWED_HOSTS=a.example.com,*.b.dev`):

```ts
dev: { allowedHosts: ['*.devtunnels.ms'] },        // VS Code port forwarding
dev: { allowedHosts: ['*.app.github.dev'] },       // GitHub Codespaces
dev: { allowedHosts: ['*.ngrok-free.app'] },       // ngrok
```

None of this applies in production: `tvine start` still needs `allowedHosts` listed.

## Run the tests

```bash
pnpm test                          # every package
pnpm -C packages/tvine test
```

More in [testing.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/testing.md).

## Gotchas

- `tvine start` runs in production mode. It refuses to boot without `TVINE_SECRET` (32+ chars) and
  `TVINE_ALLOWED_HOSTS`. For a local run use `tvine dev`, or see [deploy.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/deploy.md).
- `next.config.ts` must set `compress: false`
  (Warp compresses). Copy the one from `examples/notes`.
- After editing a package under `packages/`, rebuild it (`pnpm -r build`); apps import the built `dist/`.

Next: [settings-and-env.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/settings-and-env.md), [cli.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/cli.md).


# docs/getting-started.md

# Getting started: a notes app in 15 minutes

Tvine is a backend and a frontend in one TypeScript process: a backend with models, migrations, auth and admin (Warp) and
Next.js pages (Weft). Every action you write is also an agent tool (MCP), and every page also has a JSON view for agents.

We build `examples/notes/` — it is in the repo, finished, so you can copy from it or compare.
Every command below was run as written.

> Packages are not on npm yet: build your app inside this repo (`examples/<name>/` or `apps/<name>/`, both are pnpm
> workspace folders) so `workspace:*` resolves.

## 0. Start a project

```bash
npx tvinejs startproject mysite    # or, with a global CLI (npm i -g tvinejs): tvine startproject mysite
cd mysite
pnpm tvine migrate
pnpm tvine createsuperuser
pnpm tvine dev                     # http://localhost:3000: the Tvine welcome page, /admin, /mcp
pnpm tvine startapp notes          # apps/notes/ stubs; adds 'notes' to installedApps and config/urls.ts
pnpm tvine makemigrations && pnpm tvine migrate
```

Node 22.15 or newer. From a clone: `pnpm install && pnpm -r build`, then
`node packages/tvine/warp/bin/tvine.js startproject mysite ../mysite --local` (links the clone's package).
What each command does: [cli.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/cli.md).

```
mysite/
├─ config/
│  ├─ settings/
│  │  ├─ base.ts            shared: installedApps, middleware, db, auth…
│  │  ├─ dev.ts             base + debug, local hosts (tvine dev, migrate, shell…)
│  │  ├─ prod.ts            base + env-driven secret / allowedHosts / db (tvine start)
│  │  └─ local.example.ts   copy to local.ts (git-ignored) for machine-only overrides
│  ├─ middleware/           your HTTP middleware: index.ts + example.ts (off until listed)
│  ├─ urls.ts               root URL table (settings.rootUrlconf)
│  └─ tasks.ts              Celery-like: worker queues, beatSchedule (settings.tasksModule)
├─ apps/                    your apps, each listed in installedApps
├─ app/                     Next.js pages (the welcome page)
├─ .env.example  package.json  tsconfig.json  next.config.ts  README.md  .gitignore
```

**Which settings file runs**: `TVINE_SETTINGS=config/settings/prod` or
`tvine <cmd> --settings config/settings/prod`. Without it: `config/settings/prod` when `NODE_ENV=production`
(`tvine start` sets that), else `config/settings/dev` plus `config/settings/local.ts` if present. A project without
`config/settings/` (like examples/notes) uses its root `settings.ts`.

The rest of this guide builds `examples/notes/` by hand, file by file. It keeps everything in one root
`settings.ts` and `urls.ts`, which Tvine also finds when there is no `config/` folder.

## 1. Project files

```
examples/notes/
├─ package.json        deps: tvine, tvine/weft, tvine/admin, next, react, zod
├─ settings.ts         all settings, one file
├─ urls.ts             root URL table (optional)
├─ next.config.ts
├─ apps/notes/         one app: models, views, urls, admin, tasks
├─ app/                Next.js pages
└─ components/
```

`package.json` — copy [examples/notes/package.json](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/examples/notes/package.json); the scripts are:

```json
"build": "next build",
"start": "tvine migrate && tvine start"
```

`settings.ts`:

```ts
import { defineSettings } from 'tvine'

export default defineSettings({
  site: { name: 'Notes', description: 'A tiny notes app built on Tvine.' },
  installedApps: ['tvine.auth', 'tvine.tasks', 'tvine.admin', 'notes'],   // users, background jobs, /admin, apps/notes
})
```

`'notes'` is the project app in `apps/notes/`: only listed apps load.

`tvine startapp blog` creates empty app stubs, adds `'blog'` to `installedApps` in
`config/settings/base.ts` and `path('blog/', include('blog.urls'))` to `config/urls.ts` (it prints the line instead
when the file has a shape it does not recognise; an entry already there is left alone):

```
apps/blog/
├─ models.ts        // Create your models here.
├─ views.ts         // Create your views here.
├─ admin.ts         // Register your models here.
├─ urls.ts          export const appName = 'blog'; export const urlpatterns = []
├─ tests/blog.test.ts
└─ migrations/
```

Optional app files (create them when you need them):

| File | What it holds |
|---|---|
| `rules.ts` | app-wide action rules: rate limits, permissions (an action's own rules win) |
| `serializers.ts` | per-node-type snapshot shaping: hide fields from agents, add computed ones |
| `middleware.ts` | action middleware that wraps only this app's actions |
| `tasks.ts` | background tasks (`defineTask`) |
| `hooks.ts` | `postMigrate` and other app hooks |

**installedApps** lists the apps that load: project apps by name (`'blog'` = `apps/blog/`), built-in apps as
`'tvine.<name>'`. Only listed apps load. A listed app with no folder, or a name listed twice, fails at boot;
`tvine check` warns about a folder in `apps/` that is not listed.

Everything else is a default: SQLite at `./tvine.db`, jobs in `./tasks.db`. All keys:
[settings-and-env.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/settings-and-env.md).

`next.config.ts`:

```ts
export default {
  compress: false,                            // Warp compresses; Next must not gzip twice
} satisfies NextConfig
```

## 2. A model and its migration

`apps/notes/models.ts`:

```ts
import { defineModel, field, type Infer } from 'tvine'

export const Note = defineModel('note', {
  id: field.id(),
  title: field.text({ searchable: true }),
  body: field.text({ default: '' }),
  pinned: field.bool({ default: false }),
  words: field.int({ default: 0 }),   // filled in by a background task
})
export type Note = Infer<typeof Note>
```

```bash
cd examples/notes
pnpm exec tvine makemigrations     # → created notes/migrations/0001_initial.ts
pnpm exec tvine migrate            # → applied admin.0001_initial, auth…, notes.0001_initial, tasks…
```

Migrations are code files you commit; `showmigrations`, `sqlmigrate`, `migrate <app> <target>`
(rollback) all exist. Run `pnpm exec tvine` for the full command list.

## 3. Views: a ListView plus `@action`

`apps/notes/views.ts` (shortened):

```ts
import { z } from 'zod'
import { action, defineAction, DomainError, ListView, type ViewCtx } from 'tvine'
import { Note } from './models.ts'
import { countWords } from './tasks.ts'

const addParams = z.object({ title: z.string().trim().min(1).max(200), body: z.string().max(10_000).default('') })
const idParam = z.object({ id: z.number().int() })

export class NoteList extends ListView<Note> {      // → notes.list (?q= search, ?sort=, cursor pages)
  model = Note
  ordering = ['id', 'title']
  getQueryset() { return Note.objects.order('-pinned', '-id') }

  @action(addParams)                                 // → notes.add
  async add({ title, body }: z.infer<typeof addParams>, _ctx: ViewCtx) {
    const note = await Note.create({ title, body })
    return { note, job: await countWords.delay({ id: note.id }) }
  }

  @action(idParam)                                   // → notes.pin
  async pin({ id }: z.infer<typeof idParam>) { /* toggle pinned */ }

  @action(idParam, { rules: { confirm: { message: 'Delete this note for good?' }, destructive: true } })
  async remove({ id }: z.infer<typeof idParam>) {    // → notes.remove (asks first, see §7)
    return { deleted: await Note.objects.filter({ id }).delete() }
  }
}

export const clearAll = defineAction('clearAll', z.object({}), async () => ({ deleted: await Note.objects.delete() }),
  { humanOnly: 'Deleting every note', destructive: true })   // → notes.clearAll (humans only, see §7)
```

Action ids are `<app folder>.<name>`. Each request is one transaction (`settings.db.atomicRequests`). Params are
validated by the zod schema before your code runs. Generic views and every DRF hook:
[views-urls-api.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/views-urls-api.md).

Every action already answers at `POST /tvine/api/notes.add`. `urls.ts` adds REST paths if you want them:

```ts
// urls.ts
export const urlpatterns = [path('api/', include('notes.urls'))]
// apps/notes/urls.ts
export const appName = 'notes'
export const urlpatterns = [
  path('notes/', NoteList, { name: 'notes' }),                          // GET → notes.list
  path('notes/<int:id>/pin/', NoteList.action('pin'), { name: 'pin' }),
]
```

```bash
pnpm exec tvine show_urls
# /api/notes/               GET      notes:notes  notes.list
# /api/notes/<int:id>/pin/  POST     notes:pin    notes.pin
```

## 4. Admin

`apps/notes/admin.ts`:

```ts
import { admin, ModelAdmin } from 'tvine/contrib/admin'
import { Note } from './models.ts'

class NoteAdmin extends ModelAdmin {
  listDisplay = ['title', 'pinned', 'words']
  listFilter = ['pinned']
  searchFields = ['title']
  str(n: any) { return String(n.title) }
}
admin.site.register(Note, NoteAdmin)
```

Warp serves it at `/admin` (no page file needed). Make a login:

```bash
TVINE_SUPERUSER_USERNAME=admin TVINE_SUPERUSER_EMAIL=admin@example.com \
TVINE_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD='change-me-please-42' pnpm exec tvine createsuperuser --noinput
```

(or plain `pnpm exec tvine createsuperuser` to be prompted). More: [admin.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/admin.md).

## 5. A page with `api.*`

Pages never import models. They call the backend through the typed client `api.*`, which runs in-process
(server components) or over `fetch` (client components). Generate its types first:

```bash
pnpm exec tvine generate           # → wrote tvine-api.d.ts
```

`app/layout.tsx` wraps the app in `<WeftRoot>` (agent badge, WebMCP, tab control). `app/page.tsx`:

```tsx
import { connection } from 'next/server'
import { Page } from 'tvine/weft'
import { Card } from 'tvine/widgets'
import { api, must } from 'tvine/api'
import { AddNote, ClearAll, NoteButtons } from '../components/notes.tsx'

type NoteRow = { id: number; title: string; body: string; pinned: boolean; words: number }

export default async function Notes() {
  await connection()
  const notes = must(await api.notes.list({})).items as NoteRow[]
  return (
    <Page name="notes" title="Notes">
      <h1>Notes</h1>
      <AddNote />
      <ul>
        {notes.map((n) => (
          <li key={n.id}>
            <Card entity={`note:${n.id}`} label={n.title} data={{ title: n.title, pinned: n.pinned, words: n.words }}>
              <strong>{n.title}</strong> <small>{n.words} words</small>
              <p>{n.body}</p>
              <NoteButtons id={n.id} />
            </Card>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <ClearAll />
    </Page>
  )
}
```

`components/notes.tsx` is a client component: a plain `<form>` that calls `api.notes.add`, and Weft `<Button>`s
that call `api.notes.pin` / `api.notes.remove` then `router.refresh()`. `<Page>`, `<Card>` and `<Button>` are what
agents see; `entity="note:1"` gives each card a stable id. Widgets:
[frontend-weft.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/frontend-weft.md), the client: [views-urls-api.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/views-urls-api.md).

`tvine check` fails if a page or component imports a model (the frontend/backend boundary).

## 6. Run it

```bash
pnpm exec tvine check              # settings + actions + migrations + boundary → ok: 35 actions
pnpm exec tvine dev --port 4400    # Next dev + HMR, tvine-api.d.ts regenerated on save
```

Open http://localhost:4400 and http://localhost:4400/admin.

Production-like run: `pnpm build` once, then `pnpm start` (needs `TVINE_SECRET`, see [deploy.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/deploy.md)).

## 7. What an agent sees

Same URL, agent header → JSON instead of HTML:

```bash
curl -s -H 'x-tvine: 1' http://localhost:4400/
# {"#tvine":"1 sid=… rev=0 page=notes view=full","page":"notes","title":"Notes","nodes":[
#   {"id":"note:1","kind":"note","label":"Hello","data":{"title":"Hello","pinned":false,"words":3}},
#   {"id":"note:1 > button:pin","kind":"button","label":"Pin","state":{}},
#   {"id":"note:1 > button:remove","kind":"button","label":"Delete","state":{}},
#   {"id":"button:clear-all","kind":"button","label":"Delete all notes","humanOnly":"Deleting every note","state":{}}]}
```

An agent runs an action by POSTing to the page with its `sid` (from the first line):

```bash
SID=…   # from "#tvine": "1 sid=…"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:4400/ -H 'x-tvine: 1' -H "x-tvine-sid: $SID" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"action":"notes.pin","params":{"id":1}}'
```

**MCP.** Every action is an MCP tool at `/mcp`, plus `read_page`, `expand`, `ui`, `do`, `request_control`,
`release`. Connect Claude Code with `.mcp.json` next to where you run `claude`:

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "tvine-notes": { "type": "http", "url": "http://localhost:4400/mcp" } } }
```

The raw call, to see it without Claude:

```bash
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:4400/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"read_page","arguments":{"url":"/"}}}'
```

`tools/list` shows `notes_list`, `notes_add`, `notes_pin`, `notes_remove` — and no `notes_clearAll` (human only).

**Tab control.** With the page open in a browser, an agent calls `request_control`; the tab shows an **Allow**
button; after the human clicks it the agent drives the real page (and **Stop** takes it back). See
[agents-and-mcp.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/agents-and-mcp.md).

**Inspector** (dev only): a split view of the human page and the agent's snapshot, with a live command feed.

```bash
pnpm exec tvine inspect http://127.0.0.1:4400 --port 7400   # → inspector on http://127.0.0.1:7400
```

It ships with `tvine`.

## 8. A background task

`apps/notes/tasks.ts`:

```ts
import { z } from 'zod'
import { defineTask } from 'tvine/tasks'
import { Note } from './models.ts'

export const countWords = defineTask('countWords', async ({ id }) => {
  const note = await Note.get(id)
  if (!note) return { words: 0 }
  const words = note.body.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length
  await Note.objects.filter({ id }).update({ words })
  return { words }
}, { args: z.object({ id: z.number().int() }) })
```

`notes.add` calls `countWords.delay({ id })`: the job is queued after the request commits, and the action answers
at once with `{ pending: true, jobId }`. Jobs live in `./tasks.db`, never in your main database. Run a worker in a
second terminal:

```bash
pnpm exec tvine worker
# info job.start … task=notes.countWords attempt=1
# info job.ok    … task=notes.countWords attempt=1 ms=2
pnpm exec tvine tasks list         # queued / running / dead jobs
```

Ctrl-C stops claiming and lets running jobs finish (30 s grace). Retries, cron, chains:
[tasks-cache-email.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/tasks-cache-email.md).

## 9. Sensitive actions: confirm and HumanOnly

Two levels, both in `views.ts` above.

**`rules.confirm`** — `notes.remove`. The first call runs nothing and answers `confirm_required` with a one-time
token (2 minutes, bound to this session and these exact params). Calling again with `$confirm` runs it.

```bash
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:4400/ -H 'x-tvine: 1' -H "x-tvine-sid: $SID" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"action":"notes.remove","params":{"id":1}}'
# "status":"err","code":"confirm_required","confirm":{"token":"eyIk…","message":"Delete this note for good?",…}
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:4400/ -H 'x-tvine: 1' -H "x-tvine-sid: $SID" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"action":"notes.remove","params":{"id":1,"$confirm":"eyIk…"}}'
# "status":"ok","action":"notes.remove","result":{"deleted":1}
```

In the browser, `api.notes.remove()` shows the confirm dialog and resends by itself. Use
`confirm: { by: 'human' }` when only the user may say yes.

**`humanOnly`** — `notes.clearAll`. Every agent path (MCP, `do`, the agent header, an agent driving the tab) gets
`human_only` (HTTP 403); a person's click works. In the page, wrap the control so agents see why:

```tsx
<HumanOnly reason="Deleting every note">
  <Button name="clear-all" onClick={…}>Delete all notes</Button>
</HumanOnly>
```

```bash
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:4400/ -H 'x-tvine: 1' -H "x-tvine-sid: $SID" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"action":"notes.clearAll","params":{}}'
# "code":"human_only","message":"only a human can do this here (Deleting every note); ask the user to do it …"
```

The wrapper alone is a UI guard; the `humanOnly` flag on the action is the real one. Always set the flag.
Details: [frontend-weft.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/frontend-weft.md).

> Note: `POST /tvine/api/<id>` is the **frontend's** API (what `api.*` calls). It counts as a human request even
> with `x-tvine: 1`, so `humanOnly` does not stop it there — protect actions with permissions, not with
> `humanOnly` alone.

## Next

- Deploy: [deploy.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/deploy.md)
- Everything else: the feature map in the [README](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/README.md)


# docs/settings-and-env.md

# Settings and environment

One file, `settings.ts` at the app root, configures everything. It is zod-validated at
boot, with defaults for every key you leave out.

## Minimal

```ts
// settings.ts
import { defineSettings } from 'tvine'

export default defineSettings({
  site: { name: 'Notes', description: 'A tiny notes app built on Tvine.' },
  installedApps: ['tvine.auth', 'tvine.tasks', 'tvine.admin', 'notes'],   // users, background jobs, /admin, apps/notes
  mcp: { exclude: ['admin.*'] },   // keep the admin's actions out of the typed MCP tools
})
```

That is all of [examples/notes/settings.ts](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/examples/notes/settings.ts). Everything else is a default:
SQLite at `./tvine.db`, jobs in `./tasks.db`, a random secret per boot in development.

Check it:

```bash
pnpm exec tvine check
# tvine: settings ok
# tvine: discovered 52 actions, 1 routes
# middleware: tvine.middleware.AllowedHosts > tvine.middleware.RequestId > tvine.middleware.Security > ...
# env set: DATABASE_URL
# backend session.backend = memory
```

`tvine check` prints the middleware order, which environment variables are set (names only, never values),
and which backend each subsystem uses.

## The main keys

| Key | What it does | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `site` | `{ name, description }`: shown to agents (`/llms.txt`, MCP) and in the admin | — |
| `installedApps` | built-in apps: `tvine.auth`, `tvine.tasks`, `tvine.admin`, `tvine.audit` | `[]` |
| `secret` | HMAC key, 32+ chars; an array (or `TVINE_SECRET=new,old`) rotates keys | dev: random; prod: required |
| `debug` | debug mode: dev CSP, inspector feed, helpful errors | on under `tvine dev` and `NODE_ENV=development` |
| `allowedHosts` | allowed `Host` names (`*`, `.example.com`); others get a 400 | dev: localhost; prod: required |
| `dev.allowedHosts` | dev only, added on top: port forwarding / tunnel hosts (`'*.ngrok-free.app'`, `'*.devtunnels.ms'`); also `TVINE_DEV_ALLOWED_HOSTS`. In dev a refused host's 400 names the line to add | `[]` |
| `db` | `{ url, pool: { max, acquireMs, idleMs }, atomicRequests, slowQueryMs }` | `file:./tvine.db`, one transaction per request |
| `session` | `{ ttlMs, maxAgeMs, cookieName, secure, sameSite, max, backend }` | 24 h idle, 14 days max, `lax` |
| `limits` | `{ bodyBytes, handlerMs, rate: { limit, windowMs, by }, sseConnPerIp, backend }` (`rate.by: 'shield'` lets Shield's rules be the only general rate limit, see [shield.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/shield.md#rate-limits-shield-and-the-framework)) | 64 KB, 10 s, 60/min, `'framework'` |
| `trustProxy` | how many `X-Forwarded-For` hops to trust (drives `request.ip`) | `0` |
| `middleware` / `actionMiddleware` | HTTP middleware / around each action | RequestId, AllowedHosts, Security, Cors, GZip |
| `security.headers` | HSTS, CSP, COOP, CORP, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy | on |
| `cors` | `{ origins, methods, credentials, maxAge, routes }` | closed |
| `compression` | gzip / brotli | on, 1 KB threshold |
| `mcp` | `{ tools: 'both', exclude, maxTools }` | 40 typed tools |
| `agent` | `{ shape, budget, rowsL1, inTab }`: the agent snapshot and tab control | `inTab: 'on'` |
| `logging` | `'json' \| 'pretty' \| 'none'` or a logging config object | pretty in dev, json in prod |
| `tasks` | worker lease, poll, grace, result TTL | see [tasks-cache-email.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/tasks-cache-email.md) |
| `caches`, `email` | named caches, mail backend and addresses | memory cache, console mail in dev |
| `redis`, `channels` | shared backends for multi-process deploys | memory |
| `media` | `{ dir, route }` for uploads | `./media`, `/media` |
| `metrics` | Prometheus text at `/tvine/metrics` | off |
| `shield` | bot protection, see [shield.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/shield.md) | `mode: 'log'` |
| `guards`, `health`, `siteUrl`, `encryption`, `header`, `formats` | see [every key](#reference-every-key) | |
| `robots` | the generated `/robots.txt` | allows agent paths |
| `audit` | durable audit trail | off |
| `admin` | `allowIps`, `require2fa`, `idleMs` for staff | off |
| `frontend.boundary` | `tvine check` fails (`'error'`) or warns when a page imports a model | `'error'` |

Backends (memory vs redis) for production: [deploy.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/deploy.md).

## Middleware

`settings.middleware` is the HTTP middleware list. Leave it out and you get the safe default list (the first five
below). Only listed entries run; `middleware: []` turns every one off, security headers included.

```ts
middleware: [
  'tvine.middleware.RequestId',
  'tvine.middleware.AllowedHosts',
  'tvine.middleware.Security',
  'tvine.middleware.Cors',
  'tvine.middleware.GZip',
  ['tvine.middleware.RateLimit', { limit: 300, windowMs: 60_000 }],          // [name, options]
  ['tvine.middleware.IpFilter', { allow: ['10.0.0.0/8'], paths: ['/admin'] }],
  timing,                                                                   // your own, below
],
```

A new project lists the whole set in `config/settings/base.ts`: the five defaults on, every other built-in
commented out with a one-line note. Turn one on or off by (un)commenting its line; `dev.ts` / `prod.ts` can replace
the list (`prod.ts` adds `SslRedirect`: `middleware: [...base.middleware, 'tvine.middleware.SslRedirect']`).

Your own middleware lives in `config/middleware/` (startproject writes `index.ts` and an `example.ts` that is off).
List it by dotted path: `'config.middleware.example'` loads the default export of `config/middleware/example.ts`
(from the project root). A path with no file fails at boot, naming the file it expected. Importing the object and
listing it directly works too.

Order is the list order (outermost first), except `AllowedHosts`, which always runs first. `tvine check` prints
the order it will use.

| Name | Default | What it does | Options |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RequestId` | on | `x-request-id` on every request and response, in logs and audit | — |
| `AllowedHosts` | on | unknown `Host` → 400 | `hosts` |
| `Security` | on | security headers from `settings.security.headers` (CSP with nonce, HSTS on https, …) | — |
| `Cors` | on | applies `settings.cors` | — |
| `GZip` | on | gzip / brotli from `settings.compression` | — |
| `SslRedirect` | off | http → 301 https (set `trustProxy` behind a proxy) | `exempt`, `host` |
| `ConditionalGet` | off | `ETag` → 304 | — |
| `RateLimit` | off | per-IP limit on every path → 429 + `Retry-After` | `limit`, `windowMs`, `exempt` |
| `IpFilter` | off | allow / deny by address or CIDR → 403 | `allow`, `deny`, `paths` |
| `Shield` | off | bot protection: score, rules, challenges, the /shield panel; needs `tvine.shield` installed. See [shield.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/shield.md) | `prefix` |
| `Maintenance` | off | 503 while `enabled` or while `file` exists | `enabled`, `file`, `retryAfter`, `allowIps`, `allowPaths`, `allowStaff`, `message` |
| `BodyLimit` | off | body over the cap → 413 | `maxBytes`, `paths: { '/upload': n }` |
| `Timeout` | off | no response in `ms` → 503 (streams are never cut) | `ms`, `exempt` |
| `AccessLog` | off | one log line per request (never the query string) | — |
| `Locale` | off | `Accept-Language` → `request.locale` | `languages`, `default` |
| `ServerTiming` | off | `Server-Timing` header, debug only | — |
| `BotGuard` | off | known scanner user agents → 403 (agent paths never) | `block` (RegExp) |

Your own middleware:

```ts
import { defineMiddleware } from 'tvine'

export const timing = defineMiddleware({
  name: 'Timing',
  async process(req, res, next) {
    req.tvine.onHeaders(() => res.setHeader('x-took', String(performance.now() - req.tvine.start)))
    await next()
  },
})
// or hooks: processRequest(req, res), processResponse(req, res), processException(req, res, err)
```

`req.tvine` has `path`, `ip`, `https`, `host`, `id`, `locale`, `log`.

Project middleware file (`config/middleware/example.ts`):

```ts
import { defineMiddleware } from 'tvine'

export default defineMiddleware({
  name: 'example',
  processRequest(req) { /* runs before the view; end the response to stop the request */ },
})
```

**Action middleware** wraps each backend action instead of each HTTP request: `settings.actionMiddleware` (global)
or `apps/<app>/middleware.ts` with `export default [...]` (that app only). It runs after permission checks, so it
cannot skip them. Use it for things like a "shop closed" switch.

## Logging

```ts
logging: 'json'          // or 'pretty' | 'none'. Default: pretty in dev, json in production
logging: {               // or a config object
  level: 'info',
  handlers: [
    { type: 'console' },
    { type: 'file', path: './log/app.log', level: 'warn', maxBytes: 10_000_000, daily: true, keep: 7 },
    { type: 'custom', level: 'error', write: (record) => sentry.capture(record) },
  ],
  loggers: { 'tvine.request': 'info', 'tvine.db': 'warn', myapp: 'debug', noisy: 'off' },
  redact: ['iban'],      // extra field names to blank
}
```

```ts
import { getLogger } from 'tvine'
const log = getLogger('myapp.orders')
log.info('order placed', { orderId, total })     // debug / info / warn / error
```

Passwords, tokens, cookies, keys and similar fields are replaced with `[redacted]` before any handler sees them.
Built-in loggers: `tvine` (runtime errors), `tvine.request`, `tvine.security` (logins, refused hosts, …),
`tvine.db` (queries slower than `db.slowQueryMs`, default 500 ms), `tvine.tasks` (the worker).

## Environment variables

Read typed values with `env`:

```ts
import { defineSettings, env } from 'tvine'

export default defineSettings({
  trustProxy: env.int('TVINE_TRUST_PROXY', 0),
  allowedHosts: env.list('ALLOWED_HOSTS', []),          // "a.com, .b.com" → ['a.com', '.b.com']
  socket: env.bool('SOCKET', true),                     // 1/0, true/false, yes/no, on/off
  email: { password: env.required('SMTP_PASSWORD') },  // unset → boot error naming the variable
})
```

Also `env.str`, `env.url`, `env.json`, `env.has`. An empty value counts as unset. The same readers have `get*`
names: `env.get(key, default?)` (string), `env.getInt`, `env.getBool`, `env.getList` (comma list, trimmed),
`env.getUrl`, `env.getJson`.

### Variables the framework reads

| Variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NODE_ENV` | `production` turns on the production rules. `tvine start` defaults to production |
| `TVINE_SECRET` | the secret (32+ chars); a comma list rotates keys, newest first |
| `TVINE_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | comma list of hosts |
| `DATABASE_URL` | `file:./x.db`, `postgres://…`, `mysql://…` |
| `REDIS_URL` | the default redis connection |
| `TVINE_SESSION_SECURE` | `1` / `0`: Secure `__Host-` session cookie (on in production) |
| `TVINE_DEBUG` | `1` = debug mode and CLI stack traces |
| `TVINE_LOAD_DOTENV` | `1`: load `.env` files in production too |
| `PORT`, `HOST` | listen port (3000) and address; `--port` / `--host` win |
| `TVINE_SUPERUSER_USERNAME` / `_EMAIL` / `_PASSWORD` | for `createsuperuser --noinput` |
| `TVINE_SETTINGS` | which settings module runs, e.g. `config/settings/prod` (same as `--settings`) |
| `TVINE_DEV_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | dev only: comma list of extra hosts (tunnels, port forwarding), on top of `dev.allowedHosts` |
| `TVINE_ENCRYPTION_KEYS` | comma list for `encryption.keys` (newest first) when settings leave it out |
| `WEB_CONCURRENCY` | `tvine start` workers: `n` or `auto` (CPU cores), default 1; `--workers` wins; more than 1 needs every backend on redis |
| `NODE_APP_INSTANCE`, `pm_id` | pm2 instances: boot warns that memory backends are per process |

Split mode (Next runs separately and calls a `tvine start --api-only` server): the Next process has no
settings, so it reads these instead.

| Variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `TVINE_API_URL` | the API server's URL; pages' `api.*` calls go there |
| `TVINE_SECRET` | must match the API server (it signs the forwarded call) |
| `TVINE_TRUST_PROXY` | `X-Forwarded-For` hops to trust for the caller's IP (default 0) |
| `TVINE_HEADER` | the API server's `settings.header` (default `x-tvine`) |
| `TVINE_COOKIE_NAME` | the API server's session cookie name |
| `TVINE_SESSION_SECURE`, `TVINE_SESSION_SAMESITE`, `TVINE_SESSION_TTL_S` | the session cookie's Secure flag, SameSite (`lax`) and max age in seconds (86400) |

### `.env` files

Loaded by every `tvine` command when present, first match wins per variable, and a variable already set in the
real environment is never overridden:

1. `.env.<NODE_ENV>.local`
2. `.env.local` (skipped under `NODE_ENV=test`)
3. `.env.<NODE_ENV>`
4. `.env`

`TVINE_ENV_FILES=.env.shared,.env.ci` (a real environment variable) adds files read after those four; a later
file beats an earlier one.

In production they load only with `TVINE_LOAD_DOTENV=1`.

### Loading .env files yourself

`loadEnv(files, { dir?, required? })` loads files in the order given, at the top of `config/settings/base.ts`
(before any `env.*` read):

```ts
import { loadEnv } from 'tvine'
loadEnv(['.env.shared', `.env.${process.env.TENANT}`])   // returns the files it loaded
```

The rules:

1. Files load in order; when two define the same key, **the later file wins**.
2. They also beat the automatic `.env` files above.
3. A variable set by the **real environment** is never overridden.
4. A missing file is skipped; with `required: true` it is a boot error naming the file.
5. Production: off unless `TVINE_LOAD_DOTENV=1` (same rule as the automatic files; `required` is not checked then).

Same syntax as the automatic files (Node's `.env` parser: `#` comments, quotes, `export KEY=`, multi-line quoted values).

## Your own settings

Any top-level key the framework does not know is kept as is: your app's own settings. Put them in
`config/settings/base.ts`, override them in `dev.ts` / `local.ts` (objects deep-merge, arrays replace):

```ts
export const base = {
  // ...framework keys...
  PAYMENT_PROVIDER: env.get('PAYMENT_PROVIDER', 'stripe'),
  shop: { currency: 'EUR', freeShippingOver: 50 },
} satisfies SettingsInput
```

Read them with `ctx.settings.shop` in an action, or anywhere at runtime with `settings()` (throws before boot):

```ts
import { settings } from 'tvine'
const { currency } = settings().shop
```

Type them once (anywhere in the project, e.g. `config/settings/types.ts`):

```ts
declare module 'tvine' {
  interface Settings { PAYMENT_PROVIDER: string; shop: { currency: string; freeShippingOver: number } }
}
```

Custom keys are not validated. Framework keys still are, and a custom key one or two letters away from a
framework key (any case) is reported at boot and by `tvine check`:
`settings: unknown key 'allowedHost' — did you mean 'allowedHosts'? (kept as a custom setting)`.

## Gotchas

- **Production refuses to boot** without a secret and allowed hosts. Running `tvine start` with neither prints
  the fix:
  ```bash
  pnpm exec tvine start --port 4610
  # tvine start: TVINE_SECRET must be a random string of at least 32 chars; ... (fix: export TVINE_SECRET=$(openssl rand -hex 32))
  ```
  A production-like local run that works:
  ```bash
  TVINE_SECRET=$(openssl rand -hex 32) TVINE_ALLOWED_HOSTS=localhost,127.0.0.1 TVINE_SESSION_SECURE=0 \
    pnpm exec tvine start --port 4610
  ```
- **MCP tool cap.** `mcp.maxTools` is 40. With `tvine.admin` installed you have more actions than that, so
  `tvine check` warns that typed tools were trimmed. Trimmed actions still work through the `do` tool. Raise
  `mcp.maxTools` or add ids to `mcp.exclude` if you want specific ones typed.
- **Pages must not read settings for runtime values.** Pages call the backend through `api.*`.
- A page that reads the session must be dynamic (`await connection()` or `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`).
- Memory backends are per process. `tvine start --workers n` (or `WEB_CONCURRENCY`) refuses to start more than one worker while any is `memory`; under pm2 boot warns. Use redis.

## Reference: every key

Every key `defineSettings` accepts, with its default. Unknown keys inside strict groups (`shield`, `email`, `metrics`,
`robots`, `encryption`, `auth`, each cache) are a boot error. Objects merge deeply; arrays and functions replace.

### Core

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `site.name` / `site.description` | `'tvine app'` / `''` | shown to agents (`/llms.txt`, MCP) and in the admin |
| `siteUrl` | unset (the request's Host) | public origin like `https://shop.example` for links the server builds (approve links, sitemap) |
| `secret` | dev: random per boot; prod: `TVINE_SECRET`, required | HMAC key, 32+ chars; an array rotates (newest first) |
| `debug` | on under `tvine dev` / `NODE_ENV=development` or `test` | dev CSP, inspector feed, `ServerTiming` |
| `installedApps` | `[]` | project apps by folder (`'blog'`) and built-ins `'tvine.auth'`, `'tvine.tasks'`, `'tvine.admin'`, `'tvine.audit'`, `'tvine.shield'` |
| `rootUrlconf` | `config/urls`, else `urls` | the root URL table, a path from the project root without extension |
| `tasksModule` | `config/tasks` | where `tvine worker` finds queues and `beatSchedule` |
| `allowedHosts` | dev: localhost, LAN IPs, hostname; prod: required | `'shop.example'`, `'.example.com'` (with subdomains), `'[::1]'`, `'*'` |
| `dev.allowedHosts` | `[]` | dev only, extra hosts such as `'*.ngrok-free.app'` |
| `trustProxy` | `0` | `X-Forwarded-For` hops to trust (drives `request.ip`, https detection) |
| `health.token` | unset | 16+ chars: `/tvine/health` gives details to `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; others get `{ ok }` ([deploy.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/deploy.md)) |
| `frontend.boundary` | `'error'` | a page importing a model fails `tvine check` (`'error'`) or warns (`'warn'`) |
| `encryption.keys` | `[]` (derived from `secret`) | AES-256-GCM keys for encrypted fields, 32+ chars each, newest first ([models-and-orm.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/models-and-orm.md)) |

### Agents and formats

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `header` | `'x-tvine'` | the agent request header name; `<header>-view`, `-expand`, `-offset`, `-limit`, `-sid` follow it |
| `formats.default` | `'json'` | what an agent request gets with no `Accept` choice: `'json'` or `'notation'` |
| `formats.notationPath` | `true` | serve `<page>/agent.txt` (the page in line notation); `<page>/agent.json` is always served |
| `mcp.tools` | `'both'` | `'both'` (six generic + typed), `'generic'`, `'typed'` ([agents-and-mcp.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/agents-and-mcp.md#which-tools-are-exposed)) |
| `mcp.exclude` | `[]` | globs on action ids kept out of typed tools (`'admin.**'`) |
| `mcp.maxTools` | `40` | typed tools above this are trimmed (still reachable through `do`) |
| `agent.shape` | `'v2'` | snapshot format; `'v1'` is the old one, kept for one release |
| `agent.budget` | `1500` | token budget for `view=auto` |
| `agent.rowsL1` | `10` | list rows shown at `view=L1` |
| `agent.inTab` | `'on'` | `'off'` disables tab control and in-tab WebMCP |
| `snapshotCache.ttlMs` / `backend` / `redis` | `60000` / `'memory'` / `'default'` | shared agent snapshots of public, non-live pages; `0` = off; any write clears it |
| `guards` | `[]` | `[{ path: '/admin/**', permissions: [...] }]`: permission checks on page paths for HTTP, MCP and forms |
| `robots.allow` / `disallow` / `extra` / `sitemap` | `[]` / `[]` / `[]` / unset | the generated `/robots.txt` (only when the app ships none) |
| `socket` | `true` | accepted; not read by the current release |
| `data.defaultPageSize` / `maxPageSize` | `25` / `100` | accepted; generic views use their own `pageSize` / `maxPageSize` (25 / 100) |

### Requests and limits

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `limits.bodyBytes` | `65536` | max request body (64 KB) |
| `limits.handlerMs` | `10000` | max time per action |
| `limits.rate.limit` / `windowMs` / `by` | `60` / `60000` / `'framework'` | action calls per IP + session per window; `by: 'shield'` lets Shield's rules be the only general limit ([shield.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/shield.md#rate-limits-shield-and-the-framework)) |
| `limits.sseConnPerIp` | `20` | open event streams per IP |
| `limits.backend` / `redis` | `'memory'` / `'default'` | where rate limits, idempotency and login throttles live |
| `middleware` | RequestId, AllowedHosts, Security, Cors, GZip | HTTP middleware (see [Middleware](#middleware)) |
| `actionMiddleware` | `[]` | functions around every action |
| `media.dir` / `route` / `auditAccess` | `'./media'` / `'/media'` / unset | uploads; `auditAccess: true` writes an audit row per private-file read |

### Database, sessions, backends

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `db.url` | `DATABASE_URL`, else `file:./tvine.db` | `file:`, `postgres://`, `mysql://` |
| `db.pool.max` / `acquireMs` / `idleMs` | `10` / `5000` / `30000` | connection pool (Postgres / MySQL) |
| `db.atomicRequests` | `true` | each non-read-only action is one transaction |
| `db.slowQueryMs` | `500` | slower statements are logged on `tvine.db`; `0` = off |
| `session.ttlMs` / `maxAgeMs` | 24 h / 14 days | idle timeout / absolute lifetime (`0` = none) |
| `session.cookieName` | `'tvine_s'` | gets the `__Host-` prefix when `secure` |
| `session.secure` | on in production (`TVINE_SESSION_SECURE`) | the cookie's Secure flag |
| `session.sameSite` | `'lax'` | `'none'` needs `secure` |
| `session.max` | `100000` | live sessions kept; the least recently used is dropped past it |
| `session.backend` / `redis` | `'memory'` / `'default'` | session store |
| `channels.backend` / `redis` | `'memory'` / `'default'` | pub/sub for live updates across processes |
| `redis.<alias>.url` / `tls` / `prefix` / `connectTimeoutMs` | `default` from `REDIS_URL` | named Redis connections; every `redis:` key above names one ([deploy.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/deploy.md)) |
| `caches.<alias>` | `default`: memory, timeout 300 s | `backend` (`memory`, `redis`, `file`, `dummy`), `redis`, `location` (file dir), `timeout` (s, `null` = forever), `keyPrefix`, `version`, `maxEntries` (300) ([tasks-cache-email.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/tasks-cache-email.md)) |
| `tasks.broker` | `'file'` | job store: `'db'`, `'file'`, `'memory'`, `'redis'` |
| `tasks.leaseMs` / `pollMs` / `relayMs` / `graceMs` | `30000` / `500` / `250` / `30000` | lease, claim poll, progress relay poll, SIGTERM grace |
| `tasks.resultTtlMs` | 24 h | how long finished job rows are kept |
| `tasks.file` / `durable` / `claimBatch` / `redis` | `'./tasks.db'` / `false` / `10` / `'default'` | file broker path, power-cut durability, jobs per claim, Redis alias |

### Security

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `security.headers.enabled` | `true` | the `Security` middleware sends headers |
| `security.headers.hsts` | 1 year, subdomains, no preload | `false` turns it off; sent on https only |
| `security.headers.csp` | `{ reportOnly: false, directives: {}, reportUri: '/tvine/csp-report', staticPages: 'relaxed' }` | CSP with nonce; `directives` add sources; `false` turns it off |
| `security.headers.referrerPolicy` | `'strict-origin-when-cross-origin'` | `Referrer-Policy` |
| `security.headers.coop` / `corp` | `'same-origin'` / `'same-origin'` | `false` turns either off |
| `security.headers.coep` | unset | `'require-corp'` or `'credentialless'` |
| `security.headers.trustedTypes` | unset | `'report-only'` reports Trusted Types violations |
| `security.headers.permissionsPolicy` | camera, microphone, geolocation, payment, usb, display-capture, browsing-topics, clipboard-read: all off | `Permissions-Policy` |
| `cors.origins` / `methods` / `credentials` / `maxAge` | `[]` / GET, POST / `false` / `600` | closed by default |
| `cors.allowHeaders` | content-type, authorization, the `x-tvine*` headers, MCP headers | headers a cross-origin caller may send |
| `cors.exposeHeaders` | x-request-id, etag, retry-after, mcp-session-id | headers it may read |
| `cors.routes` | `[]` | per-path overrides: `[{ path: '/api/', origins: [...] }]` |
| `compression.enabled` / `threshold` / `brotli` / `gzipLevel` / `brotliQuality` | `true` / `1024` / `true` / `6` / `4` | response compression |
| `audit.enabled` / `actions` / `retentionDays` / `redact` | `false` / `'writes'` / `90` / `[]` | needs `'tvine.audit'` installed ([auth-and-security.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/auth-and-security.md)) |
| `metrics.enabled` / `path` / `token` / `allowIps` | `false` / `'/tvine/metrics'` / unset / `[]` | Prometheus text; neither token nor IPs = loopback only |
| `shield.*` | `mode: 'log'` | bot protection (needs `'tvine.shield'` installed and `tvine.middleware.Shield` listed); every key in [shield.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/shield.md#settings-reference). Also `shield.prefix` (`'/tvine/shield'`, challenge routes), `shield.ipdb.source` / `update` (`'dbip-lite'` / `'monthly'`), `shield.sensor` (`'challenge'`, or `'all-pages'`), `shield.events.maxPerMinute` (600) / `hardCapPerMinute` (20000) |

### Auth (`tvine.auth`)

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `auth.userModel` | `'auth.User'` | the user model; set before the first migrate |
| `auth.backends` | `['tvine.auth.ModelBackend']` | tried in order; also `'tvine.auth.EmailBackend'` or a dotted path |
| `auth.user` | unset | your own `(req) => user \| null` resolver; overrides everything |
| `auth.hashers` / `validators` | built-in | password hashers (first = preferred) and validators |
| `auth.login.maxFailures` / `accountMaxFailures` / `ipMaxFailures` / `windowMs` / `lockoutMs` | `5` / `50` / `100` / 15 min / 15 min | login throttling |
| `auth.resetTimeoutMs` / `resetUrl` / `sendPasswordReset` | 1 h / built-in / built-in | password reset |
| `auth.objectPermission` | unset | `(user, perm, obj) => boolean` for object permissions |
| `auth.tokens.defaultDays` / `maxDays` | `90` / `365` | API token lifetime |
| `auth.totp.issuer` | `site.name` | name shown in authenticator apps |
| `auth.breachCheck` | `false` | check new passwords against Have I Been Pwned |
| `auth.notify.newLogin` / `passwordChanged` / `twoFactorDisabled` / `tokenCreated` / `emailChanged` | on when mail is set up | security mails |

### Admin, email, logging

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `admin.path` / `title` | `'/admin'` / `'Administration'` | where the panel mounts ([admin.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/admin.md)) |
| `admin.theme.brand` / `radius` / `dark` | unset / unset / `'auto'` | colors; `dark`: `'auto'`, `'on'`, `'off'` |
| `admin.allowIps` / `require2fa` / `idleMs` | unset | staff IP allow-list (adds an `IpFilter`), TOTP for staff, staff idle timeout |
| `admin.dashboard.widgets` / `autoCharts` | `[]` / `true` | widget order; automatic per-model charts |
| `admin.stats.enabled` / `retentionDays` / `flushMs` | `true` / `30` / `60000` | the System pages' rollups |
| `admin.stats.searches.enabled` / `minCount` | `true` / `3` | search terms shown once seen this often |
| `admin.stats.pages.enabled` / `keepParams` | `true` / `[]` | page stats; query params kept in the path |
| `email.backend` | console (dev), memory (tests), smtp (prod) | also `'file'`, `'dummy'` ([tasks-cache-email.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/tasks-cache-email.md)) |
| `email.host` / `port` / `user` / `password` / `useTls` / `useSsl` / `allowPlainAuth` / `timeoutMs` | `localhost` / `25` / `''` / `''` / `false` / `false` / `false` / `10000` | SMTP |
| `email.defaultFrom` / `serverEmail` / `admins` / `subjectPrefix` / `filePath` | `webmaster@localhost` / `root@localhost` / `[]` / `'[Tvine] '` / `'./mail'` | sender addresses, admin list, subject prefix, file backend folder |
| `logging` | pretty (dev), json (prod) | string or `{ level, format, handlers, loggers, redact }`; handler types `console` (`stream`), `file` (`path`, `maxBytes`, `daily`, `keep`), `custom` (`write`), `memory` (`size`) |


# docs/models-and-orm.md

# Models and the ORM

Tvine has its own ORM: models in `apps/<app>/models.ts`, `Model.objects` querysets,
migration files you commit. It runs on SQLite (default), Postgres and MySQL/MariaDB with the same code.

## Setup

Nothing for development: the database is `./tvine.db`. For another engine, set the URL:

| URL | Engine | Driver to install in your app |
|---|---|---|
| `file:./tvine.db`, `:memory:` | SQLite | none (built into Node) |
| `postgres://user:pass@host/db` | Postgres | `pg` |
| `mysql://user:pass@host/db`, `mariadb://…` | MySQL / MariaDB | `mysql2` |

Set it as `DATABASE_URL` or `settings.db.url`. Pool settings: `settings.db.pool` (`{ max, acquireMs, idleMs }`); production notes in
[deploy.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/deploy.md).

## A model

```ts
// apps/notes/models.ts
import { defineModel, field, type Infer } from 'tvine'

export const Note = defineModel('note', {
  id: field.id(),
  title: field.text({ searchable: true }),
  body: field.text({ default: '' }),
  pinned: field.bool({ default: false }),
  words: field.int({ default: 0 }),
})
export type Note = Infer<typeof Note>
```

```bash
pnpm exec tvine makemigrations     # → apps/notes/migrations/0001_initial.ts
pnpm exec tvine migrate            # → applied notes.0001_initial
```

## Field types

| `field.` | JS value |
|---|---|
| `id()` | number |
| `uuid()` | string |
| `text()` | string |
| `int()`, `float()` | number |
| `bool()` | boolean |
| `decimal({ maxDigits, decimalPlaces })` | string `'12.50'` |
| `money()` | `{ value, currency }`, major units, stored as integer cents |
| `percent()` | number 0–100 |
| `datetime({ auto })` | `Date` |
| `date({ autoNow, autoNowAdd })`, `time()` | `'YYYY-MM-DD'`, `'HH:MM:SS'` |
| `duration()` | milliseconds |
| `dateRange()` | `{ start, end }` |
| `email()`, `url()`, `slug()` | validated string |
| `phone()`, `color()`, `country()`, `ip()` | E.164, `#rrggbb`, ISO code, IPv4/IPv6 |
| `json()` | any JSON |
| `tags({ maxItems, choices })` | `string[]` |
| `address()` | `{ line1, line2?, city, region?, postal?, country }` |
| `markdown()`, `code({ language })` | string |
| `richText({ allowRemoteImages })` | HTML, sanitized on every save |
| `file({ uploadTo })`, `image({ uploadTo })` | storage key |
| `signature()` | a drawn signature, stored as an image |
| `encryptedText()`, `encryptedJson()`, `encrypted({ of, deterministic, context })` | encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) |
| `enum(['a', 'b'] as const)` | one of the values |
| `fk(() => Model, { onDelete, relatedName })` | the row gets `<name>Id` |
| `m2m(() => Model, { through, relatedName })` | no column; `Model.related('field', id)` |

### Options every field takes

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `optional` | nullable; may be left out on create |
| `default` | default value |
| `unique`, `index` | unique / indexed column |
| `searchable` | used by `?q=` search in generic views and the admin |
| `hidden` | left out of generic views' output |
| `readOnly` / `writeOnly` | never accepted as input / never output |
| `humanOnly` | writes marked as coming from an agent are refused (`human_only`) |

`fk` `onDelete`: `CASCADE`, `PROTECT`, `SET_NULL` (needs `optional`), `SET_DEFAULT` (needs `default`),
`RESTRICT` (default), `DO_NOTHING`.

### Encrypted fields

```ts
defineModel('patient', {
  id: field.id(),
  ssn: field.encryptedText({ deterministic: true }),   // filter({ ssn }) works, exact match only
  notes: field.encryptedJson({ optional: true }),      // not filterable
}, { personalData: ['ssn', 'notes'], onErase: 'anonymize' })
```

Keys come from `settings.encryption.keys` / `TVINE_ENCRYPTION_KEYS` (default: derived from the secret).
After adding a key, rewrite old rows: `pnpm exec tvine encryption rotate`.
Key handling: [auth-and-security.md](https://github.com/zohaib3249/tvine/blob/main/docs/auth-and-security.md).

### Meta

**The user.** Point an fk at the configured user model, never at `User` directly: `owner: field.fk(getUserModel)`
(from `tvine/auth`). It follows `settings.auth.userModel`
(see auth-and-security.md, "Custom user model").

The third argument to `defineModel`:

```ts
defineModel('product', { /* fields */ }, {
  indexes: [['category', 'price'], { fields: ['name'], name: 'product_name_lookup' }],
  unique: [['vendor', 'sku']],                    // unique_together
  constraints: [CheckConstraint({ name: 'price_gte_0', check: Q({ price__gte: 0 }) })],
  ordering: ['-createdAt'],
  personalData: ['email'],                        // collected by "export my data"
```
