```ts
  if (order.customer !== ctx.request.user.id) throw new DomainError('forbidden', 'not your order')   // 403
}
```

## Gotchas

- Only `invalid_param`, `internal` and `human_only` keep their own code; every other `DomainError` code becomes
  `domain` with your code in `reason`. Switch on `reason`, not `code`, for business errors.
- An uncaught error's message is never sent to the caller; look in the `tvine` log.
- After a commit nothing is reported as a failure (a failing middleware or hook after commit is only logged), so
  a retry with the same `cmdId` gets the stored result.
- `unknown_action` is 404 on `/tvine/api` but 400 on the agent page transport.
- `rate_limited` on `/tvine/api` has no `Retry-After` header; read `retryAfterMs`.
- A redirect to another host is refused (`forbidden`), even from your own handler.

## See also

[actions.md](./actions.md) · [request.md](./request.md) · [views.md](./views.md) · [urls.md](./urls.md) ·
[middleware.md](./middleware.md) · [overview.md](./overview.md)


# docs/reference/warp/settings.md

# Settings

Settings are one object built with `defineSettings({...})`, validated by a zod schema at
boot, with a default for every key you leave out. Objects merge deeply over the defaults; arrays, functions and
plain values replace. Which file is loaded is chosen by `TVINE_SETTINGS` or
the `config/settings/{base,dev,prod,local}.ts` layout. A handful of environment variables feed keys directly.
Actions read the result as `ctx.settings`.

**Import:** `import { defineSettings, env, type SettingsInput, type Settings } from 'tvine'`

## Signature

```ts
function defineSettings(input: SettingsInput & { secret?: string | string[] }): Settings
```

`SettingsInput` is a deep-partial `Settings`. Unknown keys inside strict groups (`health`, `redis.<alias>`,
`shield` and its sub-objects, `email`, `metrics`, `robots`, `encryption`, `auth`, `caches.<alias>`, and the
`logging` object form) are a boot error; elsewhere they are ignored by zod. Every named cache is completed from the
cache defaults.

## Which file is loaded

| Situation | Files merged (in order) |
|---|---|
| `TVINE_SETTINGS=config/settings/prod` (or `tvine --settings …`) | that module only (path from cwd, no extension; `.ts`/`.js`/`.mjs`) |
| `config/settings/` exists, `NODE_ENV=production` | `config/settings/prod` |
| `config/settings/` exists, otherwise | `config/settings/dev`, then `config/settings/local` if present (git-ignored) |
| no `config/settings/` | `./settings` (or none) |

Each file's default export is merged over the previous one, then `createAgentServer({ settings })` overrides on
top. `base.ts` is a convention: `dev.ts` / `prod.ts` import it and spread it (`defineSettings({ ...base, debug: true })`).
`.env` files load before settings are read (below).

## Environment variables that feed settings

| Variable | Feeds | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `TVINE_SECRET` | `secret` | Used when `secret` is not given. Comma list = rotation, newest first. Each ≥ 32 chars, no duplicates. Missing in production → boot fails (at server start, not at import). Dev without it: a random key per boot. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | `db.url` | When `db.url` is not given. Set but blank → error. Default `file:./tvine.db`. |
| `REDIS_URL` | `redis.default.url` | When `redis` is not given. Set but blank → error. |
| `TVINE_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | `allowedHosts` | Comma list, when `allowedHosts` is not given. |
| `TVINE_DEV_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | extra dev hosts | Added by `AllowedHosts` in debug, never in production. |
| `TVINE_DEBUG` | `debug` | When `debug` is not given. Ignored in production if it came from a `.env` file. Unset: `debug` is on for `NODE_ENV` `development` or `test`. |
| `TVINE_SESSION_SECURE` | `session.secure` default | Default: on when `NODE_ENV=production`. |
| `TVINE_ENCRYPTION_KEYS` | `encryption.keys` | Comma list, when `encryption.keys` is not given. |
| `NODE_ENV` | many defaults | `production`: secure cookie, json logging, smtp mail, required secret + hosts, `.env` skipped. `test` / `VITEST`: memory mail. `tvine start` defaults it to `production`. |
| `TVINE_SETTINGS` | which file | See above. |
| `TVINE_LOAD_DOTENV` | `.env` in production | `1` loads `.env` files in production too. |
| `PORT`, `HOST` | listen address (CLI) | Default 3000; `--port` / `--host` win. |
| `TVINE_SUPERUSER_USERNAME` / `_EMAIL` / `_PASSWORD` | `createsuperuser --noinput` | CLI only. |
| `WEB_CONCURRENCY` | `tvine start` worker count | `n` or `auto` (= CPU cores), default 1; `--workers` wins. More than 1 refuses to start while a backend is `memory` and pings Redis first ([deploy.md](../../deploy.md#scaling)). |
| `NODE_APP_INSTANCE`, `pm_id` | — | pm2 instances: boot warns that `memory` backends are per process. |

Two-server mode (a Next server calling a `tvine start --api-only` server) has no settings in the Next process;
it reads `TVINE_API_URL`, `TVINE_SECRET`, `TVINE_TRUST_PROXY`, `TVINE_HEADER`, `TVINE_COOKIE_NAME`,
`TVINE_SESSION_SECURE`, `TVINE_SESSION_SAMESITE`, `TVINE_SESSION_TTL_S` (default 86400).

### `.env` files

Loaded by every `tvine` command, first match per variable wins, never over a variable already set:
`.env.<NODE_ENV>.local`, `.env.local` (skipped under `NODE_ENV=test`), `.env.<NODE_ENV>`, `.env`. Not in
production unless `TVINE_LOAD_DOTENV=1`. `TVINE_ENV_FILES=a,b` (real env) adds files read after those, later wins.

`loadEnv(files, { dir?, required? })`: loads `files` in order (call it at the top of `config/settings/base.ts`).
Later file wins, and beats the automatic files; the real environment always wins; missing files are skipped
(`required: true`: error naming the file); production: off unless `TVINE_LOAD_DOTENV=1`. Returns the files loaded.

### `env` helpers

`env.str(name, d?)`, `env.int`, `env.bool` (`1/0`, `true/false`, `yes/no`, `on/off`), `env.list` (comma list),
`env.url`, `env.json`, `env.required(name)`, `env.has(name)`. An empty value counts as unset; a missing one without
a default throws naming the variable. Aliases: `env.get`, `env.getInt`, `env.getBool`, `env.getList`, `env.getUrl`,
`env.getJson`.

### Your own settings

Unknown top-level keys are kept unvalidated (`PAYMENT_PROVIDER: 'stripe'`, `shop: {...}`) and merge through
base → dev → local. Read: `ctx.settings.shop`, or `settings()` from `'tvine'` anywhere after boot (throws before).
Type: `declare module 'tvine' { interface Settings { shop: { currency: string } } }`. A key within two edits of a
framework key (any case) warns at boot and in `tvine check` ("did you mean 'allowedHosts'?").

## Every key

### Site and apps

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `site.name` | `string` | `'tvine app'` | Shown to agents (`/llms.txt`, MCP server name) and in the admin. |
| `site.description` | `string` | `''` | Same. |
| `siteUrl` | `string?` | unset (the request's Host) | Public origin `https://shop.example` for links the server builds. |
| `installedApps` | `string[]` | `[]` | Project apps `'catalog'` (`apps/catalog/`) and built-ins `'tvine.auth'`, `'tvine.tasks'`, `'tvine.admin'`, `'tvine.audit'`, `'tvine.shield'`. |
| `rootUrlconf` | `string?` | `config/urls`, else `urls` | Root `urls.ts`; must exist when set. |
| `tasksModule` | `string?` | `config/tasks` | Queues / `beatSchedule` for `tvine worker`. |
| `secret` | `string \| string[]` | see `TVINE_SECRET` | HMAC key (binds, forwards, confirm tokens, signing); array = rotation. |
| `debug` | `boolean` | see `TVINE_DEBUG` | Debug mode: dev CSP, inspector feed, `ServerTiming`, dev hosts, helpful 400s. |
| `frontend.boundary` | `'error' \| 'warn'` | `'error'` | A page importing a model fails `tvine check`, or warns. |
| `encryption.keys` | `string[]` | `[]` (derived from `secret`) | AES-256-GCM keys for encrypted fields, newest first, each ≥ 32 chars, unique. |

### Hosts, proxy, HTTP

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `allowedHosts` | `string[]` | dev: `['localhost', '.localhost', '127.0.0.1', '[::1]']`; production: required | `'shop.example'`, `'.example.com'` (with subdomains), `'[::1]'`, `'*'`. Empty in production with `AllowedHosts` on → boot error. |
| `dev.allowedHosts` | `string[]` | `[]` | Debug only, on top: `'*.ngrok-free.app'`, `'*.devtunnels.ms'`. |
| `trustProxy` | `number` | `0` | Trusted proxy hops for `X-Forwarded-For` / `-Host` / `-Proto` (drives `request.ip`, https, host). |
| `middleware` | `unknown[]` | `RequestId, AllowedHosts, Security, Cors, GZip` | HTTP middleware; see [middleware.md](./middleware.md). |
| `actionMiddleware` | `Middleware[]` | `[]` | Around every action. |
| `guards` | `{ path, permissions }[]` | `[]` | Permission checks by page path for HTTP, MCP, forms and API calls (by calling page). Glob: `*` one segment, `**` any depth (`/admin/**` covers `/admin`). Denied → `forbidden`. |
| `health.token` | `string?` (≥ 16) | unset | `/tvine/health` details for `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; others get `{ ok }`. |
| `header` | `string` | `'x-tvine'` | The agent request header. |
| `formats.default` | `'json' \| 'notation'` | `'json'` | Agent reply format when `Accept` does not choose. |
| `formats.notationPath` | `boolean` | `true` | Serve `<page>/agent.txt`; `<page>/agent.json` is always served. |
| `socket` | `boolean` | `true` | Accepted; not read in this release. |

### Limits

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limits.bodyBytes` | `number` | `65536` | Max JSON body (and multipart text fields). |
| `limits.handlerMs` | `number` | `10000` | Max time per action handler (and per middleware chain). |
| `limits.rate.limit` | `number` | `60` | Action calls per window per IP + session; also every action's default own rate. |
| `limits.rate.windowMs` | `number` | `60000` | Window. |
| `limits.rate.by` | `'framework' \| 'shield'` | `'framework'` | `'shield'`: requests Shield rate-checked skip the general bucket (needs `tvine.middleware.Shield`). |
| `limits.sseConnPerIp` | `number` | `20` | Open `/tvine/channel` streams per IP. |
| `limits.backend` / `limits.redis` | `'memory' \| 'redis'` / alias | `'memory'` / `'default'` | Rate limits, idempotency, login throttle, tab agent marks. |

### Agents and MCP

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mcp.tools` | `'both' \| 'generic' \| 'typed'` | `'both'` | Generic tools (`read_page`, `expand`, `ui`, `do`, `request_control`, `release`) and/or one typed tool per action. |
| `mcp.exclude` | `string[]` | `[]` | Action-id globs disabled over MCP (`'admin.**'`). A pattern matching nothing logs a warning. |
| `mcp.maxTools` | `number` | `40` | Typed tools above this are trimmed to `priority` actions (rest via `do`); not in `'typed'` mode. |
| `agent.shape` | `'v1' \| 'v2'` | `'v2'` | Snapshot format. |
| `agent.budget` | `number` | `1500` | Token budget for `view=auto`. |
| `agent.rowsL1` | `number` | `10` | List rows at `view=L1`. |
| `agent.inTab` | `'on' \| 'off'` | `'on'` | Agents may control a human's tab. |
| `snapshotCache.ttlMs` | `number` | `60000` | Shared snapshots of non-personal pages; `0` = off; any write clears it. |
| `snapshotCache.backend` / `.redis` | | `'memory'` / `'default'` | |
| `robots.allow` / `disallow` / `extra` | `string[]` | `[]` | Generated `/robots.txt` (only when the app ships none). |
| `robots.sitemap` | `string?` | unset (`/sitemap.xml` if the app has one) | Absolute URL. |

### Database

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `db.url` | `string` | `DATABASE_URL`, else `'file:./tvine.db'` | `file:`, `postgres://`, `mysql://`; relative to cwd. |
| `db.pool.max` / `acquireMs` / `idleMs` | `number` | `10` / `5000` / `30000` | Pool. |
| `db.atomicRequests` | `boolean` | `true` | Each non-`readOnly` action is one transaction (opt out per action: `rules.atomic: false`). |
| `db.slowQueryMs` | `number` | `500` | Slower statements logged on `tvine.db`; `0` = off. |
| `data.defaultPageSize` / `maxPageSize` | `number` | `25` / `100` | Accepted; not read in this release (views use their own `pageSize` / `maxPageSize`). |

### Sessions, channels, Redis

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session.ttlMs` | `number` | `86400000` (24 h) | Idle timeout; also the cookie `Max-Age`. |
| `session.maxAgeMs` | `number` | `1209600000` (14 days) | Absolute lifetime; `0` = none. |
| `session.cookieName` | `string` | `'tvine_s'` | `__Host-` is prepended when `secure` (unless the name starts with `__`). |
| `session.secure` | `boolean` | production: `true` (`TVINE_SESSION_SECURE`) | Cookie `Secure`. |
| `session.sameSite` | `'lax' \| 'strict' \| 'none'` | `'lax'` | `'none'` needs `secure`. |
| `session.max` | `number` | `100000` | Live sessions per process (LRU). |
| `session.backend` / `.redis` | | `'memory'` / `'default'` | |
| `channels.backend` / `.redis` | | `'memory'` / `'default'` | Pub/sub fan-out and `Last-Event-ID` replay. |
| `redis.<alias>.url` | `string` | `default` from `REDIS_URL` | `redis://` or `rediss://`. |
| `redis.<alias>.tls` / `prefix` / `connectTimeoutMs` | | unset | TLS, key prefix (≤ 64, no spaces / globs), connect timeout. |

A `'redis'` backend whose alias is not configured fails at boot, naming the key.

### Media, caches, email, tasks

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `media.dir` / `route` | `string` | `'./media'` / `'/media'` | Upload storage and URL prefix. |
| `media.auditAccess` | `boolean?` | unset | Audit row per private-file read. |
| `caches.<alias>.backend` | `'memory' \| 'redis' \| 'file' \| 'dummy'` | `default`: `'memory'` | |
| `caches.<alias>.timeout` | `number \| null` (s) | `300` | `null` = forever. |
| `caches.<alias>.keyPrefix` / `version` / `maxEntries` | | `''` / `1` / `300` | |
| `caches.<alias>.redis` / `location` | | `'default'` / unset | `location` required for `'file'`. |
| `email.backend` | `'console' \| 'smtp' \| 'file' \| 'memory' \| 'dummy'` | dev `'console'`, tests `'memory'`, production `'smtp'` | |
| `email.host` / `port` / `user` / `password` | | `'localhost'` / `25` / `''` / `''` | SMTP. |
| `email.useTls` / `useSsl` / `allowPlainAuth` / `timeoutMs` | | `false` / `false` / `false` / `10000` | `useTls` and `useSsl` exclusive. |
| `email.defaultFrom` / `serverEmail` / `admins` / `subjectPrefix` / `filePath` | | `'webmaster@localhost'` / `'root@localhost'` / `[]` / `'[Tvine] '` / `'./mail'` | |
| `tasks.broker` | `'db' \| 'file' \| 'memory' \| 'redis'` | unset (`'file'`) | Job store. |
| `tasks.leaseMs` / `pollMs` / `relayMs` / `graceMs` / `resultTtlMs` | `number` | `30000` / `500` / `250` / `30000` / `86400000` | |
| `tasks.file` / `durable` / `claimBatch` / `redis` | | `'./tasks.db'` / `false` / `10` / `'default'` | |

### Security

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `security.headers.enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | |
| `security.headers.hsts` | `false \| { maxAge, includeSubDomains, preload }` | `{ 31536000, true, false }` | https only; `preload` needs maxAge ≥ 1 year and subdomains. |
| `security.headers.csp` | `false \| { reportOnly, directives, reportUri, staticPages }` | `{ false, {}, '/tvine/csp-report', 'relaxed' }` | `directives` add over built-ins (`false` drops one). |
| `security.headers.referrerPolicy` | enum | `'strict-origin-when-cross-origin'` | |
| `security.headers.coop` / `corp` | enum or `false` | `'same-origin'` / `'same-origin'` | |
| `security.headers.coep` | `false \| 'require-corp' \| 'credentialless'` | unset | |
| `security.headers.trustedTypes` | `false \| 'report-only'` | unset | |
| `security.headers.permissionsPolicy` | `Record<feature, string[] \| false>` | camera, microphone, geolocation, payment, usb, display-capture, browsing-topics, clipboard-read: `[]` | |
| `cors.origins` | `(string \| RegExp)[]` | `[]` (closed) | Exact origin, `'*'` (not with credentials), anchored RegExp. |
| `cors.methods` | `string[]` | `['GET', 'POST']` | |
| `cors.allowHeaders` | `string[]` | content-type, authorization, x-tvine, x-tvine-sid, x-tvine-view, x-tvine-expand, x-tvine-offset, x-tvine-limit, mcp-protocol-version, mcp-session-id, last-event-id | |
| `cors.exposeHeaders` | `string[]` | x-request-id, etag, retry-after, mcp-session-id | |
| `cors.credentials` / `maxAge` | | `false` / `600` | |
| `cors.routes` | `({ path } & Partial<policy>)[]` | `[]` | Per-path overrides. |
| `compression.enabled` / `threshold` / `brotli` / `gzipLevel` / `brotliQuality` | | `true` / `1024` / `true` / `6` / `4` | |
| `audit.enabled` / `actions` / `retentionDays` / `redact` | | `false` / `'writes'` / `90` / `[]` | Needs `'tvine.audit'` installed. |
| `metrics.enabled` / `path` / `token` / `allowIps` | | `false` / `'/tvine/metrics'` / unset / `[]` | Neither token nor IPs = loopback only. |
| `shield.*` | object | `mode: 'log'`, `prefix: '/tvine/shield'`, `clearance.ttl: '30m'`, … | Bot protection; needs `'tvine.shield'` and the `Shield` middleware. Full list in the Shield docs. |

### Admin, logging, auth

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `admin.path` | `string` | `'/admin'` | |
| `admin.title` | `string?` | unset (the admin site's title) | |
| `admin.theme` | `{ brand?, radius?, dark }` | `{ dark: 'auto' }` | |
| `admin.allowIps` / `require2fa` / `idleMs` | | unset | IP allow-list (adds an `IpFilter`), TOTP for staff, staff idle timeout. |
| `admin.dashboard` | `{ widgets, autoCharts }` | `{ [], true }` | |
| `admin.stats` | object | `{ enabled: true, retentionDays: 30, flushMs: 60000, searches: { enabled: true, minCount: 3 }, pages: { enabled: true, keepParams: [] } }` | |
| `logging` | `'json' \| 'pretty' \| 'none' \| { level, format, handlers, loggers, redact }` | dev `'pretty'`, production `'json'` | Handler types `console`, `file`, `custom`, `memory`. |
| `auth.user` | `(req) => Promise<TvineUser \| null>` | unset | BYO resolver, overrides everything. |
| `auth.userModel` | `'app.Model'` | `'auth.User'` | |
| `auth.backends` | `unknown[]` | `['tvine.auth.ModelBackend']` | |
| `auth.hashers` / `validators` | | built-in | |
| `auth.login` | `{ maxFailures, accountMaxFailures, ipMaxFailures, windowMs, lockoutMs }` | `5` / `50` / `100` / 15 min / 15 min | |
| `auth.resetTimeoutMs` / `resetUrl` / `sendPasswordReset` | | 1 h / built-in / built-in | |
| `auth.objectPermission` | function | unset | |
| `auth.tokens` | `{ defaultDays, maxDays }` | `90` / `365` | |
| `auth.totp.issuer` / `breachCheck` / `notify.*` | | — / `false` / on when mail is configured | See [contrib/auth.md](./contrib/auth.md). |

## Cross-key checks (boot errors)

| Check | Message gist |
|---|---|
| `audit.enabled` without `'tvine.audit'` in `installedApps` | needs `tvine.audit` |
| `tvine.middleware.Shield` listed without `'tvine.shield'` installed | needs `tvine.shield` |
| `limits.rate.by: 'shield'` without the Shield middleware | needs `tvine.middleware.Shield` |
| `session.sameSite: 'none'` without `session.secure` | needs secure |
| `email.useTls` and `email.useSsl` both on | mutually exclusive |
| a `'file'` cache without `location` | needs location |
| a `'redis'` backend whose `redis` alias is missing | names the key |
| production, `AllowedHosts` on, `allowedHosts` empty | list your domains |

`tvine check` also warns when Shield's rules and `limits.rate` are both general rate limits.

## Examples

### 1. Layout: base + dev + prod

```ts
// config/settings/base.ts
import type { SettingsInput } from 'tvine'
export const base = {
  site: { name: 'Hat Shop', description: 'Hats, scarves and gloves.' },
  installedApps: ['tvine.auth', 'tvine.tasks', 'tvine.admin', 'catalog', 'cart', 'orders'],
  mcp: { exclude: ['admin.**'] },
} satisfies SettingsInput

// config/settings/dev.ts
import { defineSettings } from 'tvine'
import { base } from './base.ts'
export default defineSettings({ ...base, debug: true, dev: { allowedHosts: ['*.ngrok-free.app'] } })

// config/settings/prod.ts
import { defineSettings, env } from 'tvine'
import { base } from './base.ts'
export default defineSettings({
  ...base,
  trustProxy: 1,
  session: { backend: 'redis' }, limits: { backend: 'redis' }, channels: { backend: 'redis' },
  middleware: ['tvine.middleware.RequestId', 'tvine.middleware.AllowedHosts', 'tvine.middleware.Security',
    'tvine.middleware.Cors', 'tvine.middleware.GZip', 'tvine.middleware.SslRedirect'],   // arrays replace: list all
  email: { host: env.str('SMTP_HOST'), password: env.required('SMTP_PASSWORD') },
})
```

### 2. Run with a specific module

```bash
TVINE_SETTINGS=config/settings/prod TVINE_SECRET=$(openssl rand -hex 32) \
  TVINE_ALLOWED_HOSTS=shop.example.com DATABASE_URL=postgres://… REDIS_URL=redis://… pnpm exec tvine start
```

### 3. Reading settings in an action

```ts
export const shopInfo = defineAction('shopInfo', z.object({}),
  async (_p, ctx) => ({ name: ctx.settings.site.name, pageSize: 24 }), { readOnly: true })
```

## Gotchas

- Arrays replace, they do not merge: setting `middleware` drops the defaults you do not list again.
- `secret` problems surface at server start (`loadSettings`), not when `settings.ts` is imported (so `next build`
  can import it without a secret).
- `TVINE_DEBUG` from a `.env` file is ignored in production; set it in the real environment.
- `allowedHosts` defaults to localhost only outside production; in production you must set it.
- `session.cookieName` changes to `__Host-…` when `secure` is on; clients reading the cookie by name must use that.
- `data.*` and `socket` are accepted but unused.

## See also

[middleware.md](./middleware.md) · [request.md](./request.md) · [actions.md](./actions.md) · [urls.md](./urls.md) ·
[contrib/auth.md](./contrib/auth.md) · [overview.md](./overview.md)


# docs/reference/warp/contrib/auth.md

# tvine.auth

## What it is

`tvine.auth` is the built-in users app. It gives you a `User` model,
password hashing and validation, sign-in through session cookies or Bearer API tokens, groups and permissions,
two-factor sign-in (TOTP plus recovery codes), a list of signed-in sessions, mail alerts about account security, and
a data export and erase flow for privacy requests. Every flow is an ordinary action (`auth.login`, `auth.me`…), so
the same code serves pages, `/tvine/api`, MCP tools and agents. Source: `packages/tvine/warp/src/contrib/auth/`.

## Install / enable

```ts
// config/settings.ts
import { defineSettings } from 'tvine'

export default defineSettings({
  installedApps: ['tvine.auth', 'catalog', 'orders'],
})
```

Then run `tvine migrate`. You do not add any middleware: once the app is installed, `request.user` is resolved for
every request (Bearer token first, then the session cookie). The migrate step also creates the
`add / change / delete / view` permission rows for every model of every installed app.

Optional REST paths (every action also answers at `POST /tvine/api/auth.<name>`):

```ts
// config/urls.ts
import { include, path } from 'tvine'
export const urlpatterns = [path('api/auth/', include('tvine.auth.urls'))]
```

## Import

```ts
import { User, getUserModel, extendUser, defineUserModel, createUser, createSuperuser, setPassword, addToGroup, grant,
  authenticate, login, logout, ModelBackend, EmailBackend, AuthUser, privacy } from 'tvine/auth'
import { isAuthenticated, isStaff, isSuperuser, hasPerm, modelPermissions, denyAgents, allOf, anyOf } from 'tvine'
```

The permission helpers (`isAuthenticated`, `isStaff`, `isSuperuser`, `hasPerm`, `modelPermissions`,
`loginRequired`, `permissionRequired`, `userPassesTest`, `staffMemberRequired`) are exported from both `tvine` and
`tvine/auth`.

## The User model

`User` is the model `auth_user`. Its fields are exported as `USER_FIELDS`.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `field.id()` | auto | primary key |
| `password` | `field.text({ hidden: true })` | — | encoded hash, `<algorithm>$…`. A value starting with `!` never matches (unusable password). Never sent out. |
| `isActive` | `field.bool` | `true` | inactive users cannot sign in, and have no permissions |
| `isStaff` | `field.bool` | `false` | may use the admin |
| `isSuperuser` | `field.bool` | `false` | has every permission |
| `lastLogin` | `field.datetime({ optional: true })` | `null` | stamped by `login()` |
| `username` | `field.text({ unique: true, searchable: true })` | — | the sign-in name (`usernameField`) |
| `email` | `field.text({ optional: true, index: true })` | `null` | the address for resets and alerts (`emailField`) |
| `firstName` | `field.text` | `''` | |
| `lastName` | `field.text` | `''` | |
| `dateJoined` | `field.datetime({ auto: true })` | now | |

Other tables of the app: `auth_group` (`Group`: `id`, `name` unique), `auth_permission` (`Permission`: `codename`
unique, `app`, `model`, `name`), the join tables `auth_user_groups` (`UserGroup`), `auth_user_permissions`
(`UserPermission`), `auth_group_permissions` (`GroupPermission`), `auth_token` (`Token`), `auth_totp` (`Totp`),
`auth_recovery_code` (`RecoveryCode`), `auth_session` (`UserSession`), `auth_known_device` (`KnownDevice`).

### Methods on a user row

Every row read from the user model has these methods (they are not columns: JSON and `Object.keys` do not see them).

| Method | Returns | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `isAuthenticated` / `isAnonymous` | `true` / `false` | getters |
| `getUsername()` | `string` | value of the model's `usernameField` |
| `getFullName()` | `string` | `firstName lastName`, trimmed |
| `getShortName()` | `string` | `firstName` |
| `hasUsablePassword()` | `boolean` | false for `!…` hashes |
| `checkPassword(raw)` | `Promise<boolean>` | re-hashes with the preferred hasher when the stored hash is old |
| `setPassword(raw)` | `Promise<void>` | hashes, saves, revokes the user's API tokens. No validators run. |
| `setUnusablePassword()` | `Promise<void>` | saves `!<uuid>`; revokes tokens |
| `getAllPermissions()` | `Promise<Set<string>>` | codenames from the user and its groups (cached per row) |
| `getGroupPermissions()` | `Promise<Set<string>>` | from groups only |
| `getUserPermissions()` | `Promise<Set<string>>` | same as `getAllPermissions()` |
| `hasPerm(perm, obj?)` | `Promise<boolean>` | see [Permissions](#permissions-and-groups) |
| `hasPerms(perms[], obj?)` | `Promise<boolean>` | all of them |
| `hasModulePerms(app)` | `Promise<boolean>` | any permission starting with `<app>.` |

### `request.user` (`AuthUser`)

In an action, `ctx.request.user` is an `AuthUser` for a signed-in user and `ANONYMOUS` otherwise. It never holds
the password hash.

| Member | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | the user id **as a string** |
| `username`, `name` | `string` | the `usernameField` value |
| `email` | `string \| null` | the `emailField` value |
| `isActive`, `isStaff`, `isSuperuser` | `boolean` | |
| `firstName`, `lastName` | `string` | |
| `extra` | `Record<string, unknown>` | a custom user model's own non-hidden fields; also copied onto the object (`user.phone`) |
| `via` | `'session' \| 'token'` | how the request signed in |
| `scopes` | `string[]` | only on token users |
| `tokenKey` | `string` | only on token users: the token's public key |
| `groups()` | `Promise<string[]>` | group names, sorted |
| `allPermissions()` / `getAllPermissions()` / `getGroupPermissions()` | `Promise<Set<string>>` | |
| `hasPerm` / `hasPerms` / `hasModulePerms` | as on the row | |
| `getUsername()`, `getFullName()` | `string` | |
| `checkPassword(raw)`, `hasUsablePassword()` | `Promise<boolean>` | read the row |
| `row()` | `Promise<row \| undefined>` | the full ORM row, with its methods |
| `claims` | object | `{ username, email, isStaff, isSuperuser, isActive }` |
| `toJSON()` | `SafeUser` | `{ id, username, email, isStaff, isSuperuser, ...extra }` (also `safeUser(u)`) |

## Custom user model (swappable)

Set `settings.auth.userModel` to `'app.Model'` **before the first migrate**. The table is `<app>_<model>`
(`'accounts.User'` → `accounts_user`). Code that needs the user model calls `getUserModel()`, never `User`.

```ts
// config/settings.ts
auth: { userModel: 'accounts.User' }

// apps/accounts/models.ts — keep every built-in field, add your own
import { field } from 'tvine'
import { extendUser } from 'tvine/auth'
export const User = extendUser({ phone: field.text({ optional: true }), marketingOptIn: field.bool({ default: false }) })
```

```ts
// a fully custom model: only the base fields (id, password, isActive, isStaff, isSuperuser, lastLogin) are added
import { defineUserModel } from 'tvine/auth'
export const User = defineUserModel(
  { email: field.text({ unique: true }), displayName: field.text({ default: '' }) },
  { usernameField: 'email', requiredFields: ['displayName'], emailField: 'email' },
)
```

`UserOptions` (second argument of `extendUser` / `defineUserModel`):

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | the table from `settings.auth.userModel` | table name; required when `userModel` is not set |
| `usernameField` | `string` | `'username'` | the sign-in field; must be `unique: true` |
| `requiredFields` | `string[]` | `extendUser`: `['email']`; `defineUserModel`: `[]` | asked by `createsuperuser`; must not contain `usernameField` |
| `emailField` | `string \| null` | `'email'` when such a field exists, else `null` | used by resets, alerts, `EmailBackend` |
| `meta` | `ModelMeta` | — | passed to `defineModel` |

`userMeta(model?)` returns `{ usernameField, requiredFields, emailField }` of a user model. The admin registers a
matching `UserAdmin` for a custom model (its own fields go in an "Additional info" fieldset) unless your app's
`admin.ts` registers the model first.

## Creating users (server side)

```ts
createUser(u: NewUser, o?: { settings?: Settings; validate?: boolean }): Promise<UserRow>
createSuperuser(u, o?)                       // createUser with isStaff + isSuperuser true
setPassword(userId: number, raw: string, o?: { settings?; validate?; ctx? }): Promise<void>
addToGroup(userId: number, group: string): Promise<void>          // creates the group if needed
grant(to: { user: number } | { group: string }, codename: string): Promise<void>
```

- `NewUser`: the `usernameField`, `email`, `password`, `isStaff`, `isSuperuser`, `isActive`, plus any field of the
  model. The username is NFKC-normalized and trimmed; a blank email becomes `null`.
- No `password` (or `null`) → an unusable password: the account can only get one through a reset.
- Validators run unless `validate: false`. `settings` picks hashers and validators (defaults without it).
- `setPassword` revokes all API tokens. With `ctx` (the current request) every other session is signed out, the
  current one stays signed in when it is that user's, and a `passwordChanged` mail goes out.
- `grant` throws `not_found` when the codename does not exist (run `tvine migrate` first).

Commands: `tvine createsuperuser [--username u] [--email e] [--noinput]` (with `--noinput` it reads
`TVINE_SUPERUSER_USERNAME`, `TVINE_SUPERUSER_EMAIL`, `TVINE_SUPERUSER_<FIELD>` for other required fields, and
`TVINE_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD`), `tvine changepassword <username>`, `tvine privacy export|erase <user>`.

There is **no built-in sign-up action**. Write your own action that calls `createUser` (and `login` if it should
sign the user in), as in the example below.

## Built-in actions

All ids are `auth.<name>`. "Session only" means a Bearer-token user is refused (`forbidden: sign in with a password
for this`). "Sudo" means: a password typed in this session in the last 10 minutes, or send `password` now.

| Action | Params | Returns | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `auth.login` | `username?` or `email?` (one is required), `password`, `otp?` | `SafeUser` | 10 / min; refused for an agent driving the human's tab |
| `auth.logout` | — | `null` | refused for an agent driving the human's tab |
| `auth.me` | — | `SafeUser \| null` | read only |
| `auth.changePassword` | `oldPassword`, `newPassword` | `null` | signed in, no agents, session only |
| `auth.requestPasswordReset` | `email` | always `null` | 5 / min; never says whether the email exists |
| `auth.resetPassword` | `uid`, `token`, `newPassword` | `null` | 10 / min |
| `auth.sessions` | — | `[{ id, createdAt, lastSeen, ip, device, current }]` | signed in, read only |
| `auth.revokeSession` | `id` (64 hex) | `null` | signed in, session only |
| `auth.logoutOthers` | — | `{ revoked }` | signed in, session only |
| `auth.totpBegin` | `password?` | `{ secret, uri }` (shown once) | signed in, no agents, session only, sudo |
| `auth.totpConfirm` | `otp` | `{ recoveryCodes }` (10, shown once) | signed in, no agents, session only |
| `auth.totpDisable` | `password`, `otp` | `null` | signed in, no agents, session only |
| `auth.createToken` | `name`, `scopes[]`, `expiresInDays?`, `password?` | `{ token, key, name, scopes, expiresAt }` (token shown once) | signed in, no agents, session only, sudo |
| `auth.listTokens` | — | `[{ key, name, scopes, createdAt, expiresAt, lastUsed }]` | signed in, read only |
| `auth.revokeToken` | `key` | `null` | signed in, session only |
| `auth.exportMyData` | — | `{ url }` | signed in, no agents, 2 / hour, a human must confirm |

Error codes you will meet: `invalid_credentials` (wrong user, password or code; never says which), `otp_required`
(2FA is on: send `otp`), `locked` (too many failures), `reauth_required` (sudo: send `password`), `invalid_token`
(bad or expired reset link), `totp_enabled`, `totp_not_pending`, `forbidden`, `human_only`.

`include('tvine.auth.urls')` maps them to: `login/`, `logout/`, `me/`, `password/change/`, `password/reset/`,
`password/reset/confirm/`, `totp/begin/`, `totp/confirm/`, `totp/disable/`, `tokens/` (list + create),
`tokens/<key>/` (DELETE: revoke), `export/`, `sessions/`, `sessions/others/` (DELETE), `sessions/<id>/` (DELETE).

### Login and sessions

`auth.login` runs `authenticate()` over `settings.auth.backends`, then the second factor, then `login()`.
`login(ctx, row)` binds the user id and a hash tied to the password hash to the session, gives the session a new id
(after commit), records a `UserSession` row, stamps `lastLogin` and sets `ctx.request.user`. If a different user was
signed in on this session, its session data is cleared first. `logout(ctx)` clears the session data and rotates its id.

A password change signs out every other session (they are bound to the old hash). Deleting a `UserSession` row
signs that session out on its next request. Session cookie options live in `settings.session` (see the settings
reference).

### Login throttling

Failures are counted in a window, in three tiers. Keys use the lower-cased name as typed (unknown names lock too) and
the IP (IPv6 by /64).

| Tier | Setting | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| name + IP | `auth.login.maxFailures` | `5` | that pair is locked |
| IP | `auth.login.ipMaxFailures` | `100` | that IP is locked for every name |
| name, any IP | `auth.login.accountMaxFailures` | `50` | every pair that already failed is refused; a pair with no failures still gets its try |
| window | `auth.login.windowMs` | 15 min | |
| lock time | `auth.login.lockoutMs` | 15 min | |

The counters are per process with `settings.limits.backend: 'memory'` and shared with `'redis'`.

### Password reset

1. `auth.requestPasswordReset({ email })` finds active users with that email (case-insensitive) and a usable
   password. Capped silently at 3 / hour per email + client and 10 / hour per email.
2. After commit it calls `settings.auth.sendPasswordReset(e)` if set, else mails a link: `settings.auth.resetUrl`
   with `{uid}` and `{token}` filled in, or the raw uid and token when `resetUrl` is not set.
3. `auth.resetPassword({ uid, token, newPassword })`. The token is valid for `auth.resetTimeoutMs` (default 1 h) and
   works once (it is bound to the password hash, `lastLogin` and email). All tokens are revoked and all sessions
   signed out.

`makeResetToken(settings, row)` / `checkResetToken(settings, row, token)` are exported for custom flows.

### Two-factor (TOTP)

`auth.totpBegin` → show `uri` as a QR code (or `secret`) → `auth.totpConfirm({ otp })` turns it on and returns 10
recovery codes (`XXXXX-XXXXX`, each works once). From then on `auth.login` answers `otp_required` until `otp` is
sent (a 6-digit code or a recovery code). Codes are RFC 6238 (SHA1, 6 digits, 30 s, ±1 step); a code is accepted once.
The issuer is `auth.totp.issuer`, default `settings.site.name`. The secret is stored AES-256-GCM encrypted under a
key derived from `settings.secret`.

## Authentication backends

```ts
authenticate(ctx: { settings; request?; sid? }, credentials: Record<string, unknown> & { password?: string }): Promise<row | null>
```

Tries each backend of `settings.auth.backends` in order; the first user wins. Bad credentials → `null`; a locked
name/IP throws `DomainError('locked')`. Failures count toward login throttling.

| Entry | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `'tvine.auth.ModelBackend'` (default) | `credentials[usernameField]` (or `username`) + `password` |
| `'tvine.auth.EmailBackend'` | `email` + `password`, case-insensitive; two accounts with one address → no match |
| `'accounts.backends.LdapBackend'` | the `LdapBackend` export of `apps/accounts/backends.ts` |
| an object or class | `{ authenticate(ctx, credentials), getUser?(id) }` (a class is instantiated) |

Unknown or inactive users cost the same hashing time as a real check.

## Bearer API tokens

A token looks like `tvp_<8 chars>_<32 chars>_<6-char checksum>`. Only its sha256 is stored. Send it as
`Authorization: Bearer tvp_…`. A token user is marked as an agent (`request.agent.is = true`), so `denyAgents`
actions refuse it.

| Scope | Allows |
|---|---|
| `'*'` | every action |
| `'read'` | every read-only action |
| `'<app>.*'` | every action of one app (`'orders.*'`) |
| `'<app>.<action>'` | one action (`'orders.place'`) |

Scopes are checked before the action's own permissions. `expiresInDays` defaults to `auth.tokens.defaultDays`
(90) and may not exceed `auth.tokens.maxDays` (365). A password change or reset revokes every token of the user.
An agent on a token sees and revokes only its own token. `tokenUser(settings, token)` resolves a token by hand.

## Permissions and groups

Codenames are `<app>.<action>_<model>`. The model part drops the `<app>_` table prefix: model `catalog_product`
→ `catalog.change_product`. `tvine migrate` creates `add`, `change`, `delete` and `view` for every model.

`hasPerm(perm)` rules: inactive → `false`; active superuser → `true`; otherwise the user's own codenames plus its
groups' codenames. With an object (`hasPerm(perm, obj)`), only `settings.auth.objectPermission(user, perm, obj)`
decides (superusers still pass).

### Guards (permission functions)

Put them in an action's `permissions: [...]`, on a view, or in `settings.guards` (`[{ path, permissions }]`). They
run in order; the first `false` (or throw) refuses with `forbidden`.

| Guard | Passes when |
|---|---|
| `allowAny` | always |
| `isAuthenticated` / `loginRequired` | signed in |
| `isStaff` / `staffMemberRequired` | signed in, active, `isStaff` |
| `isSuperuser` | signed in, active, `isSuperuser` |
| `hasPerm(...codenames)` / `permissionRequired(...)` | active and holds every codename |
| `modelPermissions(Model, { map? })` | generic-view actions: `list`/`get` need only sign-in, `create` → `add`, `update` → `change`, `delete` → `delete`, anything else → `change`; `map` overrides per action name |
| `userPassesTest((user, ctx) => boolean)` | your test returns true |
| `denyAgents` | the request is not agent-marked (also hides the control from agents) |
| `allOf(...g)` / `anyOf(...g)` | all / any pass (short-circuit) |

`permCodename(app, action, modelName)` builds a codename.

## Account alerts (`settings.auth.notify`)

A short mail to the account's address, sent in the background (through `tasks.sendMail` when `tvine.tasks` is
installed). Each kind is on by default whenever `settings.email.backend` is not `'dummy'`.

| Kind | When |
|---|---|
| `newLogin` | sign-in from a browser + OS + network (/24 or /64) not seen before (never on the account's first sign-in) |
| `passwordChanged` | password change or reset |
| `twoFactorDisabled` | `auth.totpDisable` |
| `tokenCreated` | `auth.createToken` |
| `emailChanged` | the admin changed the email (sent to the **old** address) |

`securityNotice(settings, kind, { username, email }, request?)` sends one by hand.

## Privacy: export and erase

Models opt in through their `meta`: `personalData: ['field', …]` (what is exported and blanked) and `onErase:
'delete' | 'anonymize' | (userId) => Promise<void>` (default `'anonymize'`). Only rows with a foreign key to the
user model count.

```ts
privacy.export(userId)            // = exportData: { exportedAt, user, sessions, tokens, <model>: [...] }
privacy.erase(userId, { settings?, request? })   // = eraseData: one transaction
```

Erase anonymizes the user row (`usernameField` → `deleted-<id>`, email and names blanked, password `!`,
inactive, not staff) and deletes its sessions, devices, tokens and 2FA. The admin has an "Erase personal data"
action for users. `auth.exportMyData` writes the JSON as a private media file and returns a signed link valid 24 h
for that user only.

## Settings: `settings.auth.*`

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `user` | `(req) => Promise<TvineUser \| null>` | — | your own resolver ("bring your own auth"); wins over tokens and sessions |
| `userModel` | `'app.Model'` | `'auth.User'` | swappable user model |
| `backends` | `unknown[]` (≥1) | `[ModelBackend]` | see [Authentication backends](#authentication-backends) |
| `hashers` | `PasswordHasher[]` (≥1) | `[scryptHasher()]` | first one hashes; the others still verify and are upgraded on sign-in |
| `validators` | `PasswordValidator[]` | `DEFAULT_VALIDATORS` | see below |
| `login.maxFailures` / `accountMaxFailures` / `ipMaxFailures` | number | `5` / `50` / `100` | throttling tiers |
| `login.windowMs` / `login.lockoutMs` | ms | 15 min / 15 min | |
| `resetTimeoutMs` | ms | `3_600_000` | reset link lifetime |
| `resetUrl` | string | — | `'https://shop.example/reset?uid={uid}&token={token}'` |
| `sendPasswordReset` | `(e: { user, email, uid, token, request }) => unknown` | built-in mail | send the reset yourself |
| `objectPermission` | `(user, perm, obj) => boolean \| Promise<boolean>` | — | per-object permissions |
| `tokens.defaultDays` / `tokens.maxDays` | number | `90` / `365` | API token lifetime |
| `totp.issuer` | string | `site.name` | name shown in authenticator apps |
| `breachCheck` | boolean | `false` | refuse new passwords found in Have I Been Pwned (only 5 hex chars of the SHA-1 leave the server; a network failure lets the password through) |
| `notify.newLogin` / `passwordChanged` / `twoFactorDisabled` / `tokenCreated` / `emailChanged` | boolean | `true` | account alerts |

### Hashers and validators

| Export | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `scryptHasher({ N?, r?, p? })` | default; `N = 2^15`, `r = 8`, `p = 1`; format `scrypt$N$r$p$salt$hash` |
| `pbkdf2Hasher({ iterations? })` | `pbkdf2_sha256$…` format (existing hashes in that format verify as-is); default 600 000, minimum 100 000 |
| `makePassword(raw, settings)` / `checkPassword(raw, encoded, settings)` | `checkPassword` returns `{ ok, upgrade }` |
| `minLength(n = 8)` | too short |
| `numericPassword()` | only digits |
| `commonPassword(list?)` | the built-in 20 000 common passwords, or your list |
| `userAttributeSimilarity(attrs = ['username', 'email'], max = 0.7)` | too close to a user attribute |
| `DEFAULT_VALIDATORS` | `[userAttributeSimilarity(), minLength(8), commonPassword(), numericPassword()]` |
| `validatePassword(raw, settings, user?)` | the list of problems (empty = ok) |

A validator is `(password, user?) => string[]`. Passwords longer than 4096 characters are refused.

## Examples

### 1. Sign-up action for a shop

```ts
// apps/accounts/views.ts
import { z } from 'zod'
import { defineAction, DomainError } from 'tvine'
import { createUser, getUserModel, login, safeUser } from 'tvine/auth'

export const register = defineAction('register', z.object({
  username: z.string().min(3).max(150), email: z.string().email(), password: z.string().min(1).max(4096),
}), async ({ username, email, password }, ctx) => {
  if (await getUserModel().objects.filter({ username }).first()) throw new DomainError('invalid_param', 'that username is taken', 'username')
  const row = await createUser({ username, email, password }, { settings: ctx.settings })   // validators run
  return safeUser(await login(ctx, row))
}, { rate: { limit: 5, windowMs: 60_000 } })
```

### 2. Sign in from a script, then call an action

```bash
curl -s -c jar -b jar -X POST http://localhost:3000/tvine/api/auth.login \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"username":"ana","password":"correct horse battery"}'
curl -s -b jar -X POST http://localhost:3000/tvine/api/auth.me -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}'
```

### 3. Staff-only and permission-checked actions

```ts
import { z } from 'zod'
import { allOf, hasPerm, isStaff, defineAction } from 'tvine'

export const refund = defineAction('refund', z.object({ orderId: z.number().int() }), async ({ orderId }, ctx) => {
  /* ... */
}, { permissions: [allOf(isStaff, hasPerm('orders.change_order'))] })
```

```ts
// give the "support" group the right once (a script, a migration, a fixture loader)
import { addToGroup, grant } from 'tvine/auth'
await grant({ group: 'support' }, 'orders.change_order')
await addToGroup(userId, 'support')
```

### 4. Sign in by email and keep orders private per user

```ts
// config/settings.ts
auth: {
  backends: ['tvine.auth.EmailBackend', 'tvine.auth.ModelBackend'],
  resetUrl: 'https://shop.example/reset?uid={uid}&token={token}',
  objectPermission: (user, perm, order: any) => perm === 'orders.view_order' && String(order.customerId) === user.id,
}
```

### 5. A read-only API token for a reporting script

```bash
# signed in (cookie jar from example 2), password sent because the login was more than 10 minutes ago
curl -s -b jar -X POST http://localhost:3000/tvine/api/auth.createToken -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"reports","scopes":["read"],"expiresInDays":30,"password":"correct horse battery"}'
# then, from the script:
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/tvine/api/orders.list -H 'authorization: Bearer tvp_…' -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}'
```

## Gotchas

- `request.user.id` is a **string**; model ids are numbers. Compare with `String(row.userId) === user.id`, or
  `Number(user.id)` for queries.
- Use `getUserModel()` for queries and foreign keys when a custom user model is possible. Pick `userModel` before
  the first migrate.
- `auth.login` with only `email` needs `EmailBackend` (the default `ModelBackend` reads the username field).
- `row.setPassword()` runs no validators and does not keep the current session signed in; use `setPassword(id, raw,
  { ctx })` from `tvine/auth` in actions.
- Token users are agents: `denyAgents` (and so `changePassword`, `createToken`, TOTP actions) refuse them.
- An agent driving a human's browser tab cannot sign that tab in or out (`human_only`); the human presses the button.
- Secrets (`createToken`'s `token`, `totpBegin`'s `secret`, recovery codes) are returned once and never again.
- `requestPasswordReset` always answers `null`, even when nothing was sent.
- With `settings.email.backend: 'dummy'` no alerts or reset mails go out.

## See also

- [../models.md](../models.md): fields, `meta`, foreign keys to the user model
- [../actions.md](../actions.md): `defineAction`, `permissions`, `rate`, `confirm`, `humanOnly`
- [admin.md](admin.md): `UserAdmin`, `GroupAdmin`, staff hardening
- [security.md](security.md): signing, encryption, rate limits
- [email.md](email.md): the mail settings alerts and resets use
- [../../../settings-and-env.md](../../../settings-and-env.md): `settings.session` and every other key


# docs/reference/warp/contrib/admin.md

# tvine.admin

## What it is

`tvine.admin` is the built-in staff panel. You register models with a
`ModelAdmin` class in `apps/<app>/admin.ts`; Warp serves the panel at `settings.admin.path` (default `/admin`) with
changelists (filters, search, sorting, bulk actions, inline edits, charts), change forms with inlines, a dashboard,
an audit history per object, and a System section (health, traffic, agents, queries, jobs, logs, security). Every
screen reads and writes through `admin.*` actions, so permissions, rate limits and the audit trail apply.
Source: `packages/tvine/warp/src/contrib/admin/`.

## Install / enable

```ts
// config/settings.ts
export default defineSettings({
  installedApps: ['tvine.auth', 'tvine.admin', 'catalog', 'orders'],   // the panel's logins come from tvine.auth
  admin: { path: '/admin', title: 'Shop admin' },
})
```

Run `tvine migrate`, then `tvine createsuperuser`. No page file and no middleware is needed. At boot the admin
imports `admin.ts` of every installed app (project apps first, then contrib), then checks every registration: an
unknown field name in any option is a boot error naming the class.

`tvine.auth` registers `User` and `Group`; `tvine.tasks` registers `Job` (read-only, retry / revoke);
`tvine.audit` registers `AuditEntry` (read-only).

Optional REST paths for the admin API: `path('admin/', include('tvine.admin.urls'))`. Without it every call still
answers at `POST /tvine/api/admin.<name>`.

## Import

```ts
import { admin, register, site, ModelAdmin, TabularInline, StackedInline, SimpleListFilter, display, adminAction,
  deleteSelected, logAction, LogEntry, ADDITION, CHANGE, DELETION, type Ctx, type ActionResult } from 'tvine/contrib/admin'
```

`admin` is `{ site, register }`.

## Registering

```ts
admin.site.register(Model | Model[], AdminClass = ModelAdmin): void   // throws AlreadyRegistered
admin.register(Product, ProductAdmin)                                  // same, registers now
@admin.register(Product) class ProductAdmin extends ModelAdmin {}      // decorator (TC39 or legacy)
admin.site.unregister(Model)                                           // throws NotRegistered
admin.site.isRegistered(Model): boolean
```

A model's admin key is `'<app>.<model>'`: the app whose `models.ts` exports it, and the model name without its
`<app>_` prefix (`catalog_product` → `catalog.product`).

## ModelAdmin options

### List page (changelist)

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `listDisplay` | `(string \| (obj) => unknown)[]` | `['__str__']` | columns: field names, method names, functions, or `'__str__'` (the `str()` of the row). Not m2m fields. |
| `listDisplayLinks` | `string[] \| null` | first column | columns that link to the change form |
| `listEditable` | `string[]` | `[]` | fields editable in the list; each must be a field in `listDisplay` and not a link column |
| `listPerPage` | `number` | `100` | rows per page |
| `listMaxShowAll` | `number` | `200` | "show all" works up to this many rows; also caps `pageSize` |
| `listFilter` | `(string \| SimpleListFilter class)[]` | `[]` | sidebar filters: bool → Yes/No, date/datetime → Today / Past 7 days / This month / This year, fk → related rows (first 200), enum → its values, other → distinct values in use (first 200); optional fields add a "null" choice |
| `showFacets` | `boolean` | `true` | show a row count next to each filter choice |
| `searchFields` | `string[]` | `[]` | every search word must match one of these. Prefix `^` = starts with, `=` = exact, `@` or none = contains (all case-insensitive). `rel__field` follows relations. Not money fields. |
| `searchHelpText` | `string \| null` | `Search by <fields>` | text under the search box |
| `dateHierarchy` | `string \| null` | `null` | a date/datetime field: year → month → day drill-down (filters `<f>__year`, `__month`, `__day`, UTC) |
| `sortableBy` | `string[] \| null` | all fields | which field columns can be sorted (json columns never) |
| `ordering` | `string[] \| null` | model `meta.ordering`, else `['-id']` | default order; `'-rel__count'` orders by a related count |
| `showFullResultCount` | `boolean` | `true` | show the unfiltered total next to the filtered count |
| `emptyValueDisplay` | `string` | `'-'` | shown for empty cells |
| `actions` | `(AdminAction \| string)[]` | `[]` | bulk actions; a string names a method `(ctx, qs, pks)` of the class. `deleteSelected` is always added first. |
| `actionsOnTop` | `boolean` | `true` | action bar above the list |
| `charts` | `ChartSpec[] \| false \| null` | `null` | `null` = automatic charts, `false` = none, a list = yours (see [Charts](#charts)) |

### Change form

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fields` | `string[] \| null` | every field | which fields the form shows, in order |
| `exclude` | `string[]` | `[]` | fields left out of the form |
| `fieldsets` | `[title \| null, { fields, classes?, description? }][] \| null` | `null` | grouped form sections; wins over `fields` |
| `readonlyFields` | `string[]` | `[]` | shown, never written (`auto` fields show only when listed here) |
| `autocompleteFields` | `string[]` | `[]` | fk / m2m fields picked with a search box (target admin needs `searchFields`) |
| `rawIdFields` | `string[]` | `[]` | fk / m2m fields typed as an id |
| `formfieldOverrides` | `Record<fieldName \| ormKind, Partial<FieldMeta>>` | `{}` | change any form field property: `{ text: { kind: 'textarea' } }`, `{ price: { suffix: 'EUR' } }` |
| `widgets` | `Record<fieldName, MetaKind>` | `{}` | pick an input per field: `{ status: 'segmented', notes: 'markdown' }` |
| `inlines` | `InlineClass[]` | `[]` | related rows edited on the same form |
| `saveOnTop` | `boolean` | `false` | save buttons above the form too |
| `verboseName` / `verboseNamePlural` | `string \| null` | from the model name | labels |

An fk / m2m field that is neither in `autocompleteFields` nor in `rawIdFields` is a dropdown of the related rows
(only the first 500); use `autocompleteFields` for big tables.

`MetaKind` values for `widgets` / `formfieldOverrides.kind`: `text textarea email url slug int decimal money bool
date datetime time duration uuid json choice fk m2m file image password rich color range phone search tags checkboxes
switch segmented rating otp markdown code daterange month week country address keyvalue list signature currency
percent ip slugAuto`.

### Agents and access

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agents` | `boolean \| 'confirm'` | `true` | `false`: agent-marked requests are refused for this model; `'confirm'`: an agent's write answers `confirm_required` and only the human can confirm. `UserAdmin` and `GroupAdmin` use `false`. |

### Methods you can override

| Method | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `str(obj)` | first of `name`, `title`, `username`, `email`, `label`, else `"<model> object (<id>)"` | the row's display text |
| `getQueryset(ctx)` | `model.objects` | every read and write goes through it: scope rows per user here |
| `getObject(ctx, pk)` | from `getQueryset` | `undefined` = not found |
| `getReadonlyFields(ctx, obj?)` | `readonlyFields` | |
| `saveModel(ctx, obj \| undefined, values)` | create or update | `values` are validated and keyed by row property (fk → `<name>Id`) |
| `deleteModel(ctx, obj)` | `model.delete(id)` | |
| `getActions(ctx)` | `deleteSelected` + `actions` | |
| `hasViewPermission(ctx, obj?)` | `view` or `change` permission | |
| `hasAddPermission` / `hasChangePermission` / `hasDeletePermission(ctx, obj?)` | the model permission | |
| `hasModulePermission(ctx)` | any of the four | |
| `changelist?(ctx, params)` | not set | return `{ rows, count }` to list from somewhere other than the ORM |
| `getUrls()` | `[]` | custom admin views (below) |
| `view(fn, { readOnly?, permission?, title? })` | — | wraps `fn(params, ctx)` as a staff-only action; needs `view` unless `permission` names another (`'change'`, or `X` → `hasXPermission`) |

The default permission checks: the user must be active staff; a superuser passes; otherwise the codename
`<app>.<view|add|change|delete>_<model>` (see [auth.md](auth.md#permissions-and-groups)).

### `@display`

```ts
display({ description?, ordering?, boolean?, emptyValue? })(fn)   // or as a method decorator
```

`description` = column label (or action label for string actions), `ordering` = a field to sort the column by,
`boolean: true` = show as a yes/no icon.

### Bulk actions: `adminAction`

```ts
adminAction(opts: { name?, description?, permissions?, confirm?, humanOnly? }, fn: (admin, ctx, queryset, pks) => Promise<void | ActionResult>)
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | `fn.name`, else camelCased `description` | must be an identifier |
| `description` | `string` | `name` | label in the action menu |
| `permissions` | `string[]` | `[]` | `'view' \| 'add' \| 'change' \| 'delete'` or any `X` → `hasXPermission(ctx)` must pass |
| `confirm` | `boolean \| string` | `false` | the panel asks before running (a string is the question) |
| `humanOnly` | `boolean` | — | hidden from and refused for agents |

`queryset` holds only the selected rows (through `getQueryset`); `pks` are their keys as strings. Return
`{ message?, level?: 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error', download? }`; `download` is a url string or
`{ url? | data?, filename, contentType }`. One `LogEntry` per row is written.

### List filters: `SimpleListFilter`

```ts
class InStock extends SimpleListFilter {
  title = 'Stock'
  parameterName = 'stock'
  lookups() { return [['out', 'Out of stock'], ['low', 'Below 5']] as [string, string][] }
  queryset(_ctx, qs) { return this.value() === 'out' ? qs.filter({ stock: 0 }) : this.value() === 'low' ? qs.filter({ stock__lt: 5 }) : qs }
}
```

### Inlines: `TabularInline` / `StackedInline`

Set `model` and any of the shared options (`fields`, `exclude`, `readonlyFields`, `autocompleteFields`,
`rawIdFields`, `ordering`, `formfieldOverrides`, `widgets`, `verboseName(Plural)`, `str`, `getQueryset`,
`has*Permission`) plus:

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fkName` | `string \| null` | the only fk to the parent | which fk, when the inline model has several |
| `extra` | `number` | `3` | empty rows offered |
| `maxNum` | `number \| null` | `null` (UI max 1000) | at most this many rows |
| `minNum` | `number` | `0` | at least this many rows |
| `canDelete` | `boolean` | `true` | rows can be deleted |
| `name` | `string \| null` | model short name | key of the rows in `admin.get` / `create` / `update` |

`tabular` = a grid, `stacked` = one form per row.

### Custom views: `getUrls`

```ts
getUrls() { return [path('<int:id>/invoice/', this.view(this.invoice, { title: 'Invoice' }), { name: 'invoice' })] }
async invoice(params: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: Ctx) { /* return data */ }
```

Each one becomes the action `admin.<app>_<model>_<name>` (staff only; a raw `defineAction` def is made staff-only
too unless it has `public: true`) and the route `<app>/<model>/<route>` under `tvine.admin.urls`. The model page
lists them (`name`, `path`, `title`). How the panel renders a custom view's result: Not covered here (frontend
`configureAdmin` in `tvine/admin`).

## Charts

`ChartSpec`: `{ id?, title?, type, aggregate?, field?, by?, date?, range?, size?, dashboard? }`.

| Key | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `line area bar stacked donut stat table` | — | renderer; `stat` = total over the range plus the period before |
| `aggregate` | `count sum avg min max` | `count` | `sum`…`max` need a number/money `field` |
| `field` | field name | — | what to aggregate |
| `by` | choice / bool / fk field | — | a breakdown (top 8 + Other) instead of a time series |
| `date` | date field | `dateHierarchy`, else the first date field | x axis |
| `range` | `24h 7d 30d 90d 1y` | the page's range | |
| `size` | `sm md lg xl` | | |
| `dashboard` | `boolean` | `true` | also show on the dashboard |

Automatic charts (`charts = null`): with a date field, "New <rows>" stat, a sum stat of the first money/decimal
field, "<rows> over time" area, a sum-per-period bar; then donuts by the first two enum / bool / fk fields (list
filters first). Charts use the changelist queryset and filters. Results are cached 60 s per user in the default cache.

## Site, pages and widgets

`admin.site` options (set them in any `admin.ts`): `siteHeader` (`'Tvine administration'`), `siteTitle`
(`'Tvine site admin'`, `settings.admin.title` wins), `indexTitle` (`'Site administration'`), `siteUrl` (`'/'`).

```ts
admin.site.registerPage({ path, title, icon?, section?, component, permission? })
admin.site.registerWidget({ id, title, size, data?, type?, refreshMs?, component?, permission? })
```

| Widget key | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | unique; `settings.admin.dashboard.widgets` orders by it |
| `title` | `string` | |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | |
| `data` | `ActionDef` or `(ctx, { range }) => unknown` | a function returns `ChartData`, `{ value, previous? }` or `{ columns, rows }` |
| `type` | `line area bar stacked donut stat table custom` | default `custom` with a `component`, else `stat` |
| `refreshMs` | `number` | auto refresh |
| `component` | `string` | a frontend component name (`'module#Export'`), for `type: 'custom'` and pages |
| `permission` | codename | only users holding it see it (superusers always) |

Built-in dashboard widgets (when `settings.admin.stats.enabled`): `kpi.requests`, `kpi.errors`, `kpi.latency`,
`kpi.agents`, `traffic.requests`, `traffic.status`, `traffic.latency`, `logins` (superuser), `agents.activity`,
`agents.top`, `actions.top`, `actions.slowest`, `searches.top`, `pages.top`, `searches.none`; plus `activity`
(recent actions) and up to 16 model charts when `dashboard.autoCharts`. Each staff user's layout is saved per user.

## System pages

Actions `admin.system.<page>`, staff only (`staffGuard`), read only.

| Page | Who |
|---|---|
| `health`, `traffic`, `metrics`, `agents`, `queries`, `search`, `pages` | staff |
| `jobs` | staff with `tasks.view_job` |
| `logs`, `security` | superuser |
| `revokeTab` (stop an agent's tab control) | superuser |

## Hardening (`settings.admin`)

Every `admin.*` action runs `staffGuard`: active staff, then these settings.

| Key | Effect |
|---|---|
| `allowIps: ['10.0.0.0/8', '203.0.113.7']` | staff may use the admin only from these addresses / CIDRs; also adds `tvine.middleware.IpFilter` on the panel path. A bad entry is a boot error. Refusals log `ip_refused`. |
| `require2fa: true` | staff without confirmed TOTP get `two_factor_required` (set it up with `auth.totpBegin` / `auth.totpConfirm`) |
| `idleMs: 900_000` | no admin use for this long (or since sign-in) → `reauth_required` |

`UserAdmin` also asks for a password typed in the last 10 minutes (and a session, not a token) before changing a
password or the staff / superuser flags. Passwords change only through the user's "Change password" view.

## Settings: `settings.admin.*`

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` | `'/admin'` | panel URL |
| `title` | `string` | — | browser title (overrides `site.siteTitle`) |
| `theme.brand` | `string` | — | accent color |
| `theme.radius` | `string` | — | corner radius |
| `theme.dark` | `'auto' \| 'on' \| 'off'` | `'auto'` | |
| `allowIps` | `string[]` | — | see Hardening |
| `require2fa` | `boolean` | — | see Hardening |
| `idleMs` | `number` | — | see Hardening |
| `dashboard.widgets` | `string[]` | `[]` | widget ids shown first, in this order |
| `dashboard.autoCharts` | `boolean` | `true` | model charts on the dashboard |
| `stats.enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | collect traffic / action / query rollups (`admin_stat` table) |
| `stats.retentionDays` | `number` | `30` | rollup rows kept |
| `stats.flushMs` | `number` | `60_000` | rollup write interval (min 1000) |
| `stats.searches.enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | count visitor searches (an action's `rules.search` param) |
| `stats.searches.minCount` | `number` | `3` | a term shows once this many sessions searched it |
| `stats.pages.enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | count page views |
| `stats.pages.keepParams` | `string[]` | `[]` | query params kept in counted page paths |

## Examples

### 1. Products

```ts
// apps/catalog/admin.ts
import { admin, adminAction, display, ModelAdmin } from 'tvine/contrib/admin'
import { Product } from './models.ts'

export const restock = adminAction({ description: 'Restock to 20', permissions: ['change'], confirm: 'Set stock to 20?' },
  async (_a, _ctx, qs) => { const n = await qs.update({ stock: 20 }); return { message: `${n} restocked`, level: 'success' } })

class ProductAdmin extends ModelAdmin {
  listDisplay = ['name', 'category', 'price', 'stock', 'available']
  listFilter = ['category', 'published']
  listEditable = ['stock']
  searchFields = ['^sku', 'name', 'category__name']
  autocompleteFields = ['category']
  readonlyFields = ['createdAt']
  actions = [restock]
  available = display({ description: 'Available', boolean: true })((p: any) => p.stock > 0)
  str(p: any) { return String(p.name) }
}
admin.site.register(Product, ProductAdmin)
```

### 2. Orders with lines, grouped form, scoped rows

```ts
// apps/orders/admin.ts
import { admin, ModelAdmin, TabularInline, type Ctx } from 'tvine/contrib/admin'
import { Order, OrderLine } from './models.ts'

class LineInline extends TabularInline {
  model = OrderLine
  fields = ['product', 'qty', 'price']
  autocompleteFields = ['product']
  extra = 0
}

@admin.register(Order)
class OrderAdmin extends ModelAdmin {
  listDisplay = ['id', 'customer', 'status', 'total', 'createdAt']
  listFilter = ['status', 'createdAt']
  dateHierarchy = 'createdAt'
  inlines = [LineInline]
  widgets = { status: 'segmented' as const }
  fieldsets: ModelAdmin['fieldsets'] = [
    [null, { fields: ['customer', 'status'] }],
    ['Money', { fields: ['total'], classes: ['collapse'] }],
  ]
  // shop staff see only their store's orders
  getQueryset(ctx: Ctx) { return ctx.request.user.isSuperuser ? Order.objects : Order.objects.filter({ storeId: Number((ctx.request.user as any).storeId) }) }
}
```

### 3. A dashboard widget

```ts
admin.site.registerWidget({
  id: 'low-stock', title: 'Running low', size: 'md', type: 'table', permission: 'catalog.view_product',
  data: async () => {
    const rows = await Product.objects.filter({ stock__lt: 5 }).order('stock').all(8)
    return { columns: ['Product', 'Stock'], rows: rows.map((p) => [p.name, p.stock]) }
  },
})
```

### 4. Locked-down admin

```ts
admin: { path: '/staff', allowIps: ['10.0.0.0/8'], require2fa: true, idleMs: 15 * 60_000, dashboard: { widgets: ['low-stock', 'kpi.requests'], autoCharts: true, } }
```

## Gotchas

- `listEditable` fields must also be in `listDisplay` and must not be the link column (the first column by default).
- Option names are checked at boot; a typo fails the boot with the class name.
- `getQueryset` is the only row scope: actions, charts, search, autocomplete and deletes all go through it.
- Deleting a row whose foreign keys use `PROTECT` / `RESTRICT` (the fk default) deletes nothing and lists the
  protected rows.
- Agents use the admin like staff unless `agents` says otherwise. `mcp: { exclude: ['admin.*'] }` in settings keeps
  the `admin.*` actions out of the typed MCP tool list.
- The `admin_stat` rollups add up across server and worker processes; `1h` ranges read in-process numbers.
- `registerPage` / `component` need a frontend component registered with `configureAdmin` from `tvine/admin`.

## See also

- [auth.md](auth.md): staff, permissions, groups, 2FA
- [tasks.md](tasks.md): the Job admin
- [audit.md](audit.md): the AuditEntry admin and LogEntry vs audit rows
- [../models.md](../models.md): field kinds the form maps to inputs
- [../actions.md](../actions.md): `defineAction`, used by `view()` and widgets


# docs/reference/warp/contrib/tasks.md

# tvine.tasks

## What it is

`tvine.tasks` runs work outside the request: background jobs, retries, timeouts, periodic (cron) jobs, and job
chains. You define tasks with `defineTask` in `apps/<app>/tasks.ts`, enqueue them from
actions with `.delay(args)`, and run them in job workers (`tvine worker`). Jobs are stored by a broker: a local SQLite file by
default, Redis for several hosts, your app's database, or memory for tests. Source:
`packages/tvine/warp/src/contrib/tasks/`.

## Install / enable

```ts
// config/settings.ts
export default defineSettings({
  installedApps: ['tvine.auth', 'tvine.tasks', 'catalog', 'orders'],
  tasks: { broker: 'file' },   // the default; 'redis' for several hosts
})
```

Run `tvine migrate` (job tables and the outbox), then start a worker next to the web server:

```bash
tvine worker                 # every queue, 10 at a time
tvine worker --beat          # also fire scheduled tasks (several --beat processes are safe: one leads)
```

No middleware is needed. The web server discovers tasks at boot (so actions can enqueue them) and relays job
progress to the browser; it does **not** run jobs or schedules, except with `broker: 'memory'` (jobs only) or
`tvine start --with-worker [--beat]`. With only `tvine start`, queued jobs wait and schedules never fire; about 30 s
after start it prints once:

```
tvine start: background jobs are queued but no job worker is running. Start one: tvine worker --beat   (see docs/deploy.md#background-jobs)
```

(not in `tvine dev`, not with broker `memory`, not with `--with-worker`; it reads the broker's worker heartbeats).
How to run both in production: [deploy.md](../../../deploy.md#how-a-tvine-app-runs-in-production).

### Job workers

| | |
|---|---|
| Claiming | a worker claims up to `claimBatch` jobs with a lease (`leaseMs`, 30 s) and renews it every `leaseMs / 3` while they run |
| Run once | only the lease holder may finish a job (a token fences it); several workers never run the same attempt |
| A worker dies | its lease expires, the reaper puts the job back, another worker runs it (counted as an attempt) |
| How many | any number of processes and machines that reach the broker; `--concurrency` jobs at once each (default 10) |
| Who is alive | each worker registers in the broker and heartbeats; one silent longer than `leaseMs` is stale. `tvine check`, `/tvine/health` (`workers`, `staleWorkers`) and the admin's Job workers tile read this |
| Stop | SIGTERM: stop claiming, finish within `--grace` (`graceMs`), put the rest back (attempt not spent); a second signal exits now |
| In the web process | `tvine start --with-worker [--concurrency n] [--beat]`: one job worker (and scheduler) inside the web server; with `--workers` > 1 only web worker 1 runs it; stop waits up to `graceMs` for running jobs |

## Import

```ts
import { defineTask, chain, group, chord, jobResult, revoke, Retry, JobFailed, SoftTimeLimit, HardTimeLimit } from 'tvine/tasks'
```

Also exported: `Worker`, `Beat`, `parseCron`, `nextFire`, `broker`, `setBroker`, `dbBroker`, `discoverTasks`,
`configureTasks`, `tasks`, `taskById`, `backoff`, `STATUSES`, `FINAL`, `OutboxRelay`, `ProgressRelay`.

## `defineTask`

```ts
defineTask<S extends ZodType, R>(name: string, fn: (args: z.infer<S>, ctx: TaskCtx) => R | Promise<R>, opts?: TaskOpts<S>): Task<S, R>
```

Export the task from `apps/<app>/tasks.ts`. Its id is `<app>.<name>` (`orders.sendReceipt`). `name` must match
`/^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/`. Using a task that was not discovered throws "task … was not discovered".

### `TaskOpts`

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `args` | zod schema | `z.unknown()` | args are validated when enqueued (bad args throw `invalid_param` in the caller) and again before running |
| `queue` | `string` | `'default'` | `/^[a-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/i` |
| `priority` | integer -100..100 | `0` | higher runs first, then older `runAt` |
| `maxRetries` | integer ≥ 0 | `3` | retries after the first attempt |
| `retryBackoff` | `false \| number \| { baseMs?, maxMs?, jitter? }` | `{ baseMs: 1000, maxMs: 600_000, jitter: true }` | wait before a retry: `false` = none, a number = fixed ms, an object = `min(maxMs, baseMs · 2^(attempt-1))`, jitter picks between half and all of it |
| `retryOn` | `(ErrorClass \| (e) => boolean)[]` | every error | only these errors retry |
| `dontRetryOn` | same | — | these never retry (wins over `retryOn`) |
| `timeoutMs` | `number \| { soft?, hard? }` | hard 300 000 | a number = hard limit. Soft: `ctx.signal` aborts with `SoftTimeLimit`. Hard: the attempt fails with `HardTimeLimit`. `soft` must be below `hard`. |
| `rateLimit` | `'<n>/s' \| '<n>/m' \| '<n>/h' \| { limit, windowMs }` | — | at most this many starts per window, per worker process |
| `unique` | `{ windowMs, key?: (args) => string }` | — | a second enqueue with the same key (default: the args) inside the window does not run; its job is `deduped` and follows the first |
| `expires` | ms | — | a job not started this long after enqueue becomes `expired` |
| `acks` | `'late' \| 'early'` | `'late'` | `late`: a job whose worker died is run again; `early`: it is marked `dead` instead |
| `durable` | `boolean` | `false` | enqueued inside a transaction → an outbox row in the same transaction (never lost); see Gotchas |
| `schedule` | `{ cron } \| { every }` + `{ args?, misfire?, graceMs? }` | — | periodic job, fired by the beat |
| `resultTtlMs` | ms | `settings.tasks.resultTtlMs` | how long a finished job (and its result) is kept |
| `logArgs` | `boolean` | `false` | log the (redacted) args at `job.start` |

### `TaskCtx`

| Member | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `jobId` | `string` | uuid |
| `task` | `string` | task id |
| `attempt` | `number` | 1-based |
| `queue` | `string` | |
| `signal` | `AbortSignal` | aborts on soft timeout, revoke, lost lease, shutdown. Pass it to `fetch`, check it in loops. |
| `parent` | `{ jobId, result }` | in a chain: the previous link |
| `progress(pct, message?)` | `Promise<void>` | 0–100; written at most every 250 ms (the last value always lands); sent live to the session that enqueued the job |
| `retry({ inMs? })` | `Retry` | `throw ctx.retry({ inMs: 5000 })` |
| `log(msg, data?)` | `void` | logs on `tvine.tasks` with the job's ids |

The handler's return value must be JSON (it is stored as the result); `undefined` is stored as `null`.

### A job's life

Statuses: `queued`, `running`, `success`, `dead`, `expired`, `cancelled`, `deduped`. Final ones: all but `queued`
and `running`. A failed attempt retries while `attempts <= maxRetries` and the error is retryable; then it is
`dead`. Throwing `Retry` (or `ctx.retry()`) always retries (still bounded by `maxRetries`). A job of an
unregistered task retries after 30 s. Args the schema refuses at run time → `dead`.

## Enqueueing

```ts
task.delay(args): Promise<{ pending: true; jobId }>
task.apply({ args, countdown?, eta?, priority?, queue?, expires?, owner? }): Promise<{ pending: true; jobId }>
```

| `apply` option | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `countdown` | ms | run no earlier than now + this |
| `eta` | `Date \| number` | run no earlier than this moment |
| `priority`, `queue` | | override the task's |
| `expires` | ms after enqueue, or a `Date` | override the task's |
| `owner` | `null` | a system job: no session / user, no progress events |

Inside a transaction (an action, `atomic()`), the job is pushed **after commit**: a rollback never enqueues. Outside
one it is pushed at once. The job remembers the session and user that enqueued it.

### Canvas: chain, group, chord

```ts
task.s(args?, { countdown?, priority?, queue? })   // a signature; in a chain it receives the previous result when args is omitted
task.si(args, opts?)                                 // immutable: always its own args
chain(sigA, sigB, sigC).delay()                      // one after another → { pending, jobId } of the first
group([sig1, sig2]).delay()                          // in parallel → { pending, groupId, jobIds }
chord([sig1, sig2], callbackSig).delay()             // callback gets the members' results in order, after ALL succeed
```

### Results and revoke

```ts
const r = jobResult(jobId)
await r.status()                          // JobStatus | undefined
await r.row()                             // the stored job row
await r.get({ timeoutMs: 30_000, pollMs: 200 })   // the result; throws JobFailed(jobId, status, reason) for a final non-success
await revoke(jobId)                       // queued → cancelled now; running → its signal aborts at the next heartbeat
```

Built-in actions (also MCP tools): `tasks.status({ jobId })` → `{ jobId, task, status, attempts, queue, progress,
message, result?, error?, createdAt, finishedAt? }` and `tasks.revoke({ jobId })` → `{ jobId, status }`. Only the
session or user that enqueued the job, or staff with `tasks.view_job` (status) / `tasks.change_job` (revoke), can see
a job; anyone else gets `not_found`. Args are never returned; non-staff see the error text only for `DomainError` /
`Retry`, otherwise `failed`. REST: `include('tvine.tasks.urls')` → `jobs/<uuid:jobId>/` and `jobs/<uuid:jobId>/revoke/`.

## Scheduled tasks (beat)

```ts
schedule: { cron: '0 3 * * *' }                 // 5 fields, UTC: min hour day-of-month month day-of-week
schedule: { every: 15 * 60_000, args: { full: false } }   // every n ms (>= 1000)
```

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `cron` | — | `*`, `a-b`, `*/n`, `a-b/n`, lists, `jan`–`dec`, `sun`–`sat`, `7` = Sunday, `@yearly @annually @monthly @weekly @daily @midnight @hourly` |
| `every` | — | interval in ms |
| `args` | — | must pass the task's `args` schema (checked at boot) |
| `misfire` | `'once'` | after downtime longer than `graceMs`: `'once'` = run one catch-up, `'skip'` = none, `'all'` = every missed run (max 100) |
| `graceMs` | `60_000` | lateness that still counts as on time |

Run the scheduler with `tvine worker --beat` (or `tvine start --with-worker --beat`). Several `--beat` workers are
safe and recommended for failover: one holds the scheduler lock (renewed every 10 s, 30 s lease), the others stand
by and take over within ~30 s when it dies (at once after a clean stop), and a fire time is never sent twice (a
compare-and-set in the broker). `tvine check` and the admin show the leader's name, or `scheduler off`. Schedules can also live in `config/tasks.ts` (or `settings.tasksModule`):

```ts
// config/tasks.ts
export const queues = ['default', 'mail']                     // the worker's default --queues
export const beatSchedule = { 'orders.closeStaleCarts': { cron: '*/30 * * * *' } }
```

`tvine.audit` ships `audit.prune` (daily 03:00) when installed.

## Commands

Every flag with its default: [cli.md](../../../cli.md#jobs) (or `tvine worker --help`).

| Command | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `tvine worker [--queues a,b] [--concurrency 10] [--beat] [--name x] [--grace ms]` | a job worker; `--queues '*'` (default, or `queues` in `config/tasks.ts`) = all; `--beat` = also the scheduler |
| `tvine start --with-worker [--concurrency 10] [--beat]` | a job worker inside the web process (small sites) |
| `tvine tasks list [--status s] [--queue q] [--limit 50]` | list jobs |
| `tvine tasks inspect <jobId>` | one job as JSON |
| `tvine tasks retry <jobId>` | requeue a `dead`, `expired` or `cancelled` job |
| `tvine tasks purge --dead` | delete dead jobs |
| `tvine tasks compact` | shrink the `file` broker's file |
| `tvine tasks bench [--jobs 5000] [--workers 4] [--batch 10]` | raw jobs/s of the configured broker |
| `tvine check` | `tasks: N job worker(s) running · M job(s) waiting · scheduler on (leader)\|off`; warns when jobs wait and no worker runs |

## Brokers

| `settings.tasks.broker` | Store | Use |
|---|---|---|
