```tsx
<Tooltip name="vat" content="Prices include 20% VAT"><span>ⓘ</span></Tooltip>
```

---

## Navigation

### Button

```ts
import { Button, type ButtonProps } from 'tvine/widgets'
```

Native `<button>`; with `pressed` / `defaultPressed` it is a toggle (`aria-pressed`). Kind `button`.
The slot props (`className`, `style`, `asChild`, `render`) are on the button itself.

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | required | |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | required | |
| `label` | `string` | text children, else `name` | |
| `intent` | `string` | — | Shown to agents as `intent: <x>`. |
| `type` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` | `'button'` | |
| `pressed` / `defaultPressed` / `onPressedChange` | `boolean` | — | Toggle mode. |
| `onClick` | `(e) => void` | — | |
| `className`, `style`, `asChild`, `render` | slot props | — | |

- State `{ pressed?, disabled }` (only `pressed` when a toggle). Control `click()`.
- No `action`/`bind` sugar here; call `api.*` in `onClick` (or use the server `Button` primitive inside a server `Form`).

```tsx
'use client'
import { Button } from 'tvine/widgets'
import { api } from 'tvine/api'
export function AddToCart({ productId }: { productId: number }) {
  return <Button name="add" onClick={async () => { const r = await api.cart.add({ productId, qty: 1 }); if (!r.ok) alert(r.message) }}>Add to cart</Button>
}
```

### Link

```ts
import { Link, type LinkProps } from 'tvine/widgets'
```

Native `<a href>`. Same-site left clicks go through the Next App Router (no full reload). Kind `link`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `href` | `string` | required | |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | required | |
| `name` | `string` | `href` | |
| `label` | `string` | text children, else `href` | |
| `current` | `boolean` | — | `aria-current=page`, state `{current:true}`. |
| `onClick` | `(e) => void` | — | |
| `className`, `style`, `asChild`, `render` | slot props | — | `asChild={<NextLink href=… />}` works. |

- Control `navigate()` only for same-site http(s) hrefs (off-site and `javascript:` links expose none).
  Headless: a plain GET of `href`.

### Pagination

```ts
import { Pagination, type PaginationProps } from 'tvine/widgets'
```

`<nav aria-label="Pagination">` of real links; shows first, last, current ±1 with ellipses. Kind `pagination`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page`, `pageCount` | `number` | required | 1-based. |
| `name` | `string` | `'pages'` | |
| `param` | `string` | `'page'` | Query param. |
| `query` | `string` | none | Current search string to keep, e.g. `"sort=price"`. |
| `hrefFor` | `(page) => string` | `?<param>=n` | Custom URLs (then there is no headless map). |
| `onPageChange` | `(page) => void` | — | |
| slots | `root item prev next ellipsis` | | |

- State `{ page, pageCount }`. Controls `page(to)`, `next()` (not on last), `prev()` (not on first).

```tsx
<Pagination page={page} pageCount={pages} query={`sort=${sort}`} />
```

### Tabs

```ts
import { Tabs, type TabItem, type TabsProps } from 'tvine/widgets'
```

APG tabs. Every panel is server-rendered (inactive ones `hidden inert`), so headless agents read all of them. Kind `tabs`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name`, `label` | `string` | required | |
| `items` | `{ value, label, content, disabled? }[]` | required | |
| `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange` | `string` | first enabled | |
| `url` | `string` | — | Query param for the active tab (headless). |
| `activation` | `'automatic' \| 'manual'` | `'automatic'` | Arrow keys select (automatic) or only move focus (manual). |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | |
| slots | `root list trigger panel` | | |

- State `{ value }`. Control `select(value)`.

```tsx
<Tabs name="product-info" label="Product information"
  items={[{ value: 'details', label: 'Details', content: <Details /> }, { value: 'reviews', label: 'Reviews', content: <Reviews /> }]} />
```

### Accordion

```ts
import { Accordion, type AccordionItem, type AccordionProps } from 'tvine/widgets'
```

APG accordion; closed panels are server-rendered `hidden`. Kind `accordion`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name`, `label` | `string` | required | |
| `items` | `{ value, label, content, disabled? }[]` | required | |
| `type` | `'single' \| 'multiple'` | `'single'` | |
| `collapsible` | `boolean` | `true` | In `single`, can the open item close. |
| `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange` | `string[]` | `[]` | Open items. |
| `url` | `string` | — | Headless map. |
| slots | `root item trigger panel` | | |

- State `{ open: string[] }`. Control `toggle(value, open?)`.

### Stepper

```ts
import { Stepper, type Step, type StepperProps } from 'tvine/widgets'
```

Multi-step flow: a progress list + one panel per step + Back / Next buttons. Kind `stepper`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name`, `label` | `string` | required | |
| `steps` | `{ value, label, content, validate?() }[]` | required | `validate` returns `{field: message}`, a string, or nothing (may be async). |
| `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange` | `string` | first step | |
| `linear` | `boolean` | `false` | Later steps are locked until earlier ones are done. |
| `url` | `string` | — | Headless map for `go`. |
| slots | `root list item panel prev next error` | | |

- State `{ value, done: string[] }`.
- Controls: `next()` (runs the current step's `validate`; a failure stays put and returns `invalid_param`
  with the first field), `prev()`, `go(step)` (reachable steps only).

```tsx
<Stepper name="checkout" label="Checkout" linear steps={[
  { value: 'address', label: 'Address', content: <AddressFields />, validate: () => (street ? undefined : { street: 'Enter a street' }) },
  { value: 'payment', label: 'Payment', content: <PaymentFields /> },
  { value: 'review', label: 'Review', content: <Review /> },
]} />
```

---

## Data display

### Card

```ts
import { Card, type CardProps } from 'tvine/widgets'
```

An entity card: `<article>` + heading. Its id **is** the global entity (`product:12`), so the same product
in a grid and in "recently viewed" is one agent node. Child widgets scope under it. Kind `card`. `Card` is
server-safe: it strips `hidden` keys before the client part, so they never reach the browser.

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | `string` | required | Global id, e.g. `product:12`. |
| `label` | `string` | required | Heading text and agent label. |
| `data` | `Record<string, unknown>` | required | What the agent reads about the entity. |
| `href` | `string` | — | Heading becomes a link; adds control `navigate()` for same-site hrefs. |
| `summary` | `string[]` | — | Data keys to show in the compact (L1) view. |
| `hidden` | `string[]` | — | Data keys removed before rendering (never sent to the client or agent). |
| `hooks` | `WidgetHooks` | — | |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | Body. |
| slots | `root title body` | | |

Card takes no `name`/`id`/`disabled`/`controls`/`presence` props.

```tsx
<Card entity={`product:${p.id}`} label={p.name} href={`/products/${p.slug}`}
  data={{ price: p.price, stock: p.stock, cost: p.cost }} hidden={['cost']}>
  <img src={p.image} alt="" /><AddToCart productId={p.id} />
</Card>
```

### CartBadge

```ts
import { CartBadge, type CartBadgeProps } from 'tvine/widgets'
```

A read-only cart count on `<a href>`. Id is always `cart:badge`; marked personal (the page snapshot is
not cached). Kind `cart-badge`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | `number` | required | |
| `total` | `string` | — | e.g. `"$42.00"`. |
| `href` | `string` | `'/cart'` | |
| `label` | `(n: number) => string` | `"Cart, n item(s)"` | Accessible name (a function, not a string). |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | — | |
| `onClick` | `(e) => void` | — | |
| slots | `root icon count` | | |

- State `{ count, total? }`. Control `navigate()`. `data-empty` at 0; `data-bumped` for 300 ms after a change.

### Table

```ts
import { Table, type TableColumn, type TableBulk, type TableProps } from 'tvine/widgets'
```

Native `<table>`. Sort, filter and next page are real links to ListView query params (`?sort=-price`,
`?status=paid`, `?cursor=…`), so a headless agent and a click land on the same URL. Each row registers
as an entity (`order:7`, kind `data`) under `list:rows`. Kind `table`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name`, `label` | `string` | required | `label` is the `<caption>`. |
| `rows` | `T[] \| Paginated<T>` | required | `Paginated` = `{ items, total?, pageSize, nextCursor? }` (what a ListView returns). |
| `rowId` | `(t: T) => string` | required | |
| `entity` | `string` | — | Row id prefix: `entity="order"` → rows `order:7`; without it rows are `row:7`. |
| `columns` | `TableColumn<T>[]` | required | `{ key, header, sortable?, filter?: 'text' \| { enum: string[] }, cell?(t) }`. Rows publish only column values. |
| `sort` / `onSortChange` | `{ column, dir: 'asc'\|'desc' }` | — | Current sort (from the URL). |
| `filters` / `onFiltersChange` | `Record<string, string>` | — | Current filters. |
| `selection` | `'none' \| 'single' \| 'multiple'` | `'none'` | Row checkboxes. |
| `selected` / `defaultSelected` / `onSelectedChange` | `string[]` | `[]` | |
| `bulk` | `TableBulk[]` | — | `{ name, label, action: ActionHandle, param? = 'ids', confirm?, onRun?(ids) }`. Without `onRun` the button submits the action with `{ [param]: ids }`. `confirm` asks the person with `window.confirm`. |
| `query` | `string` | — | Current search string kept in links. |
| `url` | `{ sort?, cursor?, filters? }` | `sort`, `cursor`, column key | Param names. |
| `virtual` | `{ rowHeight, height? }` | — | Render only the visible window (`height` default `rowHeight*10`). |
| slots | `root toolbar table header headerCell body row cell footer` | | |

- State `{ sort?, filters?, selected?, count, offset?, cursor? }`.
- Controls: `sort(by)` (`price` or `-price`, sortable columns only), `filter_<key>(value)` per filtered
  column, `next()` when there is a `nextCursor`, `select(rows[])` when selectable (rows must be on screen),
  `bulk_<name>(ids?)` per bulk action (defaults to the current selection; not listed when the action is
  agent-off), `scroll(to)` when `virtual`.

`rowId`, `cell` and the `on…` callbacks are functions, and functions cannot be passed from a server
component into a client component. So render `Table` from your own `'use client'` component and give it
the rows from the server:

```tsx
// components/orders-table.tsx
'use client'
import { Table } from 'tvine/widgets'
import type { Paginated } from 'tvine/weft'

type Order = { id: number; total: string; status: string }

export function OrdersTable({ rows, sort, status, query }: { rows: Paginated<Order>; sort?: string; status?: string; query: string }) {
  return (
    <Table name="orders" label="Orders" entity="order" rows={rows} rowId={(o) => String(o.id)} query={query}
      sort={sort ? { column: sort.replace(/^-/, ''), dir: sort.startsWith('-') ? 'desc' : 'asc' } : undefined}
      filters={{ status: status ?? '' }}
      columns={[
        { key: 'id', header: '#' },
        { key: 'total', header: 'Total', sortable: true, cell: (o) => <b>{o.total}</b> },
        { key: 'status', header: 'Status', filter: { enum: ['paid', 'shipped', 'refunded'] } },
      ]} />
  )
}

// app/orders/page.tsx (server component)
import { api, must } from 'tvine/api'
import { OrdersTable } from '../../components/orders-table'

export default async function Orders({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<Record<string, string | undefined>> }) {
  const sp = await searchParams
  const rows = must(await api.shop.orders({ sort: sp.sort, status: sp.status, cursor: sp.cursor }))   // a ListView
  const query = new URLSearchParams(Object.entries(sp).filter(([, v]) => v) as [string, string][]).toString()
  return <OrdersTable rows={rows as never} sort={sp.sort} status={sp.status} query={query} />
}
```

An agent sees `table:orders` with `sort(by: total|-total)`, `filter_status(value: paid|shipped|refunded)`,
`next()` when there is a next page, and rows `order:1`, `order:2` … with their column values.

`bulk` needs an `ActionHandle` from `bindAction(def)` (server only). See Gotchas.

### Carousel

```ts
import { Carousel, type CarouselProps, type CarouselSlide } from 'tvine/widgets'
```

CSS scroll-snap carousel. All slides are server-rendered and their data published, so agents read every
slide without moving it. Kind `carousel`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name`, `label` | `string` | required | |
| `slides` | `{ key, label, content, data? }[]` | required | `data` (JSON) is what agents read per slide (else `label`). |
| `index` / `defaultIndex` / `onIndexChange` | `number` | `0` | |
| `loop` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `autoplay` | `number` | — | Interval in ms. Pauses on hover/focus and while an agent acts; any manual move stops it; off under reduced motion. |
| slots | `root viewport slide prev next dot play` | | |

- State `{ index, count, playing? }`. Controls `set(index)`, `next()` / `prev()` (not at the ends unless
  `loop`), `toggle(on?)` when `autoplay`. No headless map (position is presentation).

### SortableList

```ts
import { SortableList, type SortableListProps } from 'tvine/widgets'
```

`<ul>` with keyboard move (Space grabs, arrows move, Space drops, Esc cancels) and native drag-and-drop.
Items are controlled: `onMove` must reorder them. Kind `list`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name`, `label` | `string` | required | |
| `items` | `T[]` | required | |
| `itemId` | `(t: T) => string` | required | |
| `onMove` | `(id, to) => void \| Promise<void>` | required | Called once with the final index. |
| `move` | `ActionHandle` | — | Headless: the server action taking `{id, to}`. |
| `children` | `(item: T) => ReactNode` | required | Row content. |
| slots | `root item` | | |

- State `{ count }`. Control `move(id, to)`.

### Tree

```ts
import { Tree, type TreeNode, type TreeProps } from 'tvine/widgets'
```

APG tree view; the whole tree is server-rendered (collapsed groups `hidden inert`). Kind `tree`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name`, `label` | `string` | required | |
| `nodes` | `{ id, label, children? }[]` | required | Static. |
| `expanded` / `defaultExpanded` / `onExpandedChange` | `string[]` | `[]` | |
| `selection` | `'none' \| 'single' \| 'multiple'` | `'single'` | |
| `selected` / `defaultSelected` / `onSelectedChange` | `string[]` | `[]` | |
| `url` | `string` | — | Query param for single selection (headless). |
| `render` | `(n) => ReactNode` | `n.label` | Label content (its own elements register normally). |
| slots | `root item toggle label group` | | |

- State `{ expanded, selected? }`. Controls (only over items whose parents are open): `open(item)`,
  `close(item)`, `select(item)` or `select(items[])` for multiple.

```tsx
<Tree name="categories" label="Categories" url="category"
  nodes={[{ id: 'men', label: 'Men', children: [{ id: 'men-shirts', label: 'Shirts' }] }, { id: 'women', label: 'Women' }]} />
```

---

## Feedback

### Toaster and `toast()`

```ts
import { Toaster, toast, type ToasterProps, type ToastItem, type ToastKind } from 'tvine/widgets'
```

`toast()` pushes to a module-level store; one `<Toaster>` renders them in a live region. Kind `toast`, id `toaster`.

```ts
toast(t: { title: string; description?: string; kind?: 'success' | 'error' | 'info'; duration?: number }): string   // returns the id
```

| `toast` option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `'info'` | `error` uses `role=alert`, others `role=status`. |
| `duration` | `5000` | ms before dismiss; `0` or `Infinity` = stays. |

| Toaster prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | `'toaster'` | |
| `label` | `string` | `'Notifications'` | |
| `max` | `number` | `5` | Toasts shown and kept in agent state. |
| slots | `root toast close` | | |

- State `{ items: ToastItem[] }` — dismissed toasts stay in the list flagged `dismissed: true`, so an agent
  does not miss a fast one. Control `close(id)` while any toast is open.

```tsx
// app/layout.tsx: <WeftRoot><Toaster />{children}</WeftRoot>
toast({ title: 'Added to cart', kind: 'success' })
```

### HumanOnly

Re-exported here from `tvine/weft`. Wrap anything only a person may operate. See [forms.md](forms.md#humanonly).

---

## Making your own widget

Use `defineWidget` (or `useWidget`) from `tvine/weft`; see [pages-and-regions.md](pages-and-regions.md).
The slot helpers used by the built-ins are exported:

```ts
part(tag: string, ownProps: Record<string, any>, slot: SlotProps<S> | undefined, state: S, children?: ReactNode): ReactElement
useControllable<T>(value: T | undefined, defaultValue: T): [T, (v: T) => void]   // controlled when value !== undefined
```

## Gotchas

- Any function prop (`onValueChange`, `isDisabled`, `format`, `itemValue`, `rowId`, `cell`, `validate`, `hooks`, `controls` functions…) only works when the widget is rendered from a `'use client'` component. A server component may render a widget with plain data props only.
- `name` is required on almost every widget and must be unique among siblings; it becomes the agent id.
- `label` must be non-empty (dev throws). For `Tooltip` the label is `content`; for `CartBadge`, `Pagination`, `Toaster` it is fixed.
- Controlled props (`value`, `checked`, `open`) need their `on…Change` handler, or the widget cannot change (agent included).
- A control that does not apply right now is simply missing (`dec` at `min`, `close` on a closed dialog, `clear` on a required select). Agents get `unknown_action`.
- `action` must be an `ActionHandle` made by `bindAction` in a server component; a client cannot sign it.
- `url` must be a bare query param name (`"color"`), not `"/shop?color"`.
- `Button`'s own `confirm` prop does not exist; server-side `rules.confirm` covers that (see [forms.md](forms.md#confirm-prompts)).
- `Table bulk[].action`, and the `action` prop of input widgets, need an `ActionHandle` from `bindAction(def, bind)`, which needs the action definition object. That object lives in `apps/<app>/views.ts`, and `tvine check` flags any file under `app/` or `components/` that imports `apps/`. Not covered: how app code is meant to obtain the definition without tripping that check (the repo's example app uses only `api.*` calls).
- Not covered: a per-control `confirm` field exists on the `Control` type (and Table `bulk.confirm` sets it), but the in-tab executor in this version does not prompt on it; only the person-side `window.confirm` in Table bulk buttons runs.

## See also

- [overview.md](overview.md), [forms.md](forms.md), [pages-and-regions.md](pages-and-regions.md), [agents-in-the-browser.md](agents-in-the-browser.md), [api-client.md](api-client.md)
- [../warp/views.md](../warp/views.md) — ListView params (`sort`, `cursor`, filters) the Table links to
- [../warp/actions.md](../warp/actions.md) — `rules.humanOnly`, `rules.confirm`, `readOnly`, `destructive`


# docs/reference/weft/forms.md

# Forms

## What it is

Weft has four ways to build a form, all agent-operable:

| Way | From | Use when |
|---|---|---|
| Plain HTML `<form>` + `api.*` in `onSubmit` | the Weft JSX runtime | the simplest case; inputs, selects and the form register by themselves |
| Built-in widgets (`Input`, `Select`, `Quantity`, …) inside a `<form>` | `tvine/widgets` | you want labels, errors, typed agent controls |
| Server `Form` / `Input` / `Button` primitives bound to an action definition | `tvine/weft` (server components) | a server-rendered form that submits through a Next server action into the same dispatcher agents use |
| `ModelForm` / `Field` driven by field meta | `tvine/forms` | Model forms (as in the admin's change form) with 40+ field kinds, client validation, inline formsets |

This page covers all four, plus validation, file uploads, `HumanOnly` and confirm prompts.

## Import

```ts
import { Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, RadioGroup, FileUpload, Button, HumanOnly } from 'tvine/widgets'
import { Form, Input as FormInput, Button as FormButton } from 'tvine/weft'          // server components only
import { ModelForm, Field, Fieldset, InlineFormset, registerFieldWidget, validate, validateField,
         fromApi, toPayload, fieldPayload, mapServerErrors, slugify } from 'tvine/forms'
import 'tvine/forms/forms.css'                                                      // optional default look
import { api, must, ApiError } from 'tvine/api'
```

---

## 1. Plain HTML form + `api.*`

With `jsxImportSource: "tvine/weft"` in `tsconfig.json`, plain elements register as widgets:

| Element | Agent kind | Controls |
|---|---|---|
| `<form>` | `form` | `submit()` (calls `requestSubmit()`, so your `onSubmit` runs) |
| `<input>` (text-like), `<textarea>` | `input`, `textarea` | `input(text, mode?)`, `clear()` |
| `<input type=checkbox>` / `role=switch` | `checkbox` / `switch` | `toggle(on?)` |
| `<input type=radio>` | `radio` | `select()` |
| `<select>` | `select` | `select(value)` / `select(values[])` |
| `<input type=range>` / `date` / `color` | `slider` / `date` / `color` | `set(value)` |
| `<input type=file>` | `file` | `upload(files[])` (one file unless `multiple`; 5 MB total) |
| `<button>`, `<a href>` | `button`, `link` | `click()`, `navigate()` |
| `<details>` | `disclosure` | `open()`, `close()` |

The id comes from `agentId`, then `name`, then `key`, then (links) `href`, then a slug of the text. Extra
props on any element: `agent={false}` (opt the subtree out), `agentId`, `agentLabel`, `agentSensitive`
(value never shown), `agentConfirm` (see Gotchas).

```tsx
'use client'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { api } from 'tvine/api'

export function Newsletter() {
  const router = useRouter()
  return (
    <form name="newsletter" onSubmit={async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault()
      const f = new FormData(e.currentTarget)
      const r = await api.shop.subscribe({ email: String(f.get('email')) })
      if (!r.ok) alert(r.message); else router.refresh()
    }}>
      <input name="email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" required />
      <button type="submit">Subscribe</button>
    </form>
  )
}
```

An agent sees `form:newsletter > input:email` (`input(text)`) and `form:newsletter > button:subscribe` (`click()`),
plus `form:newsletter` itself (`submit()`).

## 2. Built-in widgets in a form

Widgets render native fields with `name`, so `new FormData(form)` reads them. Pass `error` to show a field
error. A checkout form for a shop:

```tsx
'use client'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { Input, RadioGroup, Textarea, Checkbox } from 'tvine/widgets'
import { api } from 'tvine/api'

export function CheckoutForm() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({})
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('')
  return (
    <form name="checkout" onSubmit={async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault()
      const f = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.currentTarget))
      const r = await api.shop.checkout({ ...f, gift: f.gift === 'on' })
      if (r.ok) return router.push(r.goto ?? '/orders')
      setErrors(Object.fromEntries((r.errors ?? []).map((x) => [x.field, x.message])))
      setMessage(r.message)
    }}>
      <Input name="email" type="email" label="Email" autoComplete="email" required error={errors.email} />
      <Input name="street" label="Street" required error={errors.street} />
      <RadioGroup name="shipping" label="Shipping" defaultValue="standard"
        options={[{ value: 'standard', label: 'Standard' }, { value: 'express', label: 'Express' }]} />
      <Textarea name="note" label="Note for the courier" maxLength={200} showCount />
      <Checkbox name="gift" label="This is a gift" />
      {message && <p role="alert">{message}</p>}
      <button type="submit">Place order</button>
    </form>
  )
}
```

Agent ids: `form:checkout > input:email`, `… > radio:shipping`, `… > textarea:note`, `… > checkbox:gift`.

## 3. Server primitives bound to an action (`Form`, `Input`, `Button`)

Server components only (`tvine/weft` under `react-server`). The form submits through a Next server action
into the same dispatcher agents use, so a person's submit and an agent's `submit` are the same command.

```ts
function Form(props: {
  action: ActionDef; bind?: Record<string, unknown>; disabled?: boolean; agentId?: string; id?: string
  className?: string; children: ReactNode | ((scope: Scope) => ReactNode); scope?: Scope
}): JSX.Element
function Input(props: {
  name: string; type?: 'text' | 'number' | 'email' | 'date' | 'checkbox' | 'file'
  options?: { value: string; label: string }[]; defaultValue?: unknown; className?: string
  error?: ComponentType<{ message: string }>; scope?: Scope
}): JSX.Element
function Button(props: {
  intent?: string; disabled?: boolean; asChild?: boolean; children: ReactNode; className?: string
  action?: ActionDef; bind?: Record<string, unknown>; agentId?: string; scope?: Scope
}): JSX.Element
```

| `Form` prop | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `action` | required | The action definition (`{ id, schema, rules }`). |
| `bind` | — | Values fixed by the server (e.g. `{ productId: 12 }`), signed into a bind token so the client cannot change them. Bind-only params are not shown to agents. |
| `disabled` | `false` | Native `<fieldset disabled>`; agents get no submit control. Also off when every `Button` inside is disabled. |
| `agentId` | `form:<action.id>[:<bind values>]` | Agent id. Needed when several bind-less forms for the same action are on one page, or when `bind` has non-string/number values (dev throws). |
| `id`, `className` | — | DOM attributes of the `<form>`. |

| `Input` prop | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | Must be a param of the action's schema (dev warns otherwise). |
| `type` | `text` (default), `number`, `email`, `date`, `checkbox`, `file`. With `options` it renders a `<select>`. |
| `defaultValue` | Initial value (`defaultChecked` for checkbox). |
| `error` | A client component `({ message }) => …` for the field error; default `<p data-tvine-error>`. |

`Button`: a submit button. Inside a `Form` it submits that form; outside a `Form`, with `action` (and
`bind`), it becomes a one-button form. `intent` becomes the form's agent label. `asChild` puts the submit
behaviour on your own element.

How the submit works:

- `FormData` is coerced to the schema: numbers → `Number`, booleans → checkbox present, empty optional
  fields dropped, repeated names → the last value unless the param is an array.
- One `cmdId` per attempt, so a double click runs the handler once.
- A result with `errors` shows per-field messages (`FieldError`), `message` shows under the form
  (`<p data-tvine-message>`), `goto` is followed only to this site over http(s).
- `rules.confirm` on the action: the confirm dialog appears, then the same submit is resent with the token.

```tsx
// a server component
import { Form, Input, Button } from 'tvine/weft'
import { addToCart } from '../../apps/shop/views'   // see Gotchas: tvine check flags this import

<Form action={addToCart} bind={{ productId: product.id }}>
  <Input name="qty" type="number" defaultValue={1} />
  <Button intent="Add to cart">Add to cart</Button>
</Form>
```

The scope walk: `Form` finds `Input` / `Button` by walking its children. A primitive rendered inside your
own component is invisible to that walk; use render-prop children and pass `scope` on:

```tsx
<Form action={review}>{(scope) => <ReviewFields scope={scope} />}</Form>
```

## 4. `ModelForm` and `Field` (`tvine/forms`)

`ModelForm` renders a whole form from `FormMeta` (the shape the admin API emits: fieldsets, field meta,
inlines). Each field is a `Field` widget; agents speak **API shape** (`set({value: 12.5})`, `choose({value: 'paid'})`).

```ts
function ModelForm(props: ModelFormProps): JSX.Element
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `form` | `FormMeta` | required | `{ fieldsets: {title, classes?, fields}[], fields: Record<string, FieldMeta>, inlines?: InlineMeta[] }`. Empty `fieldsets` = all fields in one set. |
| `values` | `Record<string, unknown>` | — | Initial values, API shape. A new object resets the form. |
| `inlines` | `Record<string, Row[] \| { rows: Row[] }>` | — | Inline rows, API shape. |
| `onSubmit` | `(payload, { values, inlines }) => unknown` | required | Gets `toPayload(...)` (API shape). Throw / reject to show server errors (mapped like `errors`). Returning `{ ok: false, message }` shows that message to an agent. |
| `errors` | `unknown` | — | Server errors, any shape `mapServerErrors` reads. |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Every field shown as text; no controls. |
| `layout` | `'stacked' \| 'aligned'` | `'stacked'` | `aligned`: label beside input on wide screens. |
| `name` | `string` | `'model'` | Widget id `form:<name>`. |
| `label` | `string` | `name` | Agent label. |
| `model` | `string` | — | `'app.model'`, for per-field widget overrides and search. |
| `search` | `({ model, field, q, page }) => Promise<{ results: {pk,text}[], more }>` | — | fk / m2m autocomplete. |
| `uploadImage` | `(file, field) => Promise<string>` | — | Rich text image button: upload and return the URL. |
| `call` | `{ id: string; args? }` | — | Headless: the agent's `submit` maps to `do <id>` with `args` + the values. |
| `onDirtyChange` | `(dirty: boolean) => void` | — | |
| `actions` | `ReactNode \| (state) => ReactNode` | one Save button | Submit row. `state` = `{ isDirty, submitting, submit(), reset(), errors }`. |
| `top` | same | — | Extra row above the fields (e.g. a second Save). |
| `className`, `slots` | | | Slots: `root banner fieldset legend actions inline`. |

- Agent widget `form:<name>`: state `{ dirty, pending?, errors?, banner? }`, controls `submit()` and `reset()`.
- Fields: `form:<name> > field:<field>`; inline rows: `form:<name> > inline:<i> > row:<pk|newN> > field:<f>`.
- Inline widget `inline:<name>` (kind `list`): `add()` and `remove(row)`; state `{ rows, deleted, max, min }`.
- `slugAuto` fields follow their `from` field until someone edits them.
- Fieldset `classes: ['collapse']` renders a `<details>` that opens itself when it holds an error.

```tsx
'use client'
import { ModelForm, type FormMeta } from 'tvine/forms'
import 'tvine/forms/forms.css'
import { api, must } from 'tvine/api'

const form: FormMeta = {
  fieldsets: [{ title: null, fields: ['name', 'price', 'status', 'image'] }],
  fields: {
    name: { name: 'name', label: 'Name', kind: 'text', required: true, readOnly: false, nullable: false, maxLength: 80 },
    price: { name: 'price', label: 'Price', kind: 'money', required: true, readOnly: false, nullable: false, currency: 'USD' },
    status: { name: 'status', label: 'Status', kind: 'choice', required: true, readOnly: false, nullable: false,
      choices: [{ value: 'draft', label: 'Draft' }, { value: 'live', label: 'Live' }] },
    image: { name: 'image', label: 'Photo', kind: 'image', required: false, readOnly: false, nullable: true,
      upload: { accept: 'image/*', maxBytes: 2_000_000 } },
  },
}

export function ProductForm({ values }: { values?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  return <ModelForm name="product" label="Product" form={form} values={values}
    onSubmit={async (payload) => must(await api.shop.saveProduct(payload as Record<string, unknown>))} />
}
```

`must` throws an `ApiError` on failure; `ModelForm` catches it, maps `field` / `errors` onto the fields,
and shows the rest in the banner.

### `Field`

```ts
function Field(props: FieldProps): JSX.Element
```

| Prop | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `meta` | `FieldMeta` | The field (see below). |
| `value` / `onChange` | form shape | See "Value shapes". |
| `error` | `string` | Error text. |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | Text display, no controls (also when `meta.readOnly`). |
| `search` | `(q, page) => Promise<{results, more}>` | fk / m2m. |
| `model` | `string` | `'app.model'` for overrides. |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | Label for screen readers only. |
| `uploadImage` | `(file) => Promise<string>` | rich text. |
| `controls` | overrides | Same override rules as widgets. |
| `className`, `slots` | | Slots: `root label control help error`. |

Widget id `field:<name>`; state `{ kind, value?, filled?, invalid? }` (password / otp / signature show only
`filled`; long text is cut to 400 chars + length; files show `{name, type, size}`).

### `FieldMeta`

| Key | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `name`, `label`, `kind` | | required |
| `required`, `readOnly`, `nullable` | `boolean` | required |
| `help` | `string` | Help text (also an agent summary line). |
| `default` | `unknown` | Used for new inline rows. |
| `choices` | `{value,label}[]` | choice, tags, checkboxes, segmented, currency, fk/m2m listed rows. |
| `min`, `max`, `maxLength`, `decimals`, `step` | `number` | Bounds. `max` on tags / m2m / list = most items. |
| `currency` | `string` | money: fixed currency. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | choice (multi), range (two thumbs). |
| `relation` | `{ model, autocomplete, rawId }` | fk / m2m. `rawId`: type the pk. `autocomplete: false` + `choices`: a plain list. |
| `upload` | `{ accept, maxBytes }` | file / image. |
| `prefix`, `suffix` | `string` | Adornments (`$`, `kg`). |
| `palette` | `string[]` | color presets. |
| `language` | `string` | code: `json js sql html css`. |
| `from` | `string` | slugAuto source field. |
| `of` | `Partial<FieldMeta>` | list item kind (default text). |
| `free` | `boolean` | tags with choices: free text allowed too. |
| `humanOnly` | `boolean` | Lock the field for agents (signature is locked by default; `false` unlocks `clear`). |
| `allowRemoteImages` | `boolean` | rich: keep http(s) images. |

### Field kinds and agent controls

Every kind has `set(value)` and `clear()` (signature: only `clear`, and only when `humanOnly: false`).
Extra controls:

| Kind | Widget | Extra controls / notes |
|---|---|---|
| `text` `email` `url` `slug` `uuid` | native input | |
| `textarea` | textarea | |
| `int` `decimal` | number input | `set` takes a number |
| `money` | amount + currency | `set(value, currency?)` |
| `bool` | switch checkbox (nullable: Unknown/Yes/No select) | |
| `date` `datetime` `time` | native pickers | |
| `duration` | `HH:MM:SS` text | |
| `json` | code editor + live parse error | `set` takes JSON |
| `choice` | dropdown (multi-select when `multiple`) | `choose(value)` |
| `fk` | searchable dropdown / raw id | `search(q, page?)`, `choose(value)` |
| `m2m` | multi-select | `search(q, page?)`, `add(value)`, `remove(value)` |
| `file` `image` | drop zone + preview | `upload(file: {name, type, dataBase64})` (`set` refuses files) |
| `password` | show/hide input | `set` (secret: masked in logs) |
| `rich` | rich text editor | `set(value, format?: markdown\|html)`, `append(markdown)`, `read()` → markdown |
| `color` | color + hex + palette | `set('#rrggbb')` |
| `range` | slider (two thumbs when `multiple`) | |
| `phone` | country code + tel | `set('+15551234567')` (E.164) |
| `search` `month` `week` `ip` `slugAuto` | native input | |
| `tags` | chips | `add(value)`, `remove(value)` |
| `checkboxes` | checkbox list | `add`, `remove`, `toggle(value)` |
| `switch` | role=switch | `toggle()` |
| `segmented` | segmented radios | `choose(value)` |
| `rating` | stars | `set(1..max)` |
| `otp` | N digit cells | secret |
| `markdown` | textarea + toolbar + preview | `append(markdown)`, `read()` |
| `code` | editor with highlight | `read()` |
| `daterange` | two dates | `set({start, end})` |
| `country` | filter + ISO 3166 select | `choose(code)` |
| `address` | line1, line2, city, region, postal, country | `set({line1, city, country, …})` |
| `keyvalue` | editable rows | `add(key, value)`, `remove(key)` |
| `list` | rows of `meta.of` | `add(value)`, `remove(index)` |
| `signature` | canvas → PNG | human only by default |
| `currency` | ISO 4217 select | `choose(value)` |
| `percent` | number + % | |

Every control validates with `validateField` before it changes anything, so an agent gets exactly the
message a person would see (`invalid_param`, `field: "value"`).

### Custom field widgets

```ts
registerFieldWidget(key: FieldKind | `${app}.${model}.${field}`, widget: ComponentType<FieldWidgetProps>): () => void
```

`registerFieldWidget('money', MyMoney)` replaces the widget for every money field;
`registerFieldWidget('shop.order.status', StatusPicker)` for one field of one model (wins over the kind).
It returns an unregister function. The widget gets `{ meta, value, onChange, id, name, invalid, describedBy, readOnly, search?, model?, uploadImage? }`.
Agent controls stay those of the kind.

### Value shapes

Widgets edit **form shape**; the API takes **API shape**. `fromApi(meta, v)` converts API → form;
`fieldPayload(meta, v)` / `toPayload(form, values, inlines?)` convert form → API.

| Kind | Form shape | API shape |
|---|---|---|
| text-like, date, time, choice | `string` (`''` = empty) | same; choice multiple `string[]` |
| int, decimal, percent | `string` | `number` (`null` when empty) |
| money | `{ amount: string, currency }` | `{ value: number, currency }` |
| datetime | local `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` | ISO string (UTC) |
| duration | `[D ]HH:MM[:SS]` | seconds |
| json | text | parsed JSON |
| fk / m2m | `{pk, text}` / `{pk, text}[]` | pk / pk[] |
| file / image | `File` (new) or the stored value | `File`; `null` clears; the stored value is left out (unchanged) |
| keyvalue | `{key, value}[]` | object |

## Validation

Client side (`tvine/forms`):

```ts
validateField(meta: FieldMeta, value: any): string | undefined        // one field, the standard messages
validate(fields: Record<string, FieldMeta>, values: Record<string, any>): Record<string, string>
```

Messages: `This field is required.`, `Enter a valid email address.`, `Ensure this value is
less than or equal to 10.`, `Select a valid choice. x is not one of the available choices.`, and so on.
`ModelForm` validates on submit and then live after the first submit attempt.

Server errors → fields:

```ts
mapServerErrors(err: unknown): { fields: Record<string, string>; nonField: string[] }
```

Reads an `ApiError`, an `{ ok: false, field?, message, errors? }` result, an array of those, a
`{ fields | errors: Record<field, string | string[]> }` envelope, or a bare record. `__all__`,
`nonField`, `non_field_errors` or no field go to `nonField`. Inline keys: `<inline>.<i>.<field>` or `<inline>[i].<field>`.

With `api.*` directly: a failed call is `{ ok: false, code: 'invalid_param', field?, errors?: [{ field, code?, message }], message }`
(every bad field is in `errors`; `field` is the first). See [api-client.md](api-client.md).

## File uploads

Three pieces exist:

1. **`FileUpload` widget** (`tvine/widgets`) — the picker, with `accept`, `maxBytes`, `maxFiles`; agent
   `upload(files: {name, type, dataBase64}[])`, total agent upload capped at 5 MB. See [widgets.md](widgets.md#fileupload).
2. **`file` / `image` fields** in `ModelForm` — value is a `File`; `toPayload` keeps it as a `File`.
3. **The server endpoint** `/tvine/api/<id>` accepts `multipart/form-data` with one `params` JSON part
   plus file parts, only for actions that declare `multipart`, only for a signed-in user, same-origin, with
   the `x-tvine-api: 1` header. Size limits come from the action's `multipart.maxBytes` / `partBytes`.

`api.*` in the browser always sends JSON (`JSON.stringify` cannot carry a `File`). To send a file, post
multipart yourself:

```ts
async function uploadPhoto(productId: number, file: File) {
  const body = new FormData()
  body.append('params', JSON.stringify({ productId }))
  body.append('photo', file)
  const r = await fetch('/tvine/api/shop.uploadPhoto', {
    method: 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin', headers: { 'x-tvine-api': '1' }, body,
  })
  return r.json()   // an ApiResult
}
```

Not covered: how the action reads the file parts (that is the backend side — see [../warp/actions.md](../warp/actions.md)),
and the file-part naming the server expects. The server `Input type="file"` primitive renders a native
file input only ("upload wiring lands with media" in the source).

## HumanOnly

```ts
import { HumanOnly } from 'tvine/weft'   // also from 'tvine/widgets'
function HumanOnly(props: { reason: string; children?: ReactNode }): JSX.Element
```

Everything inside is shown to agents as locked (`ho: <reason>`, no controls) and the in-tab executor
refuses it with `human_only` before any hook runs. In the browser, untrusted events (`el.click()`,
`dispatchEvent`, WebMCP, page scripts) never reach the subtree's handlers. Empty `reason` →
`"only a human can do this"`. The innermost `HumanOnly` wins. It renders a `display: contents` div.

This is a UI guard. The security guard is the action's `rules.humanOnly` (dispatch refuses agents on every
path: `do`, MCP, HTTP). In dev, a `HumanOnly` wrapping a control bound to an action without `humanOnly`
logs a warning.

```tsx
<HumanOnly reason="Payment must be confirmed by you">
  <Button name="pay" onClick={pay}>Pay $42.00</Button>
</HumanOnly>
```

Known limit (from the source): React portals leave the DOM subtree, so a portal inside `HumanOnly` is not
covered by the event block (it still inherits the locked flag through context).

## Confirm prompts

Server `rules.confirm` on an action makes the first call return `{ ok: false, code: 'confirm_required', confirm: { token, message, summary, expiresIn, by } }`.
What Weft does with it:

| Caller | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| A person via `api.*` in the browser or a server `Form` | `<WeftRoot>`'s confirm dialog (a `Dialog` named `tvine-confirm`) shows `message` and `summary` with Cancel / Confirm; Confirm resends once with `params.$confirm = token`. Without `WeftRoot`, `window.confirm` is used. |
| Cancel | Result `{ ok: false, code: 'confirm_required', reason: 'cancelled', message: 'Cancelled: nothing was done.' }`. Nothing ran. |
| An in-tab agent (a WebMCP step) | The `confirm_required` result goes back to the agent; no dialog. |
| The Confirm button | Wrapped in `HumanOnly`: scripts and agents cannot click it. |

Replace the dialog: `setConfirmHandler(async (ask) => boolean)` from `tvine/api` (one handler per page;
`<WeftRoot>` sets its own on mount).

## Gotchas

- `ModelForm`, `Field`, every widget with a function prop: client components only.
- The server `Form` / `bindAction` path needs the action definition object from `apps/<app>/views.ts`, and
  `tvine check` fails on any file under `app/` or `components/` that imports `apps/`. Not covered: how a
  project is meant to pass that object to `Form` without tripping the check. Plain forms + `api.*` avoid it.
- `Input` (server primitive) outside a `Form`, or inside a component the `Form` cannot see: dev logs an
  error and agents will not see it. Use render-prop children.
- A schema param that should keep every value of a repeated field must be an array (`z.array(...)`), else
  the last value wins.
- `agentConfirm` on plain elements is stored on the control, but the in-tab executor in this version does
  not show a prompt for it (Not covered: its intended behaviour). Use `rules.confirm` on the action.
- Agents type values instantly by default (no per-char animation) unless `<WeftRoot presence={{ typing: 'animate' }}>`.

## See also

- [widgets.md](widgets.md) — every input widget's props and controls
- [api-client.md](api-client.md) — results, errors, confirm, auth
- [pages-and-regions.md](pages-and-regions.md) — scope walk, ids
- [../warp/actions.md](../warp/actions.md) — `rules.humanOnly`, `rules.confirm`, `multipart`, schemas
- [../warp/views.md](../warp/views.md) — ListView / generated create and update actions


# docs/reference/weft/api-client.md

# The `api.*` client

## What it is

`tvine/api` is the frontend's only data path. `api.<app>.<name>(params)` calls the backend action whose id
is `<app>.<name>` (a function view, an `@action` method, or a ListView's generated `list` / `get` /
`create` / `update` / `delete`). It never throws: it returns an `ApiResult`. The same import works in
server components (in-process dispatch, or signed HTTP to a separate API server) and in client components
(a same-origin POST with the session cookie). Types come from a generated `tvine-api.d.ts`.

## Import

```ts
import { api, must, ApiError, currentUser, UserProvider, useUser,
         type ApiResult, type ApiCall, type ApiOpts, type ErrCode, type FieldError, type CurrentUser } from 'tvine/api'
```

`tvine/api` resolves by condition: the `react-server` build (server components, server actions) is
`server-only`; every other bundle gets the browser build. Same names in both.

## Calling an action

```ts
interface ApiCall<P = Record<string, unknown>, R = unknown> {
  (params?: P, opts?: ApiOpts): Promise<ApiResult<R>>
  readonly id: string                          // e.g. 'shop.addToCart'
}
interface ApiOpts { cmdId?: string; bind?: string; signal?: AbortSignal }

type ApiResult<T = unknown> =
  | { ok: true; data: T; goto?: string }
  | { ok: false; code: ErrCode; reason?: string; field?: string; errors?: FieldError[]; message: string; retryAfterMs?: number; confirm?: ConfirmAsk }

interface FieldError { field: string; code?: string; message: string }
```

| `ApiOpts` | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `cmdId` | Idempotency key: a retry with the same `cmdId` does not run the action twice. |
| `bind` | A signed bind token (from a server-side `bindAction`) for actions with `rules.bind`. |
| `signal` | `AbortSignal` to cancel the request. |

| `ErrCode` | When |
|---|---|
| `invalid_param` | Bad params. `errors` lists every bad field; `field` is the first. |
| `unknown_action` | No such action id. |
| `stale_bind` | The bind token is wrong / expired. |
| `stale_rev` | The page changed since the agent read it. |
| `expired_sid` | Session gone. |
| `rate_limited` | Too many calls; `retryAfterMs` says when to retry. |
| `conflict` | A write conflict. |
| `domain` | Refused by the app; `reason` says why (e.g. `forbidden`, `not_found`). |
| `internal` | Server error, or `reason: 'network'` when the request did not reach the server. |
| `human_only` | The action has `rules.humanOnly` and the caller is an agent. |
| `confirm_required` | The action has `rules.confirm`; see "Confirm". |

### `must`

```ts
function must<T>(r: ApiResult<T>, o?: { notFound?: boolean }): T
```

Returns `r.data`, or throws `ApiError` (`code`, `reason`, `field`, `errors`, `message`). With
`{ notFound: true }`, a result with `reason: 'not_found'` throws Next's 404 instead (the page renders
`not-found.tsx`).

```ts
class ApiError extends Error { code: ErrCode; reason?: string; field?: string; errors?: FieldError[] }
```

## Server components

```tsx
// app/products/[id]/page.tsx
import { Page } from 'tvine/weft'
import { api, must } from 'tvine/api'

type Product = { id: number; name: string; price: string; description: string }

export default async function ProductPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params
  const p = must(await api.shop.get({ id: Number(id) }), { notFound: true }) as Product
  return (
    <Page name="product" title={p.name}>
      <h1>{p.name}</h1>
      <p>{p.price}</p>
      <p>{p.description}</p>
    </Page>
  )
}
```

How the server build reaches the backend:

| Setup | Transport |
|---|---|
| `tvine dev` / `tvine start` (one process) | In-process dispatch. No HTTP. |
| Frontend separate from a `tvine start --api-only` server | HTTP POST to `TVINE_API_URL` + `/tvine/api/<id>`, with the caller's session cookie, IP and agent flag in a signed `x-tvine-forward` header (HMAC with the first key of `TVINE_SECRET`, valid 30 s). A session cookie minted by the API server is set on the response. |
| Neither | Throws: `tvine/api: no backend. Run the app with tvine start/tvine dev …` |

Env used by the split mode: `TVINE_API_URL`, `TVINE_SECRET` (comma list; first signs),
`TVINE_COOKIE_NAME`, `TVINE_HEADER` (default `x-tvine`), `TVINE_TRUST_PROXY` (number of trusted proxy hops
for the client IP; else `unknown`), `TVINE_SESSION_SECURE`, `TVINE_SESSION_SAMESITE` (default `lax`),
`TVINE_SESSION_TTL_S` (default 86400). The cookie is `__Host-tvine_s` when secure (production by default),
else `tvine_s`.

## Client components

```tsx
'use client'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { Button, toast } from 'tvine/widgets'
import { api } from 'tvine/api'

export function AddToCart({ productId }: { productId: number }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  return (
    <Button name="add" onClick={async () => {
      const r = await api.cart.add({ productId, qty: 1 })
      if (!r.ok) return toast({ title: r.message, kind: 'error' })
      toast({ title: 'Added to cart', kind: 'success' })
      router.refresh()                // re-render server components with the new cart
    }}>Add to cart</Button>
  )
}
```

The browser build POSTs `{ params, bind?, cmdId? }` as JSON to `/tvine/api/<id>` with
`credentials: 'same-origin'` and the header `x-tvine-api: 1` (which forces a CORS preflight from other
sites). The session cookie is httpOnly: no session id is ever readable from JS. A network failure returns
`{ ok: false, code: 'internal', reason: 'network', message }`.

## Generated types: `tvine-api.d.ts`

```bash
tvine generate            # write tvine-api.d.ts in the project root
tvine generate --check    # exit 1 when it is stale (CI)
```

`tvine dev` regenerates it on every change to `apps/*/views` / serializers. The file is type queries only
(`typeof import('./apps/shop/views.js')`), so it never pulls models into the frontend bundle:

```ts
// generated by tvine generate — do not edit
import type { ApiCall } from 'tvine/api'
import type { ActionIn, ActionOut, ViewIn, ViewOut } from 'tvine/types'
type Shop = typeof import('./apps/shop/views.js')
declare module 'tvine/api' {
  interface ApiManifest {
    shop: {
      "addToCart": ApiCall<ActionIn<Shop["addToCart"]>, ActionOut<Shop["addToCart"]>>
      "list": ApiCall<ViewIn<Shop["Products"], "list">, ViewOut<Shop["Products"], "list">>
    }
  }
}
export {}
```

| Action kind | Params type | Result type |
|---|---|---|
| Function view (`defineAction`) | `z.input` of its schema | what `run` resolves to |
| `@action` method on a class view | the method's first param | what it resolves to |
| ListView `list` | `{ q?, sort?, cursor?, [filter]: unknown }` | `Paginated<Record<string, unknown>>` |
| ListView `get` / `create` / `update` | `Record<string, unknown>` | `Record<string, unknown>` |
| ListView `delete` | `Record<string, unknown>` | `null` |

When the same action name is used by several view classes in one app, the key becomes `<Class>.<name>`.
List rows are untyped: cast them (`must(await api.shop.list({})).items as Product[]`). Values are JSON on
the wire (a `Date` arrives as a string). Without the generated file, `api` is typed loosely as
`Record<string, Record<string, ApiCall>>`.

## Auth and session

```ts
currentUser(): Promise<CurrentUser | null>
interface CurrentUser { id: string; username: string; email: string | null; isStaff: boolean; isSuperuser: boolean }
function UserProvider(props: { user: CurrentUser | null; children?: ReactNode }): JSX.Element
function useUser(): CurrentUser | null
```

`currentUser()` calls `auth.me` through the same api path (never the ORM). `null` when signed out, when
`tvine.auth` is not installed, or on any error. On the server it is deduped per render (React `cache`).
Pass it to client components with `UserProvider`:

```tsx
// app/layout.tsx
import { WeftRoot } from 'tvine/weft'
import { currentUser, UserProvider } from 'tvine/api'

export default async function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <html lang="en"><body>
    <WeftRoot><UserProvider user={await currentUser()}>{children}</UserProvider></WeftRoot>
  </body></html>
}

// components/account-link.tsx
'use client'
import { useUser } from 'tvine/api'
export function AccountLink() {
  const user = useUser()
  return user ? <a href="/account">{user.username}</a> : <a href="/login">Sign in</a>
}
```

Sign-in / sign-out are ordinary actions (e.g. `api.auth.login(...)`, `api.auth.logout({})`), see
the `tvine.auth` app's actions in [../warp/actions.md](../warp/actions.md). Not covered here: their exact params.

## Confirm

When an action has `rules.confirm`, the first call returns `code: 'confirm_required'` with
`confirm: { token, message, summary, expiresIn, by: 'anyone' | 'human' }`. In the browser, `api.*`
handles it for a person: it asks (the `<WeftRoot>` dialog, else `window.confirm`), and on yes resends once
with `params.$confirm = token` and a new `cmdId` (`<cmdId>.c`). Cancel returns
`{ ok: false, code: 'confirm_required', reason: 'cancelled', message: 'Cancelled: nothing was done.' }`.
The server build never confirms on its own: it returns the `confirm_required` result.

```ts
setConfirmHandler(fn?: (ask: ConfirmAsk) => Promise<boolean>): void   // replace the dialog (undefined = default)
askConfirm(ask: ConfirmAsk): Promise<boolean>
confirmed(r, resend: (token) => Promise<R>): Promise<R>              // the ask-then-resend step, reusable
```

## Agent marking

The server always knows whether a call came from an agent:

| Call | Marked as |
|---|---|
| A person's click → `api.*` | human |
| A WebMCP agent's step runs a control whose handler calls `api.*` | agent (`via: 'webmcp'`): while a step runs, the browser build adds `agentCmd: { via }` to the body |
| A remote agent driving the tab, or the dev gallery's "try it as agent": the executor's own posts (a control bound to a server action, the `do` tool) | agent (`agentCmd: { via: 'channel' \| 'inspector' }`) |
| A remote agent driving the tab: `api.*` calls made by *your* handlers during its step | **agent** — the browser does not add the mark, but the server marks every request of the session as agent while a forwarded command runs (and a short time after), whatever the client sends (`asAgent` in warp `core/dispatch.ts`) |
| A server component rendered for an agent's snapshot | agent (split mode forwards the agent flag from `x-tvine` / the tvine `Accept` header) |

The marker is downgrade-only: page code can mark its own call as agent, never turn an agent call into a
human one. `rules.humanOnly`, `denyAgents` and `mcp: false` are enforced on the server for agent calls.

## Lower-level exports

| Export | Build | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `makeApi(transport)` | both | Build an `api` proxy over your own `Transport = (id, params, opts) => Promise<ApiResult>`. |
| `browserTransport` | browser | The default browser transport. |
| `agentVia()` | browser | The current agent mark (`'webmcp'`) while an agent step runs, else `undefined`. |
| `serverTransport`, `forwardTransport({ url, secret, cookieName?, header?, next? })`, `signForward(payload, secret, now?)` | server | The server transports and the forward header signer. |
| `network(e)` | both | The `internal/network` result for a caught error. |

## Gotchas

- `api.*` never throws (except the server build with no backend configured). Check `r.ok`, or use `must`.
- After a mutation in a client component, call `router.refresh()` yourself; `api.*` does not.
- `api.*` sends JSON only; for file uploads post `multipart/form-data` yourself (see [forms.md](forms.md#file-uploads)).
- Do not import `apps/**`, models or the ORM in frontend files; `tvine check` fails. `import type` is fine.
- During a remote-tab agent step the browser does not mark your handlers' `api.*` calls, but the server does: while a forwarded command runs in a tab of the session, every request of that session is an agent request, so `rules.humanOnly` still refuses them. (Per session, not per tab: a person acting in another tab of the same session at that moment is treated as agent too, which is stricter, never looser.)
- `currentUser()` returns `null` on any error, not only when signed out.
- `api` is a Proxy: `api.shop.foo` exists for any name; a wrong name fails at call time with `unknown_action` (types catch it once `tvine-api.d.ts` is generated).

## See also

- [forms.md](forms.md) — submitting forms, validation errors, uploads, confirm
- [agents-in-the-browser.md](agents-in-the-browser.md) — how agent calls reach the server
- [overview.md](overview.md) — the frontend boundary
- [../warp/actions.md](../warp/actions.md), [../warp/views.md](../warp/views.md) — defining the actions `api.*` calls


# docs/reference/weft/pages-and-regions.md

# Pages, regions and custom widgets

## What it is

This page covers the primitives that structure what an agent sees: the server primitives `Page`,
`Section`, `Data`, `List`, `Link` (they emit `<script type="text/tvine">` fragments for headless agents),
the client contract `useWidget` / `defineWidget` / `WidgetScope` for making your own components
agent-readable, how ids are built, the auto-registration props of the Weft JSX runtime, progressive
disclosure (what an agent reads at L0 / L1 / full and how `expand` works), and live updates.

## Import

```ts
// server components (react-server build of tvine/weft)
import { Page, Section, Data, List, Link, registerAgent, useAgent, register, registerLink, pageFragment, bindAction } from 'tvine/weft'
// client components
import { useWidget, defineWidget, WidgetScope, useWidgetScope, useAgent, useTvineChannel, AgentBadge, AgentSuspense, WeftError,
         type WidgetSpec, type Control, type ControlCtx, type ParamSpec, type WidgetHooks } from 'tvine/weft'
```

---

## Server primitives

They work in server components only. Each scoping primitive (`Page`, `Section`, `Form`, `List`) walks the
JSX it was handed and passes a `scope` prop to every primitive it finds, which is how ids get their
prefix (`section:cart > form:shop.checkout`). Primitives rendered inside your own component are not seen
by that walk: use render-prop children `{(scope) => <Custom scope={scope} />}` and forward `scope`. Dev
warns when a container saw only components.

### Page

```ts
function Page(props: { name: string; title?: string; personal?: boolean; live?: boolean; children: ReactNode | ((scope: Scope) => ReactNode) }): JSX.Element
```

| Prop | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | required | Page id for agents (e.g. `product`). |
| `title` | `name` | Page title in the agent snapshot. This is not the document `<title>`; set that with Next `metadata`. In-tab reads use `document.title`. |
| `personal` | `false` | The page shows per-session content: never cached or shared. |
| `live` | `false` | The page changes without a write the server sees (time, another system): never cached, but not per-session. |

A route has exactly one `Page`; a literally nested `Page` throws in dev.

### Section

```ts
function Section(props: { name: string; as?: ElementType; className?: string; children: ReactNode | ((scope: Scope) => ReactNode) }): JSX.Element
```

Registers a node `section:<name>` and scopes everything inside under it. Renders `<section>` (or `as`).
Client widgets inside get the parent id too (`section:cart > button:checkout`).

### Data

```ts
function Data(props: { type: string; value: Record<string, unknown>; agentId?: string; personal?: boolean; live?: boolean; children?: ReactNode }): JSX.Element
```

An entity node: id `<type>:<value.id | value.key>`, or `agentId`. `value` is what the agent reads. Client
widgets inside are scoped under the **global** entity id (`product:12 > button:add`). Renders no element.

### List

```ts
function List<T>(props: {
  name: string; items: T[] | Paginated<T>; query?: URLSearchParams | Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>
  children: (item: T, i: number, scope: Scope) => ReactNode; as?: ElementType; className?: string
}): JSX.Element
```

Registers `list:<name>` with `{ name, count, pageSize?, nextCursor? }`. With a `Paginated` value only the
first `pageSize` rows register for agents (people still see all), and a `list:<name>:next` link is
added that keeps `query` and replaces `cursor`. Renders `<ul>` (or `as`).

### Link (server)

```ts
function Link(props: { href: string; label?: string; params?: string[]; personal?: boolean; live?: boolean; agentId?: string; as?: ElementType; children?: ReactNode; [k: string]: unknown }): JSX.Element
```

Registers `link:<href>` (or `agentId`) with the label (plain-text children, else `label`; dev throws when
neither). `as={NextLink}` for client navigation. `javascript:` / `data:` / `vbscript:` hrefs are not
exposed. Other props go to the rendered element.

### registerAgent / useAgent (server)

```ts
registerAgent(type: string, spec: AgentSpec): ReactElement      // also exported as useAgent on the server
interface AgentSpec { id?: string; data: Record<string, unknown>; actions?: { def: ActionDef; bind?: Record<string, unknown> }[]; personal?: boolean; live?: boolean }
```

Returns the fragment element; render it. Id is `<type>:<data.id | data.key>` unless `id` is given (throws
when neither exists). Low-level: `register(node)`, `registerLink(link, flags)`, `pageFragment({ page, title, personal?, live? })`.

### bindAction (server)

```ts
bindAction(def: ActionDef, bind?: Record<string, unknown>): ActionHandle
// ActionHandle = { id, params, bind, agent, ro?, danger?, attention?, humanOnly? } — plain JSON, safe to pass to a client component
```

Signs `bind` (with the action id inside, so a bind for A cannot be replayed on B) and lists the params
agents may send (bind-only params are hidden). `agent: false` when the action is `mcp: false` or
`denyAgents`. `ro`, `danger`, `attention`, `humanOnly` mirror `rules.readOnly`, `destructive`,
`humanAttention`, `humanOnly`. Throws if `bind` is given and no signer is configured (the server sets it at boot).

---

## Client widgets: `useWidget`

```ts
function useWidget<S extends Json>(spec: WidgetSpec<S>): Widget

interface Widget {
  id: string                                   // full id, e.g. 'product:12 > x-coupon:code'
  ref: (el: HTMLElement | null) => void        // put on your root element
  props: { 'data-tvine-id': string; 'data-agent-active'?: ''; 'data-agent-verb'?: ActionKind }   // spread on the root
  embed: ReactElement | null                   // the SSR fragment: render it once
  Scope: (p: { children: ReactNode }) => ReactElement   // wrap children so their ids nest under this one
  agent: { active: boolean; verb?: ActionKind }         // true while an agent acts on this widget
}
```

The four things to do: `ref={w.ref}`, `{...w.props}`, render `{w.embed}`, wrap children in `<w.Scope>`.

### WidgetSpec

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | built-in kind or `` `x-${string}` `` | Built-ins: `section data card cart-badge button link pagination menu context-menu form input textarea select combobox checkbox radio switch slider date file quantity rating tabs accordion stepper dialog drawer popover tooltip toast list table tree carousel`. Custom: `x-…`. |
| `label` | `string` | Required, non-empty (dev throws). |
| `name` | `string` | Local id = `<kind>:<name>`. |
| `id` | `string` | Local id override. |
| `entity` | `string` | Global id (`product:12`); the widget's id IS this, ignoring the parent. |
| `state` | JSON | What the agent reads. Plain JSON only (dev throws on `Date`, `Map`, classes, `NaN`). |
| `controls` | `Record<string, Control>` | Agent controls (below). |
| `data` | `Record<string, unknown>` | Extra fields the agent reads. |
| `sum` | `string` | L0 one-liner. |
| `summary` | `string[]` | Data keys shown in the L1 view (for list rows); some built-ins put short text lines here. |
| `detail` | `string[]` | Data keys left out of L1 (shown in full / `expand`). |
| `hidden` | `string[]` | Data keys never shown to agents. |
| `collapsed` | `boolean` | One line until the agent calls `expand(id)`. |
| `changesContent` | `boolean` | Acting on it changes page content (built-in inputs set it). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Lists no controls. |
| `personal` | `boolean` | Marks the snapshot uncacheable. |
| `sensitive` | `boolean` | State becomes `{ filled: boolean }`; args masked in logs. |
| `humanOnly` | `string` | Locked with this reason (set for you inside `<HumanOnly>`). |
| `presence` | `false \| PresenceOptions` | Agent cursor / outline for this widget. |
| `hooks` | `WidgetHooks` | See below. |
| `rows` | `{ count; get(offset, limit) }` | Type exists for large row sets. Not covered: no code in this version reads it. |
| `children` | `(c: AutoChild) => AutoChild \| { label?, controls?, hooks?, presence? } \| false \| 'group'` | Policy for plain HTML auto-registered directly inside this widget (JSX runtime): `false` hides the child from agents, an object patches its label / controls (override rules) / hooks / presence. `AutoChild` = `{ id, role, name, label, href?, tag, props }`. `'group'` is reserved, not applied. |

The id must be computable without render order: give `name`, `id`, `entity`, or `data.id` / `data.key`
(string or number), else `useWidget` throws. Segment characters other than letters, digits, `_ . : @ / + -`
are replaced by `_` (dev logs); max 256 chars.

### Control

```ts
interface Control<A = Record<string, unknown>, R = Json | void> {
  kind: ActionKind                 // click input clear select toggle set open close submit navigate scroll focus move upload
  params?: { [K in keyof A]: ParamSpec }
  run(args: A, ctx: ControlCtx): R | Promise<R>
  enabled?: boolean                // false = not listed, not callable
  label?: string                   // shown to agents (and in the presence label)
  confirm?: boolean | string       // stored; Not covered: the executor does not prompt on it in this version
  headless?: HeadlessMap           // what a browser-less agent does instead
}
interface ParamSpec {
  type: 'string' | 'number' | 'boolean' | 'date' | 'file' | 'json'
  enum?: readonly string[]; min?: number; max?: number; step?: number
  maxLength?: number; pattern?: string; multiple?: boolean; optional?: boolean; secret?: boolean
}
```

The executor checks args against `params` before calling `run`: unknown args, missing required args,
wrong types, `enum`, `min`/`max`, `maxLength`, `pattern` (full match) → `invalid_param`. `file` and `json`
are checked by your `run`. The signature agents see is like `choose(item: a|b|c)` or `qty(value: 1..10)`.

```ts
interface ControlCtx {
  source: 'agent' | 'gallery'; via: 'webmcp' | 'tab' | 'inspector'; cmdId: string
  signal: AbortSignal                 // aborted on Stop / timeout
  el: HTMLElement | null              // the widget's root
  presence: { point(el): Promise<void>; type(el, text): Promise<void>; say(text): void }
  run(action: ActionHandle, params?): Promise<{ ok: true; result?; goto? } | { ok: false; code; field?; message }>
  navigate(href: string): Promise<void>
  child(localOrFullId: string): WidgetHandle | undefined   // a descendant widget: { id, kind, state, call(control, args) }
  veto(reason: string): never                              // refuse with code 'domain'
}
```

Throw `new WeftError(code, message, reason?, field?)` from `run` to return a specific error code.
Each step has a 5 s timeout, a command 15 s, 20 steps max.

### HeadlessMap

What a browser-less agent (MCP over HTTP) does for a control:

| Shape | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `{ url: 'color', values?: 'enum' \| 'any' }` | Set `?color=<value>` on this page (a path instead of a name = GET that page). |
| `{ rendered: true }` | Nothing to do: the content is already in the HTML (tabs, accordion). |
| `{ params: ActionHandle, field? }` | Fill `field` of that server action. |
| `{ call: 'app.action', args? }` | Run `do <call>` with `args` + the agent's args. |
| `{ session: string, enum? }` | Type exists. Not covered: no built-in uses it. |

### Hooks

```ts
interface WidgetHooks {
  onAgentAction?(e: AgentActionEvent): void | false | string | Promise<…>   // false / string = refuse (code 'domain')
  afterAgentAction?(e: AgentActionEvent & { outcome: UiStepResult }): void  // always runs, refusal included
  onAgentFocus?(active: boolean): void
}
interface AgentActionEvent { target; control; args; via; cmdId; danger?: true; attention?: true | string; agent?: { name; verified: false } }
```

Order: the target widget, then every enclosing widget, then every mounted `<WeftRoot hooks>` (page-wide).
A throwing hook refuses with `internal hook error`. `danger` / `attention` come from the bound action's
`destructive` / `humanAttention`; the framework never refuses on them by itself. `HumanOnly` is checked
before any hook.

### Example: a custom coupon widget with `useWidget`

```tsx
'use client'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useWidget, WeftError } from 'tvine/weft'
import { api } from 'tvine/api'

export function CouponBox() {
  const [code, setCode] = useState('')
  const [applied, setApplied] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const apply = async (c: string) => {
    const r = await api.cart.applyCoupon({ code: c })
    if (!r.ok) throw new WeftError(r.code, r.message, undefined, 'code')
    setApplied(c)
  }
  const w = useWidget({
    kind: 'x-coupon', name: 'coupon', label: 'Coupon code',
    state: { applied },
    controls: {
      apply: { kind: 'submit', params: { code: { type: 'string', maxLength: 20, pattern: '[A-Z0-9]+' } }, run: (a: { code: string }) => apply(a.code) },
      ...(applied ? { remove: { kind: 'clear', run: async () => { await api.cart.removeCoupon({}); setApplied(null) } } } : {}),
    },
  })
  return (
    <div ref={w.ref} {...w.props}>
      {w.embed}
      <input value={code} onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase())} agent={false} />
      <button onClick={() => apply(code).catch(() => {})} agent={false}>Apply</button>
      {applied && <p>Applied: {applied}</p>}
    </div>
  )
}
```

`agent={false}` (Weft JSX runtime) keeps the inner input/button from registering twice; the agent uses
`x-coupon:coupon` with `apply(code)` / `remove()`.

## `defineWidget`

The factory every built-in uses. It keeps internal state seeded from props, re-seeds when the props-derived
state changes (compared by JSON), and applies `controls` / `hooks` / `id` / `name` / `label` /
`disabled` / `presence` props for you.

```ts
function defineWidget<P, S extends Json, C extends Record<string, Control>>(def: {
  kind: WidgetKind | `x-${string}`
  state(props: P): S
  controls(api: { props: P; state: S; set(next: Partial<S>): void; el(): HTMLElement | null }): C
  headless?(props: P): Partial<Record<keyof C, HeadlessMap>>
  describe?(props: P): { label: string; summary?: string[] }
  spec?(props: P): Partial<WidgetSpec>          // e.g. { name, sensitive, personal, data, entity }
}): (props: DefinedProps<P, C>) => Widget & { state: S }
```

```tsx
'use client'
import { defineWidget, type DefinedProps } from 'tvine/weft'

type P = { name: string; sizes: string[]; value: string; onChange(v: string): void }
const useSizePicker = defineWidget<P, { value: string }, any>({
  kind: 'x-size',
  state: (p) => ({ value: p.value }),
  controls: ({ props: p, el }) => ({
    select: { kind: 'select', params: { value: { type: 'string', enum: p.sizes } },
      run: async (a: { value: string }) => { el()?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(`[data-size="${a.value}"]`)?.click() } },
  }),
  describe: () => ({ label: 'Size' }),
  spec: (p) => ({ name: p.name }),
})

export function SizePicker(props: DefinedProps<P, any>) {
  const w = useSizePicker(props)
  return <div ref={w.ref} {...w.props}>{w.embed}
    {props.sizes.map((s) => <button key={s} data-size={s} aria-pressed={s === props.value} onClick={() => props.onChange(s)} agent={false}>{s}</button>)}
  </div>
}
```

Clicking the real button from `run` means the person-path `onChange` runs for agents too.

## `useAgent` (client)

```ts
useAgent(type: string, spec: { id?; label?; data: Record<string, unknown>; actions?: ActionHandle[]; personal?; live? }): ReactElement | null
```

A v1-compatible shortcut over `useWidget`: kind `data`, entity `<type>:<data.id|key>` (or a scoped `id`),
label from `label` / `data.name` / `data.title` / `type`. Each `ActionHandle` (from `bindAction` on the
server) becomes a `submit` control (one action → `submit`, several → named by action id). Render the
returned element. A raw `ActionDef` is ignored with a dev warning (clients cannot sign).

## `WidgetScope` / `useWidgetScope`

```ts
function WidgetScope(props: { id: string; entity?: boolean; children?: ReactNode }): JSX.Element
function useWidgetScope(): string        // the nearest enclosing widget's full id ('' = page)
```

Make client widgets inside nest under an id without registering a widget yourself (the server
primitives use it). `entity` = `id` is global, not joined to the parent.

## Ids, in one table

| Source | Local segment | Full id |
|---|---|---|
| `name="size"` on a `select` | `select:size` | `<parent> > select:size` |
| `id="sizes"` | `sizes` | `<parent> > sizes` |
| `entity="product:12"` | — | `product:12` (global) |
| `data={{ id: 7 }}`, kind `data` | `data:7` | `<parent> > data:7` |
| plain `<button name="buy">` (JSX runtime) | `button:buy` | `<parent> > button:buy` |
| plain `<a href="/cart">` | `link:/cart` | |
| server `Section name="cart"` | `section:cart` | |
| server `Form action={a}` | `form:<a.id>[:bind values]` | |

Same id twice in one scope: the first mount stays addressable, dev logs an error. The same entity in two
places (grid + "recently viewed") is fine: one node.

## JSX runtime props (plain HTML)

With `"jsxImportSource": "tvine/weft"`, every intrinsic element accepts:

| Prop | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `agent={false}` | Do not register this element or anything inside it. (`'group'` is reserved, not applied.) |
| `agentId` | Explicit name → `<role>:<agentId>`. |
| `agentLabel` | Label override. |
| `agentSensitive` | Value never shown (password inputs and `autocomplete=*password*`/`cc-*` are sensitive already). |
| `agentConfirm` | Stored on the control; Not covered: no prompt in this version. |

Elements that are disabled, `hidden`, `aria-hidden`, `aria-disabled` or `inert` are left out of the agent
view. `<WeftRoot auto={false}>` turns auto-registration off for the whole app.

## Progressive disclosure

The agent tool `read_page({ view })` returns the page at a chosen size:

| View | What |
|---|---|
| `md` | The page as compact Markdown with control ids inline. The tool description tells agents to start here. Supports `offset` / `limit`. |
| `auto` (default) | `full` if it fits ~4000 tokens, else `L1` if it fits, else `L0`. |
| `L0` | A map: up to 30 top nodes and 10 links, one line each (`label`, `sum`, what it offers). |
| `L1` | Depth 2, 5 rows per list, rows shown by their `summary` keys; repeated row controls folded into one `×N` line. |
| `full` | Everything. |

`expand({ id, offset?, limit? })` returns one node in full (rows paged). What you control per widget:
`sum` (the L0 line), `summary` (L1 row keys), `detail` (keys kept out of L1), `hidden` (never shown),
`collapsed` (one line until expanded). Tabs, accordion and tree render every panel in the HTML, so a
headless agent reads them without clicking.

## Live updates

| Tool | Use |
|---|---|
| `Page live` / `Data live` / `Link live` | Mark content that changes without a server write: never cached. |
| `personal` | Per-session content: never cached or shared. |
| `useTvineChannel({ enabled?, onUpdate? })` | Same-origin SSE on `/tvine/channel`. Returns `{ status: 'off'\|'connecting'\|'live'\|'expired', agentActive, lastEvent?, lastJob? }`. `onUpdate` fires when an agent changed something server-side (`source: 'agent'`), when a background job of this session finishes or bumps the rev, and on a `stale_rev` replay gap. `agentActive` turns off 30 s after the last agent event. |
| `AgentBadge({ active, className?, children? })` | Renders `<span data-tvine-agent-badge>` (default text `agent active`) while `active`. |
| `AgentSuspense({ fallback, children })` | A `Suspense` the agent runtime knows about: while its fallback shows, reads report `pending` and the settle rule waits for it (max 3 s). |

```tsx
'use client'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useTvineChannel, AgentBadge } from 'tvine/weft'

export function LiveCart() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { agentActive } = useTvineChannel({ onUpdate: () => router.refresh() })
  return <AgentBadge active={agentActive}>An assistant is editing your cart</AgentBadge>
}
```

In the tab, the registry has a revision number (`rev`) that bumps on every mount, unmount and state
change; an agent `ui` call that sends an old `rev` gets `stale_rev` and a fresh L0 map.

## Gotchas

- Forgetting `{w.embed}` hides the widget from headless agents; forgetting `ref={w.ref}` breaks in-tab controls that read `ctx.el`.
- Do not use `useId` or list indexes in names: ids must be the same on the server and in every render.
- Server primitives inside your own components need the render-prop `scope` hand-off, or they register without their prefix / without a form.
- `state` is compared shallowly for `rev` bumps; build it from plain values.
- `Page title` is the agent's title, not `document.title`.

## See also

- [widgets.md](widgets.md) — the built-ins made with `defineWidget`
- [forms.md](forms.md) — `Form`, `Input`, `Button` primitives, `HumanOnly`
- [agents-in-the-browser.md](agents-in-the-browser.md) — the tools that read all this
- [overview.md](overview.md)
- [../warp/views.md](../warp/views.md) — ListView `Paginated` results for `List` / `Table`


# docs/reference/weft/agents-in-the-browser.md

# Agents in the browser

## What it is

The Weft runtime lets an AI agent work inside a person's open browser tab, as that person, while they
watch. There are two ways in: **WebMCP** (an agent built into the browser calls tools the page registers)
and **remote tab control** (an agent connected to the site's MCP server calls `request_control`, the person
clicks Allow, and the agent's commands run in their tab). Both use the same in-tab registry and executor,
show the same agent cursor, outline and Stop pill, and run the same widget hooks. `<WeftRoot>` turns all
of it on; most apps write no extra code.

## Import

```ts
import { WeftRoot, registerWebMcp, connectTab, openConnect, useTvineChannel, AgentBadge, HumanOnly,
         type PresenceOptions, type WidgetHooks } from 'tvine/weft'
```

## `<WeftRoot>`

```ts
function WeftRoot(props: {
  children?: ReactNode
  hooks?: WidgetHooks            // page-wide agent hooks (veto, audit)
  auto?: boolean                 // false: no auto-registration of plain HTML inside
  inTab?: 'on' | 'off'           // 'off': no WebMCP tools and no tab socket
  presence?: false | PresenceOptions   // false: no outline/cursor/label (the Stop pill always shows)
}): JSX.Element
```

| Prop | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `hooks` | — | `onAgentAction` / `afterAgentAction` / `onAgentFocus` for every widget on the page. Several mounted roots stack (innermost first). Functions: pass them from an app-owned `'use client'` wrapper. |
| `auto` | `true` | `false` keeps the JSX runtime but skips auto-registering plain HTML. |
| `inTab` | `'on'` | On in production too. `'off'` is the app's opt-out. |
| `presence` | `{}` | See "Presence". |

What it mounts: the presence overlay settings, the navigation watcher, the WebMCP tools, the tab socket,
the confirm dialog (`ConfirmHost`), and in development only the widget gallery (Alt+Shift+W) — in a
production build that code is not in the bundle. Put it in the **root layout** so it survives client
navigations.

